A Thread Of Silver.name: A Thread Of Silver（A Thread Of Silver）
A Thread Of Silver.description:
Source PPC:DHB

  價格 6,700 gp; Accuracy +7; Associated Skill Knowledge (engineering) (DC 25)

DESCRIPTION

  This thick leather-bound book was stolen by unknown hands, and describes one of the earliest surveys of a famous mountain and nearby ruins. Assassins brutally hunt down anyone with a copy.

SKILL BONUSES

  • Disable clockwork traps (Disable Device +2)
  • Evaluate certain relics (Appraise +4)
  • Identify construct creature (Knowledge [arcana] +4)

Abacus.name: 算盤（Abacus）
Abacus.description:
價格：2GP；重量：2磅

  這件裝置可以幫助你進行一些較為複雜的數學運算。

Absinthe.name: Absinthe（Absinthe）
Absinthe.description:
Absinthe

  價格 3-30 gp; 重量 varies

  This green alcoholic drink, made from wormwood, is rumored to enhance creativity, which makes it a favored beverage of artists and eccentrics.

Acid.name: 強酸（Acid）
Acid.description:
價格：10G；重量： 1磅

  你可以將一瓶強酸投擲出去作為濺射武器使用。這類攻擊被視為射程增量為10尺的遠程接觸攻擊。直接命中會造成1D6的酸液傷害，在5尺之內的生物都會由於酸液的飛濺而受到1點酸液傷害。

Acrobat's Pillar.name: Acrobat's Pillar（Acrobat's Pillar）
Acrobat's Pillar.description:
Source: PZO1110

  價格 50 gp; 重量 40 磅

  This training contraption consists of a stout, 7-foot-tall wooden pillar with spring-powered wood-and-brass arms jutting sideways at different heights. When the springs are wound, the arms wave erratically through the area within 10 feet of the pillar. The arms don't swing with sufficient force to cause damage, but you can practice your acrobatic technique by moving up to and around the pillar while the arms are in motion, attempting to avoid being tagged. The mechanism operates for 10 minutes before winding down. The entire contraption can be dismantled and stowed in a chest the size of a large foot locker for transport.

  Using the pillar to hone your acrobatic techniques requires 1 hour of practice and a DC 20 Acrobatics check. If you succeed at the check, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Acrobatics checks to avoid attacks of opportunity provoked by moving out of or through an opponent's threatened area. This bonus lasts for 24 hours or until you fail an Acrobatics check.

Air Bladder.name: 氣囊（Air Bladder）
Air Bladder.description:
價格 1 sp; 重量 1/2 磅

  氣囊是長期潛水的游泳者所使用的裝備，與水袋類似，但具有更好的氣密性。充滿氣時可提供一箇中型生物1輪呼吸或一個小型生物2輪呼吸所需的空氣。

Air Crystals.name: Air Crystals（Air Crystals）
Air Crystals.description:
Source PFSFG

  These unpleasant-tasting, alchemically grown crystals release breathable air when chewed. A pouch of air crystals provides 1 minute of breathable air. Placing air crystals in your mouth takes a standard action; chewing them each round is a free action. Any attempt to speak while chewing air crystals negates any remaining duration.

Alchemical Cement.name: 鍊金混凝土（Alchemical Cement）
Alchemical Cement.description:
價格：5GP重量：2磅

  把這種細膩的灰色粉塵與砂礫或碎石暗比例混合再調入水，晾乾就會變成和石頭一樣堅固的固體。在風乾以前這種混凝土的硬度只有黏泥巴的程度，所以你必須用合適的模具將之固定成形（比如用燒製的粘土或木框）。混凝土乾燥的世界大約需要1d10+10分鐘，在此之後，它每英吋厚度具有2點硬度和5點生命值。過去1d6小時候，成形混凝土牆的硬度和生命值將完全等同於石頭。

Alchemical Coal.name: Alchemical Coal（Alchemical Coal）
Alchemical Coal.description:
Source PZO1121

  A kobold who chews and swallows this alchemically treated piece of coal (a full-round action) can make one breath weapon attack during the next minute. If the kobold fails to make a breath attack before this minute expires, it is sickened for 1 hour. Other humanoid creatures that eat alchemical coal are sickened for 1 hour (though certain other creatures may be able to use them, at the GM's discretion). Creatures that are immune to poison are immune to the sickened effect. The type of breath weapon depends on the type of alchemical coal that is chewed by the kobold.

  Blinding Cinders: This jagged bit of dusty red coal allows a kobold to breathe a 30-foot line of coarse cinders. The breath weapon deals 1d6 points of fire damage and blinds creatures in the area for 1 round. A creature that succeeds at a DC 15 Reflex saving throw takes half damage and is not blinded.

  Choking Smoke: This crumbling chunk of chalky white coal allows a kobold to breathe a 15-foot cone of foul vapor that deals 1d6 points of acid damage and sickens a creature for 1d4 rounds. A creature that succeeds at a DC 15 Reflex saving throw takes half damage and is not sickened.

Alchemical Glue.name: 鍊金凝膠（Alchemical Glue）
Alchemical Glue.description:
價格：20GP重量：1/2磅

  兩瓶黏黏的漿狀物，只要按比例混合起來再稍稍凝固它們就會形成堅不可摧的粘合劑。一整份凝膠可以塗滿1平方尺的物體表面或（考慮到損失和誤用的可能性），塗滿20個表面積2平方英尺的小物件。凝膠開始凝結的時間是1分鐘，完全乾燥則要一小時。嘗試撕開粘在一起的東西（接觸面至少1平方尺）必須要通過一個DC20的力量檢定（開始凝結的膠）或DC25的力量檢定（完全粘接的膠）。把粘住的小物體（任何接觸面小於一平方尺）拽開則需要一個DC15（凝結）或DC20（粘接）的力量檢定。

Alchemical Glue Accelerant.name: 鍊金膠催化劑（Alchemical Glue Accelerant）
Alchemical Glue Accelerant.description:
價格：25GP重量：-

  這一小瓶液體可以加快鍊金凝膠的作用時間。通過一個標準動作調入催化劑，加入催化劑的鍊金凝膠會在1輪時間後開始凝結並在1分鐘後完全乾燥。一份催化劑含有20滴，一滴可以用在粘接一個小物體上，而調進足以塗抹1平方尺的凝膠則需要一整瓶。

Alchemical Preserves.name: Alchemical Preserves（Alchemical Preserves）
Alchemical Preserves.description:
Source PZO1121

  Each small tin of this specially treated jam contains just enough of the gooey stuff to provide a halfling with a single serving of revitalizing nourishment. While any creature can eat these preserves as a standard action, it only affects halflings in a beneficial way. Halflings who eat the preserves recover from fatigue. Non-halflings who eat alchemical preserves become sickened for 1 round.

Alchemical Solvent.name: 鍊金解膠劑（Alchemical Solvent）
Alchemical Solvent.description:
價格：20GP重量：1/2磅

  這瓶滿是氣泡的紫色液體可以化開任何黏膠，把它撒出來正好可以解決5平方尺內的一切過黏的干擾物（比如瀝青焦油，樹脂和凝膠），這個過程需要1輪時間。解決更黏的麻煩（比如鍊金凝膠，絆足包，蛛網，等等）需要1d4+1輪生效。但是它魔法性質的黏膠，諸如至尊膠（Sovereign Glue）無效。

Alchemist's Fire.name: 熾火膠（Alchemist's Fire）
Alchemist's Fire.description:
價格：20G；重量： 1磅

  熾火膠是由數類不穩定液體所組成的，它們一旦暴露於空氣就會猛烈的燃燒。你可以將一瓶熾火膠投擲出去作為濺射武器使用。這類攻擊被視為射程增量為10尺的遠程接觸攻擊。直接命中會造成1d6點的火傷害。在5尺之內的生物都會由於火焰的飛濺而受到1點火傷害。在你直接命中目標隨後的一個回合，目標將受到額外的1d6點傷害。如果目標自願，他還可以使用一個整輪動作試圖撲滅身上的火焰來避免受到該額外的傷害，這需要通過一個DC15的反射檢定，在地上打滾可以獲得+2的檢定加值。跳進湖裡或者使用魔法來滅火將自動使得火焰熄滅。

  製造熾火膠需要一個DC20的工藝（鍊金）檢定。

Alchemist's Kindness.name: Alchemist's Kindness（Alchemist's Kindness）
Alchemist's Kindness.description:
Source PZO1115

  Favored by young rakes and others of means, this is a crystalline powder resembling salt. Mixed with water, it makes a fizzing cocktail that eliminates the effects of a hangover within 10 minutes of drinking it.

Alchemist's Lab.name: 鍊金師工作臺（Alchemist's Lab）
Alchemist's Lab.description:
價格：200GP；重量：40磅

  這副工作臺可以用來配置鍊金物品，在使用者的手藝（鍊金術）技能檢定上提供+2環境加值，但不會對手藝（鍊金術）檢定增加額外的消耗。如果沒有工作臺的支持，一個角色雖然被視為擁有足夠的工具來完成鍊金術實驗，但也無法享受+2加值的好處。

Alchemist's Lab, Portable.name: 便攜式鍊金術工作臺（Alchemist's Lab, Portable）
Alchemist's Lab, Portable.description:
價格：75GP；重量：20磅

  這副精簡版的鍊金術工作臺可以為你的手藝（鍊金術）檢定提供+1環境加值。

Ale.name: 麥酒（Ale）
Ale.description:
價格：4CP－2SP；重量：1-8磅

  這種啤酒是用焙烤過的大麥釀製的，味道甘甜而下肚極有質感，有時還飄逸著果香。

Ale, Dwarven Stout.name: 矮人烈酒（Ale, Dwarven stout）
Ale, Dwarven Stout.description:
價格：4CP；重量：1/2磅

  與其說矮人烈酒是一種酒，不如說是一類酒更正確。在人類的國度出售的矮人烈酒品目繁多，不過基本上都是一種顏色泛黑，略有焦味的泡沫啤酒——據說灌些矮人烈酒足以飽肚。每個矮人氏族都保有一份獨特的烈酒配方，一些特別好味的配方都是依靠某些家族數百年來代代相傳保留的。

Ale, Luglurch.name: Ale, Luglurch（Ale, Luglurch）
Ale, Luglurch.description:
Ale, Luglurch

Source PPC:Halflings

  Most races find this pale and frothy beer too salty to swallow, but halflings simply consider it an acquired taste. Drinking three or more cups of Luglurch in a 1-minute span gives a halfling a -2 penalty on Perception checks and a +1 bonus on Reflex saves and Acrobatics checks for 10 minutes.

  Note: Non-halflings do not receive any bonuses from this drink.

Alkali Flask.name: 強鹼瓶（Alkali Flask）
Alkali Flask.description:
價格：15G；重量： 1磅

  這瓶強腐蝕性的液體將會和泥怪的天然酸液產生反應。你可以將一瓶強鹼投擲出去作為濺射武器使用。這類攻擊被視為射程增量為10尺的遠程接觸攻擊。對於非泥形怪物，強鹼瓶會對其造成普通強酸的效果；對於泥形怪物或其他基於酸液的生物，鹼酸瓶會對其造成雙倍的傷害。

  製造強鹼瓶需要一個DC20的工藝（鍊金）檢定。

Alkali Salt.name: Alkali Salt（Alkali Salt）
Alkali Salt.description:
Source PZO9210

  These tiny granules can be dissolved in water, creating a slimy material used to coat metallic items such as weapons or armor. Such a coating neutralizes the metal-eating acid of black puddings and gray oozes, protecting the item from 1d3 contacts with an ooze's acidic touch.

  Create: Craft (alchemy) DC 20

Allnight.name: Allnight（Allnight）
Allnight.description:
Source PZO9410

  This treated wafer dissolves into a chalky paste when placed under the tongue and then gives the imbiber a jolt of restless energy. It eliminates the effects of fatigue for the next 8 hours; when the drug's effect ends, the user is exhausted. Allnight makes its users jittery and unable to focus; they suffer a -2 penalty on all skill checks until its effects wear off.

Altar, Portable.name: 便攜式經臺（Altar, Portable）
Altar, Portable.description:
價格：250GP；重量：40磅

  通常為木製，且浮雕有特定宗教的徽記和裝飾物，一副便攜式經臺具有可拆卸式的檯面，內部可以存放用於禮拜的祭器諸如蠟燭、薰香、聖油等物。雖然簡單，但對於需要在各地旅行傳教，或是在旅途中舉行祈禱和祭儀，以及向大眾宣教的牧師來說它的作用相當巨大。

Ambrosia.name: Ambrosia（Ambrosia）
Ambrosia.description:
Source PZO1121

  Upon consumption, this heavenly elixir, brewed from holy water and blessed herbs, grants a +2 sacred bonus on saving throws against negative energy, energy drain, and death effects for 1 hour, including saves to remove negative levels. Ambrosia affects undead and evil outsiders as holy water.

Amulet of Natural Armor +1.name: +1天生防護護符（Amulet of Natural Armor +1）
Amulet of Natural Armor +1.description: 通常以魔法獸的獸皮或者其它天生護甲——骨、角、殼、鱗片等，強化穿戴者的身體血肉。穿戴者得到+1到+5點天生防禦的增強加值。

Amulet of Natural Armor +2.name: +2天生防護護符（Amulet of Natural Armor +2）
Amulet of Natural Armor +2.description: 通常以魔法獸的獸皮或者其它天生護甲——骨、角、殼、鱗片等，強化穿戴者的身體血肉。穿戴者得到+1到+5點天生防禦的增強加值。

Amulet of Natural Armor +3.name: +3天生防護護符（Amulet of Natural Armor +3）
Amulet of Natural Armor +3.description: 通常以魔法獸的獸皮或者其它天生護甲——骨、角、殼、鱗片等，強化穿戴者的身體血肉。穿戴者得到+1到+5點天生防禦的增強加值。

Amulet of Natural Armor +4.name: +4天生防護護符（Amulet of Natural Armor +4）
Amulet of Natural Armor +4.description: 通常以魔法獸的獸皮或者其它天生護甲——骨、角、殼、鱗片等，強化穿戴者的身體血肉。穿戴者得到+1到+5點天生防禦的增強加值。

Amulet of Natural Armor +5.name: +5天生防護護符（Amulet of Natural Armor +5）
Amulet of Natural Armor +5.description: 通常以魔法獸的獸皮或者其它天生護甲——骨、角、殼、鱗片等，強化穿戴者的身體血肉。穿戴者得到+1到+5點天生防禦的增強加值。

Angelstep.name: Angelstep（Angelstep）
Angelstep.description:
Source PZO1140

  價格 25 gp

  This iridescent white shelf fungus is said to have first grown from the footsteps of an angel, though some claim it instead comes from the footsteps of a djinni.

  Gather DC 18; Yield 1 dose

  Terrain temperate or warm deserts

  Preparation A dose of angelstep can be used raw or processed into a pigment that can be worn on the skin. Processing a dose of the pigment takes 4 hours and requires a successful DC 15 Craft (alchemy) check. Angelstep pigment costs twice as much as the raw fungus.

  Use As part of an attempt to stabilize a dying creature, a dose of raw angelstep can be rubbed on the creature to grant a +4 bonus on the Heal check to stabilize the creature. A dose of angelstep pigment applied to the skin of a Medium or smaller creature helps to protect that creature against death for 2d4 hours. The next time the wearer of angelstep pigment drops to negative hit points, it gains a +4 alchemical bonus on its next 1d6 Constitution checks to stabilize. The pigment loses its effect once all these checks are attempted or once the victim is stabilized.

Animal Glue.name: 動物膠（Animal Glue）
Animal Glue.description:
Animal Glue

  價格 5 sp; 重量 1/2 磅

  將動物皮、骨、蹄、角、筋充分煮沸後形成赭色的漿液，待其冷卻變硬之後就可以製成這種簡單的膠水。在你使用這種膠水之前，必須先加熱直到它液化。你可以用刷子將其塗抹在需要貼上的碎片上，將碎片緊密的貼合在一起並至少保持1分鐘，之後膠水才會重新冷卻變硬。1份膠水足以塗滿1平方英尺的表面，或者（由於浪費和溢出）40個面積為2平方英尺的小區域。拉開一個由動物膠貼上的大平面（至少1平方尺）需要通過一個DC15力量檢定。拉開一個平面（小於1平方尺）需要通過一個DC10力量檢定。動物膠會緩慢的溶於水，每在水裡浸泡10分鐘，打開膠面所需的力量檢定DC就會減少1。在加熱，甚至是遇到蒸汽時動物膠會加速軟化，每1分鐘打開膠面所需的力量檢定DC就會減少1。

Antiplague.name: Antiplague（Antiplague）
Antiplague.description:
Source PZO1115

  If you drink a vial of this foul-tasting, milky tonic, you gain a +5 alchemical bonus on Fortitude saving throws against disease for the next hour. If already infected, you may also make two saving throws (without the +5 bonus) that day and use the better result.

  Create: Craft (alchemy) DC 25

Alchemical Power Component

Source PZO9410

  Certain healing spells have greater effects when used with antiplague.

  • Heroes' Feast (M): For each vial of antiplague used as a power component, one creature eating the feast gains the benefits of antiplague for 12 hours. Antiplague's normally foul taste does not change the taste of the feast.
  • Remove Disease (M): Add +2 on your caster level check to cure diseases on the target.

Antitoxin.name: Antitoxin（Antitoxin）
Antitoxin.description:
Source PZO1110

  If you drink a vial of antitoxin, you get a +5 alchemical bonus on Fortitude saving throws against poison for 1 hour.

Alchemical Power Component

Source PZO9410

  Like antiplague, antitoxin can augment certain healing spells.

  • Neutralize Poison (M): Add +2 on your caster level check to neutralize poison on a target creature. Antitoxin has no effect when you cast the spell on an object.

Anvil.name: 鐵砧（Anvil）
Anvil.description:
價格：5GP；重量：10-100磅

  雖然用處和大小各有不同，不過一具鐵砧的基本造型是大致相同的。從非常巨大沉重的鐵匠用鐵砧（100磅），到較小的蹄鐵鐵砧（50磅）到最小號的金銀匠鐵氈（10磅）。沒有合適的鐵砧，一個冶金匠人無法完成他的手藝。

Applejack.name: 蘋果酒（Applejack）
Applejack.description:
價格：10GP；重量：2磅

  這種極烈的蘋果酒是用在寒冬凌風中凍硬過，然後再壓碎榨汁的蘋果釀製的。

Aquarium Ball.name: Aquarium Ball（Aquarium Ball）
Aquarium Ball.description:
Source PPC:FF

  價格 80 gp; 重量 20 磅

  This clear, 1-inch-thick glass orb is the size of a large melon and hangs from a thick chain. It can hold up to 2 gallons of freshwater or saltwater, allowing it to house aquatic creatures such as fish or frogs. The cap near the top of the ball can be unscrewed for access. One Tiny creature or two Diminutive creatures can fit comfortably into an aquarium ball. The water within the orb must be changed daily in order to keep the creatures within alive. Otherwise, the inhabitants begin to slowly suffocate.

Arcane Family Workbook.name: Arcane Family Workbook（Arcane Family Workbook）
Arcane Family Workbook.description: Arcane Family Workbook The elven predilection for becoming wizards and the social benefits that elven wizards enjoy often encourages families to dedicate themselves to wizardly studies for multiple generations. Older elven wizards take note of their own insights into the secrets of arcane magic and compile these thoughts with the ideas of earlier generations to form family workbooks. When used as a reference (an action that typically takes 1d4 full rounds of searching the text), an arcane family workbook grants a +2 circumstance bonus on a Spellcraft checks. This bonus increases to +4 if 1d4 hours are spent referencing the book. 價格 300 gp; 重量 3 磅 Source PZO1121

Armor Truss.name: Armor Truss（Armor Truss）
Armor Truss.description:
Source: PZO9455

  價格 30 gp; 重量 10 磅

  This collection of flexible strips of wood, durable shims, and thin cords allows you to prop open the buckles, padding, and plates of armor for easy entry. If you take at least 15 minutes preparing an empty suit of armor with an armor truss, you are considered to have help in putting on the armor and can don the armor in the time it usually takes to don the armor hastily without worsening armor check penalties or decreasing armor bonuses.

Arrow, Grappling.name: 爪鉤箭（Arrow, Grappling）
Arrow, Grappling.description:
價格 1 gp; 重量 1/2 磅

  這種小爪鉤被設計於用弓發射，並且可以繫上絲繩。發射時，其射程增量為30尺。也有用於弩的爪鉤箭存在。

Artificer's Lab, Portable.name: Artificer's Lab, Portable（Artificer's Lab, Portable）
Artificer's Lab, Portable.description:
Source PZO1121

  The portable artificer's lab contains everything needed to create magic items, though many of the tools and implements are of only the most basic type. This lab allows the artificer to spend 4 hours crafting each night while out adventuring, and net 3 hours' worth of work (instead of 2). However, because the tools are all designed to fulfill multiple functions and the portable lab lacks the space and quiet that provide ideal circumstances for creating magic items, the skill check to complete a magic item that had any of its work done using a portable lab takes a -5 penalty.

Astrolabe.name: 星盤（Astrolabe）
Astrolabe.description:
價格 1,000 gp; 重量 6 磅

  該裝置由一個扁平的圓盤和另外兩個安裝於其下的圓盤組成。安裝的圓盤可以在中心軸上旋轉，這使它們可以按照日期來旋轉、移動。底盤顯示使用者目前所處的緯度，但若使用者超出了預設的緯度，那麼星盤就毫無用處。充滿了天文特色的上盤標記了天空。任何人都可以嘗試在晚上用星盤確定目前的日期和時間（花費1分鐘）。當使用星盤時，你使用生存檢定時可以用智力調整值取代感知調整值以避免減值。

Bachelor snuff.name: Bachelor snuff（Bachelor snuff）
Bachelor snuff.description:
Source Adventurer's Armory pg. 19
價格 1 gp; 重量 —
分類 Black Market

描述

  If inhaled through the nose, this sootysmelling golden powder renders humanoid males temporarily sterile without otherwise affecting their performance. A dose typically lasts 1–3 days. Long-term users of bachelor snuff tend to develop a slight, but still noticeable, gilded tinge to their teeth and nails.

Backpack.name: 背包（Backpack）
Backpack.description: 這種皮革背包有一個大口袋，可用扣帶關閉，可容納約2立方英尺的物品。有些背包在側面會有一個或多個小口袋。

Backpack, Masterwork.name: 精製背包（Backpack, Masterwork）
Backpack, Masterwork.description: 這款背包有許多口袋可以用來存儲冒險中可能需要的物品。背包上有一些鉤子可以用來綁住水罐、袋子，甚至是捲起來的毛毯等。交叉於胸前的肩帶含有軟墊，使得腰部能夠更均勻的分配重量。與普通的背包一樣，精製品背包能夠在其主容器內容納約2立方英尺的物品。若你裝備精製品背包，計算負重時你的力量視為比正常值+1。

Bag, Bear.name: Bag, Bear（Bag, Bear）
Bag, Bear.description:
Source PZO1121

  These sacks each include a 20-foot-long rope, from which they may be easily suspended from a tree limb or similar anchor point. Placing foodstuffs or fragile materials in hanging sacks is often considered a basic precaution when camping in the wild, to prevent bears and other predators from rooting through the sack's contents.

Bag, Waterproof.name: 防水袋（Bag, Waterproof）
Bag, Waterproof.description:
價格 5 sp; 重量 1/2 磅

  這種皮革麻袋用焦油或瀝青密封，防止那些脆弱的物體被水毀壞。袋子內的物品保持相對的乾燥，使攜帶地圖、卷軸、法術書和類似物品袋的想法成為可能。雖然袋子是不能滲透的，但它只能被完全浸沒10輪，之後水就會滲進袋子破壞那些物品。

Baijiu.name: 白乾（Baijiu）
Baijiu.description:
價格：10GP；重量：2磅

  這清冽如水的酒蒸餾自發酵的高粱。其烈如地火，嚐起來辣口燒喉——才是好酒。

Ball (10 in).name: 球 (10寸)（Ball (10 in)）
Ball (10 in).description:
價格：6 gp;重量：1磅

  球可以使用充氣的動物膀胱製作，用輕質木材雕刻而成，或者用植物纖維和布料填充進布袋再縫好。

Ball (2 in).name: 球 (2寸)（Ball (2 in)）
Ball (2 in).description:
價格：8cp;重量：—

  球可以使用充氣的動物膀胱製作，用輕質木材雕刻而成，或者用植物纖維和布料填充進布袋再縫好。

Ball (5 in).name: 球 (5寸)（Ball (5 in)）
Ball (5 in).description:
價格：2sp;重量：—

  球可以使用充氣的動物膀胱製作，用輕質木材雕刻而成，或者用植物纖維和布料填充進布袋再縫好。

Bandolier.name: 子彈帶（Bandolier）
Bandolier.description:
價格 5 sp; 重量 -

  這條皮帶佩戴在肩膀上，斜跨過使用者的胸部和背部。子彈帶上有八個圓環或者袋子，可以用來裝下小的匕首或者火藥筒。你從子彈帶上拿取一件物品，其動作等同於從背包裡拿出一個物品。你可以同時佩戴兩個子彈帶（超過這個數量的子彈帶會互相妨礙，並影響你的行動）。

Banner (Complex).name: 旗幟 (複雜)（Banner (Complex)）
Banner (Complex).description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 56
價格 1–20 gp; 重量 2 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  旗幟可以是旌旗、條幅或者三角旗。你可以把它綁在一根長杆、長槍，或者長柄武器上。大多數旗幟都織、染或繪有圖案或符號，例如一個騎士的紋章或一個國家的標誌。簡單的旗幟只有一種顏色或只有一個簡單的圖案如武器、盾牌，其費用只有1GP。若旗幟有2到4種顏色或有複雜的圖案如獅子、龍，則費用為5GP。複雜的旗幟，有四種以上的顏色或有非常複雜的圖案如由八個或更多部分組成的紋章，其費用為20GP。

Banner (Simple).name: 旗幟 (簡單)（Banner (Simple)）
Banner (Simple).description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 56
價格 1–20 gp; 重量 2 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  旗幟可以是旌旗、條幅或者三角旗。你可以把它綁在一根長杆、長槍，或者長柄武器上。大多數旗幟都織、染或繪有圖案或符號，例如一個騎士的紋章或一個國家的標誌。簡單的旗幟只有一種顏色或只有一個簡單的圖案如武器、盾牌，其費用只有1GP。若旗幟有2到4種顏色或有複雜的圖案如獅子、龍，則費用為5GP。複雜的旗幟，有四種以上的顏色或有非常複雜的圖案如由八個或更多部分組成的紋章，其費用為20GP。

Banner (Very complex).name: 旗幟 (非常複雜)（Banner (Very complex)）
Banner (Very complex).description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 56
價格 1–20 gp; 重量 2 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  旗幟可以是旌旗、條幅或者三角旗。你可以把它綁在一根長杆、長槍，或者長柄武器上。大多數旗幟都織、染或繪有圖案或符號，例如一個騎士的紋章或一個國家的標誌。簡單的旗幟只有一種顏色或只有一個簡單的圖案如武器、盾牌，其費用只有1GP。若旗幟有2到4種顏色或有複雜的圖案如獅子、龍，則費用為5GP。複雜的旗幟，有四種以上的顏色或有非常複雜的圖案如由八個或更多部分組成的紋章，其費用為20GP。

Barbarian Chew.name: Barbarian Chew（Barbarian Chew）
Barbarian Chew.description:
Source PZO9410

  This bitter red chew comes from dried leaves of a stunted bush found in northern climates. It stains the teeth dark crimson but also increases the duration of barbarian rage entered into during the next hour by 1 round.

Barding.name: 坐騎護甲（Barding）
Barding.description:
價格：可變；重量：可變

  坐騎護甲是一種會包裹住頭部、頸部、胸部、身體、可能還外加肢體的護甲，它一般為馬或者其他坐騎製作。製成中甲或者重甲的坐騎護甲，相比輕型坐騎護甲能夠提供效果更好的保護，不過這要以犧牲速度作為代價。坐騎護甲可以由任何在護甲與盾牌表格（Armor and Shields table）中列出的護甲製作而成。

  馬用護甲（大型非類人生物）的價格是人類（中型類人生物）的四倍，而重量是同類護甲的兩倍（見表格：特別生物的防具（Armor for Unusual Creatures table））。如果是給矮種馬或其他中型坐騎準備的坐騎護甲，那麼僅需要支付雙倍的價格，護甲重量與中型類人生物的護甲重量相同。中型或重型坐騎護甲會降低佩戴護甲的坐騎速度，如下表所述。

  飛行坐騎若穿戴中型或重型坐騎護甲便無法飛行。

  脫下或穿戴上坐騎護甲所需要的時間是穿戴護甲表格（Donning Armor table）中給出時間的五倍。穿戴護甲的動物無法被用於攜帶或承載騎手之外的人，也不能負載普通的鞍囊（normal saddlebags）。

  坐騎護甲類型 （40尺） 基本速度（50尺） （60尺）

  中型坐騎護甲 30尺 35尺 40尺

  重型坐騎護甲 30尺* 35尺* 40尺*

  *：穿戴重型護甲的坐騎只能以正常速度的三倍奔跑，而不是原本的四倍。

Barding Stitches.name: Barding Stitches（Barding Stitches）
Barding Stitches.description:
Source PPZO9410

  價格 50 gp; 重量 1 磅

  This thin, specially treated wire can be used to attach barding to creatures whose body types cannot normally accommodate armor, such as piscine, serpentine, and verminous animals, by delicately and thoroughly sewing the equipment directly to the creature's flesh. Equipping a creature with barding using barding stitches takes 10 times as long as normal barding, and a successful DC 25 Heal check is required to attach or remove the stitches. The creature must be helpless or willing to be equipped with barding stitches, and must have at least a +1 natural armor bonus to AC. An armored creature with barding stitches takes a -2 penalty on Strength– and Dexterity-based skill checks (in addition to any penalties from the barding itself), Fortitude and Reflex saves, and saves against effects with the pain descriptor (these penalties stack). These penalties persist for as long as the creature is equipped with barding stitches.

Barding, Hellknight.name: Barding, Hellknight（Barding, Hellknight）
Barding, Hellknight.description:
價格 varies; 重量 varies

  Hellknights often equip their steeds with armor similar to their own. Typical barding for Hellknight steeds features ornamental spikes (these spikes deal no damage). Such barding is usually designed to look similar to the armor of the horse's rider, or to look skeletal, fiendish, or similar to a nightmare. Hellknight barding can be made from Hellknight leather, Hellknight half-plate, or Hellknight plate; it costs four times as much and weighs twice as much. Hellknight half-plate barding or Hellknight plate barding slows a mount's speed from 40 feet to 30 feet, from 50 feet to 35 feet, or from 60 feet to 40 feet. A mount wearing such armor moves at only triple its normal speed when running instead of quadruple.

Barding, Thorny Breastplate.name: Barding, Thorny Breastplate（Barding, Thorny Breastplate）
Barding, Thorny Breastplate.description:
Source PCh:DDR

  This barding is covered in thick metal spikes and is designed to protect the owlbear's chest, shoulders, and neck, while leaving the limbs mostly free for moving and attacking. It provides a +5 armor bonus to AC, reduces the owlbear's speed to 20 feet, and adds +1d8 piercing damage to its grapple attacks.

Barrel.name: 木桶（Barrel）
Barrel.description:
Source PZO1110

  這是一個用金屬條捆紮的堅固木桶，配有一個緊密的蓋子。可以容納10立方尺或650磅重的物體。大概能容納75加侖的液體。

  重量: 30 磅; 容積: 10 立方尺/650 磅

Basket.name: 籃子（Basket）
Basket.description:
Source PZO1110

  這種大籃子配有一個蓋子，能容納約2立方英尺或20磅重的物品。

  重量: 1 磅; 容積: 2 立方尺/20 磅

Bathtub, Collapsible.name: 便攜式浴缸（Bathtub, Collapsible）
Bathtub, Collapsible.description:
Bathtub, Collapsible

  價格 15 gp; 重量 20 磅

  經過10分鐘的組裝後，這些木板可以組合成一個可供防水油布搭立的圓柱形框架。它可以讓一箇中型生物在其中舒適的沐浴，而不必擔心來自湖泊、河流或其他水體的威脅。

Beast Lure.name: Beast Lure（Beast Lure）
Beast Lure.description:
Source PZO9410

  This light brown oil works similar to wild animal musk but attracts one specific kind of creature (dogs, giant bees, and so on).

  Create: Craft (alchemy) DC 20

Beast Scent.name: Beast Scent（Beast Scent）
Beast Scent.description:
Source PZO9211

  This is a mixture of scent gland extracts and aromatic herbs that serves as both attractor and olfactory camouflage. It masks the natural scent of a creature with an appealing if pungent musk that is alluring to most animals. Beast-scent provides a +2 circumstance bonus to Handle Animal and wild empathy checks and a -5 penalty to attempts to track the wearer by his original scent. If the tracking creature is following the smell of beast-scent itself, track checks are made at a +10 circumstance bonus instead. A single vial of beast-scent masks the scent of one Medium creature or two smaller creatures; larger creatures require proportionally more to gain the item's benefits. Beast-scent is rendered inert after 1 hour of exposure to air. Applying a vial is a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

  Create: Craft (alchemy) DC 25

Bedroll.name: 鋪蓋卷（Bedroll）
Bedroll.description: 為了便於睡覺，組成睡袋的兩床羊毛毯除了底部和一側之外都縫在了一起。有些睡袋開放的一側有繫帶，當你在裡面睡覺的時候可以將其系起來。睡袋可以捲起並綁成一個圓柱以方便存放和運輸。大多數人將毛毯和睡袋一起使用以保持溫暖，或僅作為地墊使用。

Belladonna.name: Belladonna（Belladonna）
Belladonna.description:
Source PZO9410

  Also known as deadly nightshade, this plant, with its distinctive greenish-purple leaves and dull black berries, has served as a cosmetic and medicine for longer than memory despite its toxicity. It can also induce vivid but usually unpleasant hallucinations, particularly ones dealing with flight. Herbalists and others trained to use it safely believe it has numerous applications, including pain relief.

Bellows.name: 鼓風機（Bellows）
Bellows.description:
價格：1GP；重量：3磅

  手動鼓風機可以用來有效的將火燒旺，在維持火堆燃燒的生存技能檢定上獲得+1環境加值。

Belt of Giant Strength +2.name: +2巨力腰帶（Belt of Giant Strength +2）
Belt of Giant Strength +2.description: 這是一條寬腰帶，以厚重皮革製成，並鑲嵌鐵飾。穿戴者的力量值有+2、+4或+6增強加值。在剛穿戴的24小時內，此加值視為臨時加值。

Belt of Giant Strength +4.name: +4巨力腰帶（Belt of Giant Strength +4）
Belt of Giant Strength +4.description: 這是一條寬腰帶，以厚重皮革製成，並鑲嵌鐵飾。穿戴者的力量值有+2、+4或+6增強加值。在剛穿戴的24小時內，此加值視為臨時加值。

Belt of Giant Strength +6.name: +6巨力腰帶（Belt of Giant Strength +6）
Belt of Giant Strength +6.description: 這是一條寬腰帶，以厚重皮革製成，並鑲嵌鐵飾。穿戴者的力量值有+2、+4或+6增強加值。在剛穿戴的24小時內，此加值視為臨時加值。

Belt of Incredible Dexterity +2.name: +2敏捷腰帶（Belt of Incredible Dexterity +2）
Belt of Incredible Dexterity +2.description: 這條腰帶有著銀製的帶扣，通常描繪著猛虎的形象。穿戴者的敏捷值有+2、+4或+6增強加值。在剛穿戴的24小時內，此加值視為臨時加值。

Belt of Incredible Dexterity +4.name: +4敏捷腰帶（Belt of Incredible Dexterity +4）
Belt of Incredible Dexterity +4.description: 這條腰帶有著銀製的帶扣，通常描繪著猛虎的形象。穿戴者的敏捷值有+2、+4或+6增強加值。在剛穿戴的24小時內，此加值視為臨時加值。

Belt of Incredible Dexterity +6.name: +6敏捷腰帶（Belt of Incredible Dexterity +6）
Belt of Incredible Dexterity +6.description: 這條腰帶有著銀製的帶扣，通常描繪著猛虎的形象。穿戴者的敏捷值有+2、+4或+6增強加值。在剛穿戴的24小時內，此加值視為臨時加值。

Belt of Mighty Constitution +2.name: +2健體腰帶（Belt of Mighty Constitution +2）
Belt of Mighty Constitution +2.description: 這條腰帶的黃金帶扣上有著熊的形象。穿戴者的體質值有+2、+4或+6增強加值。在剛穿戴的24小時內，此加值視為臨時加值。

Belt of Mighty Constitution +4.name: +4健體腰帶（Belt of Mighty Constitution +4）
Belt of Mighty Constitution +4.description: 這條腰帶的黃金帶扣上有著熊的形象。穿戴者的體質值有+2、+4或+6增強加值。在剛穿戴的24小時內，此加值視為臨時加值。

Belt of Mighty Constitution +6.name: +6健體腰帶（Belt of Mighty Constitution +6）
Belt of Mighty Constitution +6.description: 這條腰帶的黃金帶扣上有著熊的形象。穿戴者的體質值有+2、+4或+6增強加值。在剛穿戴的24小時內，此加值視為臨時加值。

Bit And Bridle.name: 嚼子和韁繩（Bit and Bridle）
Bit And Bridle.description:
價格：2gp；重量：1磅

  騎手控制坐騎時要使用這樣的挽具。大多數定居點可以輕鬆購買到馬、矮種馬和騎乘用犬所使用的嚼子和韁繩，而對於任何可以作為坐騎的生物來說，都可以定製與其相應的嚼子和韁繩。

Black Amaranth.name: Black Amaranth（Black Amaranth）
Black Amaranth.description:
Source PZO1140

  價格 100 gp

  Black amaranth grows in small clusters from the remains of the dead.

  Gather DC 18; Yield 1 dose

  Terrain temperate or warm forests or plains

  Preparation The amaranth's flowers and stalks must be carefully ground into paste. This requires a successful DC 12 Craft (alchemy) check and 1 hour of work.

  Use A dose of black amaranth paste can be applied to a dead body to slow decay. One dose used on a Tiny or smaller creature delays the onset of decay for 3 days (as per gentle repose). Two doses are needed for Small creatures, 3 for Medium creatures, 6 for Large creatures, 12 for Huge creatures, 24 for Gargantuan creatures, and 48 for Colossal creatures. Each dose applied requires a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

Black Cumin.name: Black Cumin（Black Cumin）
Black Cumin.description:
Source Adventurer's Guide pg. 14
價格 15 gp Black cumin, 20 gp Flaming sumac, 30 gp Golden cardamom, 100 gp Striped nutmeg, 15 gp Sunrise cinnamon, 25 gp Tiger cloves, 5 gp Violet salt; 重量 — Black cumin, — Flaming sumac, — Golden cardamom, — Striped nutmeg, — Sunrise cinnamon, — Tiger cloves, — Violet salt

描述

  Food spoils more quickly in hot climates, and Qadirans have become experts at using the spices that they trade to help preserve their meals. After importing plants from across the planes, Qadiran druids and alchemists bred and magically adapted unique species with enhanced medicinal properties. Al-Zabriti tribes generally have supplies of the following spices on hand. To gain the benefits of these spices, a character must consume multiple doses over 1 or more days, as indicated for each spice. Once the benefit is gained, continued consumption at that rate maintains the benefit.

Black Cumin: Cumin is a nutty seasoning used in savory foods. If eaten twice per day for a week, it grants those who consume it a +1 alchemical bonus on Fortitude saves to resist disease for the following 24 hours. An ounce of black cumin sells for 15 gp and seasons 14 meals.

Flaming Sumac: A tart spice, sumac allows a character who contracts a natural disease with multiple effects to suffer one fewer effect (determined randomly) each time he fails a saving throw to resist that disease’s effects. An individual must consume flaming sumac twice per day for at least 3 days to gain its effects, which last for 24 hours after the last dose is consumed. An ounce of flaming sumac sells for 20 gp and seasons six meals.

Golden Cardamom: This fragrant, sweet powder is made from ground cardamom seeds and is often used as a perfume and tooth cleaner, as well as a seasoning in rice dishes and desserts. When a character takes ability damage from a disease, the actual damage taken is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0). Golden cardamom has no effect on ability drain or other effects caused by disease. It must be eaten once per day for 9 days to build up sufficiently within an individual’s body to provide this effect. An ounce of golden cardamom seeds sells for 30 gp and seasons nine meals.

Striped Nutmeg: Used for both desserts and meats, nutmeg halves any ability damage (but not ability drain) resulting from non-supernatural disease, to a minimum damage of 1. It must be eaten three times per day for at least 4 days to provide this effect. An ounce of ground striped nutmeg sells for 100 gp and seasons 12 meals.

Sunrise Cinnamon: A warming spice, sunrise cinnamon is used for seasoning both sweet and savory foods. It promotes sweating, and a character who ingests it twice per day for 5 days gains a +4 alchemical bonus on Fortitude saves made to resist the effects of hot environments. An ounce of ground sunrise cinnamon sells for 15 gp and seasons 10 meals.

Tiger Cloves: Cloves are used in both sweet and savory foods, brewed into teas, and chewed as a breath freshener. When chewed for 1 minute, a dose of tiger cloves removes nauseated or sickened conditions caused by disease or poison effects. When used to season a meal, a dose of tiger cloves grants a +2 alchemical bonus on saving throws to resist the nauseated or sickened conditions for 24 hours after the meal is eaten. A single dose of tiger cloves sells for 25 gp and seasons one meal.

Violet Salt: Salt is of vital importance for retaining a body’s water. If a dose of Qadiran violet salt is consumed as part of a meal, it grants a +4 alchemical bonus on Constitution checks to resist the effects of ongoing thirst for the next 24 hours. A dose of violet salt sells for 5 gp and seasons one meal.

Black Fester.name: Black Fester（Black Fester）
Black Fester.description:
Source PZO1121

  This black paste is often applied on orc weapons before going on raids to stymie an enemy's healing magic. Like a poison, black fester stays on a weapon until the first time it strikes an opponent. It remains in the target's body for 1 hour. A creature exposed to black fester resists magical healing; a creature trying to magically heal the target must make a DC 10 caster level check to restore any hit points to the target.

Black powder (Keg).name: Black powder (Keg)（Black powder (Keg)）
Black powder (Keg).description:
Source Ultimate Combat pg. 141, Inner Sea World Guide pg. 292
價格 10 gp Black powder (dose), 1,000 gp Black powder (keg); 重量 — Black powder (dose), 5 磅 Black powder (keg)

描述

  Black powder is the key explosive component within a firearm that enables it to function, but in larger amounts this alchemical material can be quite destructive on its own as well. A single dose of black powder is enough to power a single shot from most one-handed and two-handed firearms, while 10 doses are required to fire a cannon. Black powder is often stored and transported in kegs (which hold 100 doses), but in this quantity the powder itself becomes dangerous. Exposure to fire, electricity, or a misfire explosion causes black powder to explode—a single keg that explodes in this manner deals 5d6 points of fire damage to anyone within a 20-foot burst (DC 15 Reflex half). Storing black powder in a powder horn protects the powder from explosion.

Bladeguard.name: Bladeguard（Bladeguard）
Bladeguard.description:
Source PZO1115

  This clear resin protects a weapon from harmful attacks from oozes, rust monsters, and similar effects that corrode or melt weapons, rendering the weapon immune for 24 hours. One pot can coat one two-handed weapon, two one-handed or light weapons, or 50 ammunition items. Applying it takes 1 full round. Immersing the weapon in water or similar liquid washes it off.

  Create: Craft (alchemy) DC 15

Alchemical Power Component

Source PZO9410

  Weapons and armor aren't the only things bladeguard protects.

  • Wall of Iron (M): For each pot of bladeguard used as a power component, you may designate one 10-foot square of iron wall that has acid resistance 10 and immunity to rusting attacks.

Blanket.name: 毛毯（Blanket）
Blanket.description:
Blanket

Source PZO1115

  價格 5 sp; 重量 3 磅

  這張溫暖、針織的毛毯有一條繫帶，因此可以方便的捲起來並繫好。毛毯經常與睡袋一起使用以提供額外的保暖或當作墊子使用。

  冬毯 這張毛皮毯子夠一個人蓋。 Source PZO1110

Blightburn Paste.name: Blightburn Paste（Blightburn Paste）
Blightburn Paste.description:
Source PZO9432

  This heavy stone box measures 2 feet to a side, and the tiny compartment inside is lined with lead. Inside the compartment is a half-ounce of deep green paste. This paste is made of animal fat mixed with ground-up blightburn. Once the box is opened, blightburn paste limits teleportation within 60 feet and irradiates anyone within 60 feet, afflicting them with blightburn sickness (see sidebar for details on both effects). Any creature that touches the paste is afflicted with blightburn sickness (no save), and takes 2d6 points of fire damage per round until the paste is cleaned away with a successful DC 15 Heal check.

  Create: Craft (alchemy) DC 30

  Blightburn: The mineral blightburn is a green-glowing crystal and burns anyone who touches it, dealing 2d6 points of fire damage per round of contact, and its radiation causes blightburn sickness.

  The substance also limits teleportation. Anyone casting a teleportation spell in or teleporting to a cavern with blightburn in its walls must succeed at a DC 30 caster level check.

Block And Tackle.name: 滑輪組（Block And Tackle）
Block And Tackle.description:
價格 5 gp; 重量 5 磅

  無論是用來將寶藏從坑裡拉起還是搬運設備，當一個簡單的滑輪組被妥善的固定住時，它就可以為提起重物的力量檢定提供+5的環境加值。固定滑輪組需要1分鐘。

Bloodblock.name: 止血劑（Bloodblock）
Bloodblock.description:
價格：25GP重量：-

  這種粘稠的粉紅色物質可以幫助傷口快速止血，使用它可以在急救，處理鐵蒺藜或治療致命傷害的醫療技能檢定上提供+5鍊金加值。使用一劑止血劑相當於通過一個DC15的醫療檢定來停止流血效果，如果是用來治療致命傷害，使用一劑止血劑相當於你在治療時使用了醫療包（Kit, Healer's）。

Bloody Mandrake.name: Bloody Mandrake（Bloody Mandrake）
Bloody Mandrake.description:
Source PZO1140

  價格 15 gp

  Bloody mandrakes grow from the corpses of intelligent creatures who had supernatural powers in life. This plant's unsettlingly humanoid-shaped tuber-like roots increase fertility and vitality. Gather DC 20; Yield 1d4 doses

  Terrain any plains or swamps

  Preparation A bloody mandrake must be pulped so that its sticky red sap can be gathered, skimmed, and then refined into an even stickier paste; this process requires a successful DC 15 Craft (alchemy) check and 1d4 hours of work per yield.

  Use One dose of bloody mandrake paste smeared on the lips (this is a free action) during spellcasting can be used as an additional material component when casting spells that remove afflictions and conditions or that provide a morale bonus. Doing so grants a +1 bonus to the spell's effective caster level.

Blue Book.name: 藍皮書（Blue Book）
Blue Book.description: 藍皮書 這本書詳細介紹了一個主要城市中的灰色娛樂場所。包含了城市中妓院、脫衣舞酒吧以及賭廳的名字。仔細閱讀此書1小時，在接下來的24小時內你在該城市裡為了收集訊息而進行的知識（本地）、威嚇及交涉檢定都可以獲得+2環境加值。如果你的GM允許，你在該城市周邊進行同樣的檢定也可以獲得+1的加值。 價格 5 gp; 重量 1 磅

Board Game.name: 棋盤遊戲（Board game）
Board Game.description:
價格：1sp - 10gp；重量：2磅

  棋盤遊戲的種類和變化可謂數不勝數。其中名為圍棋（Siege）的策略遊戲，規則是玩家嘗試圍攻其他人的地盤，在老年人中廣受歡迎，不過酒館裡的人們則比較喜歡局勢更為撲朔迷離的遊戲，比如飛龍之賽（Wyvern's Race）和雙面（Doppel）。

  譯註：Siege是中世紀的一種棋類遊戲，一方扮演被圍攻的城堡裡的國王和衛士，一邊圍攻，具體譯名不清楚就……借用圍棋的名號了。後面提到的兩種棋也不知道是啥。就隨便譯了。求博學者們提供正確的解釋。

Bodybalm.name: Bodybalm（Bodybalm）
Bodybalm.description:
Source PZO9410

  When this pungent yellow powder is boiled in water and given to a creature to drink, it provides the attending healer a +5 alchemical bonus on Heal checks for providing long-term care, treating poison, and treating disease.

  Create: Craft (alchemy) DC 25

Boline.name: Boline（Boline）
Boline.description:
Source: PZO9481

  價格 10 gp; 重量 2 磅

  Bolines are hook-shaped knives commonly used by herbalists and spellcasters to harvest ingredients for their craft. A boline's blade is typically 5 inches long, and is too small and irregular to use as a weapon. You can use a boline to finely slice the herbs in a healer's kit, so you can treat deadly wounds with only a single use from a healer's kit rather than two uses.

Bomb Launcher.name: Bomb Launcher（Bomb Launcher）
Bomb Launcher.description:
Source PZO1121

  These odd looking, egg-shaped contraptions have cleverly placed fins that improve bombs' accuracy. Goblin alchemists use these special containers to make their bombs more accurate when thrown long distances. Using a bomb launcher when throwing a bomb increases the bomb's range increment to 30 feet (or increases the range increment of a bomb with the rocket bomb discovery to 70 feet). Bomb launchers are destroyed when used.

Bombchucker.name: Bombchucker（Bombchucker）
Bombchucker.description:
Source: PRG:MC

  價格 12 gp; 重量 1 磅
Category Tools

  This curved wicker basket is worn like a glove over one hand. The basket extends approximately 2 feet in a steady curve, allowing you to launch a thrown splash weapon at incredible speeds and over long distances. Using a bombchucker increases the range increment of any thrown splash weapon by 10 feet. Loading a bombchucker requires a free hand, as the hand wielding the bombchucker can't be used for any other purpose. A bombchucker doesn't get in the way of preparing and throwing a bomb created with the bomb class feature.

Bone Reed.name: Bone Reed（Bone Reed）
Bone Reed.description:
Source PZO1140

  價格 75 gp

  This aquatic grass resembles translucent white horsetail.

  Gather DC 24; Yield 1 dose

  Terrain any swamps

  Preparation A bone reed must be pressed and dried. This process requires a successful DC 10 Craft (alchemy) check and takes 8 hours to complete.

  Use A creature that sleeps for at least 8 hours in 1 day with a bone reed bound to one of its arms or legs heals double the normal ability damage and hit point damage (or triple with full bed rest). A bone reed loses its effectiveness after use. Binding a bone reed to a limb requires 1 minute of work.

Book Of Letters.name: 信件大全（Book Of Letters）
Book Of Letters.description: 信件大全 該大全包含了官方信件的範本，除此之外還有地址的正確格式、禮儀，以及措辭的變化。官僚、外交官和辦事員常常使用它。但它同樣可以用來偽造官方信件。它為與城市官方人員交流的交涉檢定提供了+2的環境加值，併為偽造時的語言學鑑定提供了+2的環境加值。信件大全只在一個特定的區域是準確的，例如一個國家甚至是一個小鎮，並且只能為該地區的相關檢定提供加值。 價格 50 gp; 重量 3 磅

Book Of Puzzles.name: 謎語書（Book of Puzzles）
Book Of Puzzles.description:
價格：50gp；重量：1磅

  每本書都刊載這10個能夠考驗意志並促進智力的謎題。解開單個謎題需要至少1小時的時間而且成功通過DC10的智力檢定，不過檢定結果每比DC高出5點，解謎所需要的時間就會縮短10分鐘（解謎最低需要10分鐘）。一旦解開一道謎題，在接下來的24小時內你能夠選擇單次解除裝置、知識或察言觀色技能檢定，使這次檢定能夠投擲兩次並取較高的結果。一旦謎語書裡的謎題都被解開，那麼這本書便沒用了，不過你還能夠購買其他內容不同的謎語書。

Book Of War Prayers.name: 戰前禱詞集（Book of War Prayers）
Book Of War Prayers.description:
價格：50gp；重量：0.5磅

  這本皮邊兒小冊子裡的書頁都是上好的牛皮紙，書裡記載了許多戰前祈禱文。若你的魅力為13或更高、或者至少在表演（演說）上投入了至少1點技能點的話，那麼你能夠在戰鬥之間高聲念出書中的祈禱詞以鼓舞他人。為了產生此效果而閱讀祈禱文需要10分鐘時間。聽到你的祈禱詞的人會在下次嘗試對抗恐懼（fear）時，豁免檢定獲得+2士氣加值，不過這次豁免檢定要在接下來的24小時內作出。

Book, Dungeon Guide.name: Book, Dungeon Guide（Book, Dungeon Guide）
Book, Dungeon Guide.description:
While mundane and magical research are paramount to the planning stages of any expedition, the ultimate prize in dungeon research is undoubtedly a dungeon guide. Each of these valuable books is about a different dungeon of either wide-spread or local fame, and contains all manner of convoluted hints and ideas about its supposed locale-sometimes even maps. A dungeoneering group in possession of such a rare and unusual boon has a much better chance of seeing the light of day once again after its expedition.

  Vast dungeons, megalithic towers, and submerged tombs are the focus of generations of scholarship and research. Any number of books have been written about these forsaken places-most, it must be said, scribed by sages who haven't been within a hundred miles of the sites in question. After all, few adventurers have the time or inclination to write scholarly tomes about their experiences, so it falls to researchers and chroniclers to piece together dungeon guides. To do so, they draw on books of lore and accounts of dungeons before the sites became the abodes of monsters, scour the diaries and reminiscences of retired adventurers, consult extraplanar intelligences, and fill in the gaps with wild guesswork.

  Dungeon guides vary in their reliability. Some read like tour guides of famous dungeons, dwelling on gory tales of monsters and exaggerated claims about treasure. Others are obsessive collections of picayune details, with hundreds of pages on honored animal cremation rituals or gnome pottery. Truly reliable guides are extremely rare, and some dungeon guides have become legends in their own right.

  A dungeon guide serves two functions. First, adventurers can consult it to obtain information regarding specific areas of the dungeon. Second, a dungeon guide can provide its reader bonuses on up to three skill checks. Anyone can consult the guide for information on the dungeon, but only readers who possess ranks in the skill associated with the text can benefit from the guide's skill bonuses.

Boots.name: Boots（Boots）
Boots.description:
Type 價格 重量 Source
Fire-resistant 2 gp 2 磅 PZO1123
Softpaw 50 gp 4 磅 PZO1121
Stiletto 5 gp 1 磅 PPZO94102
Wading 50 gp 2 磅 PZO1140

  Boots, Fire-Resistant These heavy leather boots contain a layer of brick dust that protects your feet from heat. You gain fire resistance 2 against fire attacks directed at or under your feet, such as walking across hot coals. Repeat or prolonged exposure to fire damage eventually burns the outer leather of the boots, ruining them (typically after about 1d10+20 rounds of exposure).

  Boots, Softpaw These soft and subtle boots are constructed of silk and specially cured leather. They are specially designed for catfolk feet. They work with the feline structure of the race's feet to soften footfalls and to reduce the imprints of their tracks. While wearing softpaw boots, a catfolk gains a +1 circumstance bonus on Stealth checks. Furthermore, the DC to notice or follow the tracks of a catfolk wearing softpaw boots increases by +2. Source PZO1121

  Boots, Stiletto The most ostentatious and impractical of footwear, the tall heel attached to these boots adds several inches to your height. This type of boot is popular among nobles, though the trend has recently caught on among some members of noble courts. You can use the heel of a stiletto boot as an improvised weapon, dealing damage as a punching dagger. Source PPZO94102

  Boots, Wading These waterproof boots are felt lined and have a thin layer of metal around the soles. The top of each boot ends just before the knee, with a cord for tying the top shut over clothing or exposed skin. These boots assist in prolonged hikes through deep mud or shallow pools, granting the wearer a +1 circumstance bonus on Profession (fisher) checks while fishing in shallow water. Source PZO1140

Bottle.name: 玻璃瓶（Bottle）
Bottle.description:
價格 2 gp; 重量 1 磅

  這種玻璃瓶的容量大概有1品脫，配有一個軟木塞。

Bottle, Glass.name: Bottle, Glass（Bottle, Glass）
Bottle, Glass.description:
Source PZO1110

  A glass bottle holds 1/2 品脫 and weighs 1.5 磅 when full.

  重量: -; 容積: 1/2 品脫 / 1/5 磅

Box, Scroll.name: 卷軸匣（Box, Scroll）
Box, Scroll.description:
價格 5 gp; 重量 1 磅

  這種木製的匣子可輕鬆容納10個卷軸以及一些方便索引的小夾或書籤。從持握的卷軸匣內取出卷軸是一個移動動作。一個卷軸匣有5點生命值，硬度5，擊破DC20。卷軸匣是不漏水的。

Bread.name: 麵包（Bread）
Bread.description:
價格：2CP；重量：1/2磅

  一條麵包，根據烤制的程度可以是硬皮或者軟皮的——也取決與當地麵包師傅的傳統和使用的原料。麵包還可以分成發酵或者無酵的，由在揉麵時是否加入酵母發麵決定。無酵的麵包也叫無酵餅，薄的無酵和餅乾差不多，厚的則可以達到一寸。無酵或者發酵的麵包裡還可以加進橄欖、奶酪、水果或者肉，以及其他填餡——特別是為節日準備的麵包。大部分麵包只需要一天就會被風乾變硬。

Brewed Reek.name: Brewed Reek（Brewed Reek）
Brewed Reek.description:
Source PZO1121

  Animal musk, spoiled meat, pungent plants, and any other foul-smelling substances on hand go into a batch of brewed reek. When boiled, this mixture becomes a thick alchemical slime that adheres to anything it touches. You can hurl brewed reek as a splash weapon with a range increment of 10 feet. A creature struck with a direct hit must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or be sickened for 2d6 rounds. If the target fails its save, it must make a second Fortitude save or be nauseated for 1 round. Creatures in the splash area must make a Fortitude save or be sickened for 1 round. A creature that drinks brewed reek does not get a saving throw and is sickened for 2d6 rounds and nauseated for 1 round.

  Create: Craft (alchemy) DC 25

Bridge, Portable.name: 便攜式橋樑（Bridge, Portable）
Bridge, Portable.description:
價格 200 gp; 重量 60 磅

  當用8個巖釘（每邊個4個）支撐起來時，這種由繩索和木板條組成的橋最多可支撐1500磅的重量，並跨過30英尺的距離。它可以捲成一個掛在背後或由駝獸揹負的包裹。說服動物跨越便攜式橋需要來（come）或跟隨（heel）的訓練。

Brimstone/Sulfur.name: Brimstone/Sulfur（Brimstone/Sulfur）
Brimstone/Sulfur.description:
Source PZO9445

  價格 5 sp; 重量 -

  Brimstone, also called sulfur, has a distinctive odor and caustic properties.

Alchemical Power Component

  Doses 2 (1 gp); Spells acid descriptor

  Spells with the [acid] descriptor deal +1 acid damage.

Brooch.name: 胸針（Brooch）
Brooch.description:
價格：可變；重量：—

  這件小飾品可以用於放置在合適的位置別住某些服飾，比如披風或斗篷。許多組織會提供特殊的胸針，用於作為組織成員的標誌或者達成特殊榮譽的象徵。

Brush, Dandy.name: Brush, Dandy（Brush, Dandy）
Brush, Dandy.description:
Source PPZO9410

  價格 2 sp; 重量 2 磅

  This hard-bristled tool has a handle that slips over the wearer's hand, and is used by animal breeders, owners, and grooms to brush the animals in their care, loosening dirt and detritus from the creatures' coats and stimulating the skin so it produces the natural oils that keep them healthy and clean.

Brush, Mastodon.name: Brush, Mastodon（Brush, Mastodon）
Brush, Mastodon.description:
Source PPZO9410

  價格 20 gp; 重量 5 磅

  Tribespeople in lands where megafauna and other large mammals are an important source of food and transportation craft these large, two-handed grooming tools to keep their enormous mounts and pack animals healthy and clean.

Bucket.name: 水桶（Bucket）
Bucket.description:
Source PZO1110

  一個典型的桶有一個繩制提手，可以容納1-2加侖的液體。

  重量: 2 磅; 容積: 1 立方尺/65 磅

Bufo.name: 蛙酒（Bufo）
Bufo.description:
價格：1GP；重量：2磅

  這是一種被地精族、沼蜍人和其他原始類人生物所鍾愛的酒。製法是將毒性的蟾蜍、蛙類（或者卵）浸在淡啤酒裡，或者將它們擠出的毒汁摻進酒裡（這樣就可以反覆利用了）。有些部落會乾脆將死掉的動物在盛酒的敞口杯裡泡酥，等喝完酒再吃掉。如果一個生物喝下蛙酒，它會目眩而非普通的醉酒。

Buoy.name: 浮標（Buoy）
Buoy.description:
Type 價格 重量
普通 5 gp 16 磅
Superior 10 gp 30 磅

  浮標用來標記湖泊、河流或類似的水體中某個特殊的地點，從而讓你能夠在稍後的日期裡返回該地點。

  一個常見的浮標包括了一個漂浮物（通常是一個充滿氣的氣囊或者一個密封的葫蘆），一段200英尺長的麻繩，以及一個作為錨的15磅重的石頭。漂浮物通常有被繪以鮮豔的顏色，並且還有一個容易吸引注意力的標記。雖然錨定的浮標足以應對普通的天氣和潮汐，但智慧生物想要破壞它們還是輕而易舉的。

  高級浮標有一個球形或卵形、中空的漂浮物（通常由銅製成），用鐵鏈取代了普通的麻繩，並用金屬錨取代了普通的重物。

Buoyant Balloon.name: 浮球（Buoyant Balloon）
Buoyant Balloon.description:
價格：10GP重量：1磅

  這個拳頭大小，經過鍊金術處理的動物氣泡在接口處聯結著一根空心木棍，把木棍拗斷的話，木棍中間的一小節玻璃管破裂，在氣泡中施放出輕與空氣的鍊金氣體，把氣泡充氣到直徑3尺大小。為氣泡充氣需要一個移動動作。氣球可以吊起最多20磅物品，但是如果裝載的物品多於10磅，那麼它每輪就只能移動30尺距離。如果同時使用多個氣球，那麼它們可以懸吊的物體重量：可累加起來計算。不過，如果氣球沒有被以某種方式固定的話，它就會一直上升，直到在600尺左右的高度因為壓力而爆炸。

Cage.name: 籠子（Cage）
Cage.description:
價格：可變；重量：可變

  這 種牢固、輕便的圍欄的用處是關住生物——通常是動物，不過只要籠子夠大，就可以關住任何東西。籠子通常使用鐵、木頭或者竹子直腸，不過這會根據各地的習慣和可以找到的材料而有所改變。一個籠子能夠關住一隻體型相應的動物、或者五隻體型小一級的動物。動物的重量：會加在籠子之上。籠子通常會有下面幾種規格：微型（Diminutive）或超微型（Fine）、超小型（Tiny）、小型（Small）、中型（Medium）、大型（Large）和超大型 （Huge）。對於為水生動物準備的籠子來說，價格：是普通籠子的兩倍，並且在灌滿水之後重量：變為正常的四倍。

Cage (Diminutive or fine).name: Cage (Diminutive or fine)（Cage (Diminutive or fine)）
Cage (Diminutive or fine).description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 81, Adventurer's Armory pg. 19, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 185
價格 10 gp (Diminutive or Fine), 60 gp (Huge), 30 gp (Large), 15 gp (Small or Medium), 2 gp (Tiny); 重量 2 磅 (Diminutive or Fine), 960 磅 (Huge), 240 磅 (Large), 60 磅 (Small or Medium), 5 磅 (Tiny)

描述

  This secure, portable enclosure is used to hold creatures— generally animals, but a large enough cage can hold anything. Cages are made from iron, wood, or bamboo, depending on local customs and available materials. One cage holds one animal of that size, or five animals of a smaller size. The weight of the creature adds to the weight of the cage. Cages come in the following sizes: Diminutive or Fine, Tiny, Small, Medium, Large, and Huge. Cages for aquatic creatures cost twice as much, and weigh four times the normal weight when filled with water.

Cage (Huge).description:
