Caltrops.name: 鐵蒺藜（Caltrops）
Caltrops.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 56, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
價格 1 gp; 重量 2 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  鐵蒺藜是有四個尖端的鐵釘，因為設計的關係，不管你如何將它們散落，始終有一個尖角向上。你可以將它們散落在地上，以企望讓敵人踩在上面，或至少來減慢你的敵人行進的速度。一袋2磅重的鐵蒺藜可以覆蓋5尺見方的區域。

每次當一個生物進入被鐵蒺藜覆蓋的區域（或者待在該區域中戰鬥持續一個回合），這個生物就可能會踩上一枚鐵蒺藜。鐵蒺藜對該生物進行攻擊檢定（基本攻擊加值+0）。在這次攻擊中，生物的盔甲，盾牌，偏斜加值將不被計算。如果生物穿了鞋子，或其它類似鞋子的裝備，將會獲得+2的防禦等級加值。如果鐵蒺藜成功的進行了一次攻擊，那麼，生物被判定踩上了鐵蒺藜。鐵蒺藜會造成1點傷害，並且因為目標的腳受傷了，速度將會減半。動速度的減值會持續24小時，直到生物成功的被治療（DC 15的醫療檢定），或至少得到了1點的魔法治療為止。一個衝鋒或者奔跑的人物在踩到鐵蒺藜時，必須立即停下。任何以半速或者更慢的速度行進可以順利的通過鐵蒺藜覆蓋的區域而不受傷害。

鐵蒺藜對某些特殊的敵人不起作用。

Caltrops (Cold Iron).name: Caltrops (Cold Iron)（Caltrops (Cold Iron)）
Caltrops (Cold Iron).description:
Source Demon Hunter's Handbook pg. 18
價格 2 gp; 重量 2 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  Cold iron caltrops function in all ways as ordinary caltrops (Pathfinder RPG Core Rulebook 155) except that they are made of cold iron, and affect creatures with DR/cold iron accordingly.

Caltrops (Vicious).name: Caltrops (Vicious)（Caltrops (Vicious)）
Caltrops (Vicious).description:
Source Goblins of Golarion pg. 12
價格 50 gp; 重量 4 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  These specially modified caltrops have clusters of needle-sharp spines that are slightly longer and more brittle than those on normal caltrops. Like standard caltrops, a 2-pound bag of vicious caltrops covers a 5-foot-square area. Vicious caltrops work just like normal caltrops, save that they have an attack bonus of +4, do 1d2 points of damage, and require a DC 20 Heal check to fully treat.

Candle.name: 蠟燭（Candle）
Candle.description:
Candle

  蠟燭只能照常一小塊區域，使5尺範圍內的光照等級提升一級（黑暗變為昏暗，昏暗變為正常）。蠟燭無法將光照等級提升至正常以上。一根蠟燭可以燃燒1小時。 價格 1 cp; 重量 -

  頭盔蠟燭 這個裝置是個頂端有一根短而細的釘子的頭盔，你可以將蠟燭插在上面，解放你的雙手去完成其他任務。 價格 2 gp; 重量 4 磅

  燭燈 燭燈是一個小的燈籠狀的裝置，有玻璃面板和用來放置蠟燭的凹槽。它保護蠟燭免受氣流和蠟滴的影響。燭燈的光照程度與蠟燭相同，但可以通過關閉面板來使其僅照亮1-3個相鄰的方格。你可以用燭燈來保持雙手的溫暖。 價格 5 gp; 重量 1 磅

  燭臺 這個碟狀的物體有一個平底，一個把手，頂部還有一個尖釘。你可以將蠟燭插到頂端的尖釘（直徑可達3英吋）上，並用手持燭臺。燭臺的平底意味著你可以把它放下來而不用擔心蠟燭翻倒並熄滅。一個典型的燭臺由烘烤的粘土或便宜的金屬（例如銅）製成，但也有精緻複雜而昂貴的燭臺存在。 價格 1 cp; 重量 1/2 磅

Candle lamp.name: 燭燈（Candle lamp）
Candle lamp.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 56
價格 5 gp; 重量 1 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  燭燈是一個小的燈籠狀的裝置，有玻璃面板和用來放置蠟燭的凹槽。它保護蠟燭免受氣流和蠟滴的影響。燭燈的光照程度與蠟燭相同，但可以通過關閉面板來使其僅照亮1-3個相鄰的方格。你可以用燭燈來保持雙手的溫暖。

Candlerod.name: 燭光杖（Candlerod）
Candlerod.description:
價格：1GP重量：1磅

  這是一種和日光杖類似的鍊金工具。點亮以後，燭光杖可以在12小時內放出等同於蠟燭亮度的光芒。

Canteen.name: 餐盒（Canteen）
Canteen.description:
價格 2 gp; 重量 1 磅

  這種中空的容器由木頭、葫蘆或者金屬製成，就像水袋一樣可以成裝液體，但更耐穿刺和切割。

Canvas.name: 帆布（Canvas）
Canvas.description:
價格 1 sp/平方碼; 重量 1 磅

  這種方塊狀的厚重布匹適用於繪畫，在暴雨中遮擋物品，製作帆，或者製作簡易的袋子。帆布並不防水，但經過油、蠟或樹脂的處理之後即可防水。

Cap, Tinker's.name: Cap, Tinker's（Cap, Tinker's）
Cap, Tinker's.description:
Source: PZO9430

  價格 200 gp; 重量 4 磅

  This expertly crafted helmet has several small arms that hold magnifying lenses near the wearer's face. They're kept in place by locking hinges and crude gyroscopes that compensate for normal head movements. While the lenses are properly aligned, the wearer gains a +2 circumstance bonus on Appraise and Craft checks involving items that are small or highly detailed and on sight-based Perception checks when she uses an action to inspect something within 5 feet. However, the arms become misaligned if the wearer falls prone or is grappled, or if the helmet is damaged (hardness 5, 2 hit points). If the arms are misaligned, they lose their usefulness until readjusted (a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity).

Cap, Vigil.name: Cap, Vigil（Cap, Vigil）
Cap, Vigil.description:
Source: PZO9430

  價格 400 gp; 重量 4 磅

  A vigil cap is built like a tinker's cap, but with shades and wide-view mirrors instead of magnifying lenses. The helmet's arms can be adjusted (as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity) into one of the following modes at a given time:

  All-Around Perspective: When properly angled, the mirrors grant the wearer a better view of his surroundings and attacking foes. In this mode, the helmet grants a +2 circumstance bonus on reactive sight-based Perception checks.

  Indirect Observation: Intended to protect against gaze attacks, this mode combines shades positioned to block forward vision with mirrors angled to let the wearer see around him. Any time he would normally have to attempt a saving throw against a gaze attack, there is a 75% chance he doesn't need to attempt the save. Because of the wearer's obscured vision, however, all foes gain partial concealment (10% miss chance) against him.

  Shades: With the mirrors tucked aside, the shades provide a +2 circumstance bonus on saving throws against effects that blind or dazzle.

Cape, Billow.name: Cape, Billow（Cape, Billow）
Cape, Billow.description:
Source PZO1121

  This silk cape is constructed of many carefully arranged overlapping layers that are loosely stitched together. When exposed to a sudden influx of air, like that caused by falling, the cloak unfolds like a crude parachute. When falling, a creature wearing a billow cape is treated as if he had deliberately jumped from the height. When worn in areas of strong wind or greater, a billow cape hampers movement. In such wind conditions, the wearer treats all terrain as difficult terrain and takes a -4 penalty on Fly checks. Because of the strange and somewhat fragile construction of this cape, only Small or smaller billow capes function properly. Larger billow capes take all the penalties resulting from high winds, but grant none of the benefits when the wearer falls.

Cards.name: 紙牌（Cards）
Cards.description:
價格：1sp - 100gp；重量：1磅

  紙牌種類繁多，從使用刻版印刷來在厚紙板上留下複雜的花紋，到向著上過蠟的牛皮紙上繪製圖案的藝術品，還有以象牙、木材甚至是金屬製作的牌。

Case, Map Or Scroll.name: Case, Map Or Scroll（Case, Map Or Scroll）
Case, Map Or Scroll.description:
Source PZO1115

  A bone, leather, or wooden scroll case easily holds four scrolls; you can cram more inside but retrieving any of them becomes a full-round action rather than a move action. You must destroy the scroll case to damage its contents (hardness 2 for leather or 5 for wood, 2 hit points, Break DC 15). A scroll case is not water-tight.

Case, Scroll.name: 卷軸筒（Case, Scroll）
Case, Scroll.description:
價格 1 gp; 重量 1/2 磅

  皮革或木製的卷軸筒可輕鬆容納四張卷軸；你也可以塞入更多，但取出任意卷軸的行動會從一個移動動作變為一個整輪動作。你必須破壞卷軸筒才能破壞裡面的東西（皮革制的硬度2，木質的硬度為5，2點生命值，擊破DC15）。卷軸筒並不防水，因此必須仔細保護起來並遠離風雨。

Cauim.name: 根汁酒（Cauim）
Cauim.description:
價格：1GP；重量：2磅

  這是一種用玉米或者木薯的根莖釀製的啤酒，材料必須在釀酒時充分粉碎。

Caul.name: 發罩（Caul）
Caul.description:
價格：10gp - 100gp；重量：—

  這種華貴的髮網一般使用絲綢、金絲織物或者珠寶製作而成，皇室或貴族中的女性最常佩戴此類飾品。

Cauldron.name: 坩堝（Cauldron）
Cauldron.description:
Type 價格 重量
普通 1 gp 5 磅
秘銀 1,251 gp 2-1/2 磅

  這種鍋是鐵罐的放大版，容量約1加侖——足以製作讓四個飢餓的人填飽肚子的一餐。它同樣也可以用來製作藥水或者類似的工作。秘銀坩堝更加輕便，且食物很少粘在其上。

Censer, Celestial.name: Censer, Celestial（Censer, Celestial）
Censer, Celestial.description:
Source PZO1121

  價格 20 gp; 重量 1/2 磅

  This blessed thurible holds up to 10 pieces of incense, and burns at a rate of 1 stick per hour. If a smokestick is added to the incense in the censer while it burns, creatures with the evil subtype are dazzled for as long as they remain within the area of the resulting smoke.

Censer, Toxic.name: Censer, Toxic（Censer, Toxic）
Censer, Toxic.description:
Source PZO9487E

  價格 115 gp; 重量 1 磅

  This ornately etched censer has a small hidden compartment under the heat source that can hold 1 dose of poison. When in use, the censer's heat source indirectly heats the poison, causing it to mix with the burning incense and allow the poison to permeate the air, filling a 20-foot radius centered on the censer. The poison's type changes to inhaled, and it is effective for 5 minutes before it is entirely burned off.

Chain.name: 鐵鏈（Chain）
Chain.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 56, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
價格 30 gp; 重量 2 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  這條鐵鏈由許多環環相扣的約一寸長的鐵環連接而成，它非常牢固並足以承受很大的重量。鐵鏈的硬度為10，具有5點生命值。破壞它需要通過一個DC26的力量檢定。

Chain Belt.name: Chain Belt（Chain Belt）
Chain Belt.description:
Source: PZO1121

  While undines dress sparingly, they often wear 10-foot-long belts of fine linked chain about their waists. The belts contain hinged links to which the wearer can affix various objects such as tools, small weapons, and other valuables, including links of silver and platinum, or small hammered plates of gold set with gems. If worn properly, the belt can hold up to 30 pounds of small items. A swimming undine can unwrap the belt as swift action if she needs to remove it to decrease her weight load.

Chain, Breakaway.name: 易損鐵鏈（Chain, Breakaway）
Chain, Breakaway.description:
Source: PZO9410

  這種易損鐵鏈看起來就跟普通的鐵鏈一樣（通過一個DC25的察覺檢定可以發現它與普通鐵鏈的不同），但很容易破壞。通過一個DC10的力量檢定就可以瞬間破壞它。

Chair, Folding.name: 摺疊椅（Chair, Folding）
Chair, Folding.description:
Chair, Folding

  價格 2 gp; 重量 10 磅

  這個簡單的摺疊椅有一個木製框架和帆布座椅、靠背，使其易於運輸且方便在任何你想要的地方展開。它摺疊起來很輕鬆，並且可以放進一個方便運輸的袋子裡。摺疊椅可以輕而易舉的支撐250磅重的物體。

Chalk.name: 粉筆（Chalk）
Chalk.description:
Source PZO1110

  價格 1 cp; 重量 -

  這種白色的粗塊狀粉筆可以簡單的在木頭、金屬或者石頭上留下記號。你可以用它書寫約24小時，之後就會被耗盡。粉筆也有其他顏色，但非常罕見而且更加昂貴。

Chalkboard.name: 黑板（Chalkboard）
Chalkboard.description:
Source PZO1115

  價格 1 gp; 重量 2 磅

  黑板由一塊拋光的黑色石頭薄片和圍繞它的木頭框架組成，大致與一本大書的大小相當。用一塊溼布擦拭可以擦除粉筆在上面留下的任何痕跡。

Charcoal.name: Charcoal（Charcoal）
Charcoal.description:
Source SoS

  Sticks of charcoal are useful for marking floors and walls, writing on paper or parchment, and making rubbings of engravings or other markings. In a pinch, they can even be burned to stay warm. A good quality rubbing generally takes 1 minute 一張 of paper.

Cheese.name: 奶酪（Cheese）
Cheese.description:
價格：5GP；重量：1/2磅

  以上的標出是一分切塊的輪狀奶酪的價格：。整輪的乾酪通常重5-10磅，外包有保質的封皮。

Chest.name: Chest（Chest）
Chest.description:
Source PZO1115

  The 普通 wooden chest comes in several sizes, including small (2 cubic feet, 1 hit point, break DC 17), medium (4 cubic feet, 15 hp, break DC 23), large (6 cubic feet, 30 hit points, break DC 29), and huge (8 cubic feet, 50 hit points, break DC 35). Most include a simple inset lock.

  • Small: 重量: 25 磅; 容積: 2 立方尺/200 磅
  • Medium: 重量: 50 磅; 容積: 4 立方尺/? 磅
  • Large: 重量: 75 磅; 容積: 6 立方尺/? 磅
  • Huge: 重量: 100 磅; 容積: 8 立方尺/? 磅

Treasure Chest

Source PPC:PotIS

  A treasure chest begins as a 普通 wooden chest, and is then treated with resin to make the wood water-resistant. Metal bands, usually bronze to prevent rusting, are strapped around the treasure chest for extra reinforcement, and the lock is also made of bronze. A treasure chest uses the same statistics as an ordinary wooden chest of its same size, but its hit points increase by 25% and its break DC increases by 2. Treasure chests stand up better to water travel and to being buried compared to ordinary chests.

Chest, False-Bottomed.name: 暗格箱（Chest, False-Bottomed）
Chest, False-Bottomed.description:
Source PZO9410

  這種箱子常被走私者用來運送違禁品或是那些對他們而言最好保持隱秘的寶藏。箱子的暗格約有1寸深，分為從內部、底部或從背部打開等不同類型。發現暗格需要一個DC20的.察覺檢定。

Clay, Blackfire.name: 火炭泥（Clay, Blackfire）
Clay, Blackfire.description:
價格：20GP重量：10磅

  這種黑乎乎的軟泥摸起來意外的暖和。用一個整輪動作揉它可以讓這泥發出更多的熱，使你在對抗寒冷天氣的豁免檢定上獲得+4鍊金加值。把5團泥揉在一起拚命捏，你可以把它們的熱量聚集在一起，製造出一團可以散發出營火程度熱量的泥團，用來取暖或煮飯都可以。

  火炭泥只會發熱：無光，無味，無煙，清潔環保。只是在發熱1小時後，整團泥就會變成冰涼的硬塊。一份火炭泥可以切成10團。

Clear Ear.name: Clear Ear（Clear Ear）
Clear Ear.description:
Source PZO9410

  This green gel is poured into the user's ear and takes effect 2 hours later, enhancing senses and memory but increasing irritability. For 6 hours, the user gains a +2 alchemical bonus on Perception and Knowledge checks and a -2 penalty on all Charisma-based checks.

Cleats.name: 防滑釘（Cleats）
Cleats.description:
價格：5gp；重量：2磅

  防滑釘可以讓你在光滑表面行走時所受的懲罰降低50%。比如，在冰面上行走時，每移動1格會花費2格的移動力（正常的1格外加作為懲罰的1格），若你裝上了防滑釘，在冰面上每移動1格僅會花費1.5格的移動力。防滑釘會對所有種類的拋光地板造成損傷。防滑釘可以附加到任意一套其他服飾上。

Cloak of Resistance +1.name: +1抗力披風（Cloak of Resistance +1）
Cloak of Resistance +1.description: 銀或鋼的點綴在該織物上到處都是。它給穿戴者提供魔力防護。穿戴者的所有豁免得到+1到+5抗力加值。

Cloak of Resistance +2.name: +2抗力披風（Cloak of Resistance +2）
Cloak of Resistance +2.description: 銀或鋼的點綴在該織物上到處都是。它給穿戴者提供魔力防護。穿戴者的所有豁免得到+1到+5抗力加值。

Cloak of Resistance +3.name: +3抗力披風（Cloak of Resistance +3）
Cloak of Resistance +3.description: 銀或鋼的點綴在該織物上到處都是。它給穿戴者提供魔力防護。穿戴者的所有豁免得到+1到+5抗力加值。

Cloak of Resistance +4.name: +4抗力披風（Cloak of Resistance +4）
Cloak of Resistance +4.description: 銀或鋼的點綴在該織物上到處都是。它給穿戴者提供魔力防護。穿戴者的所有豁免得到+1到+5抗力加值。

Cloak of Resistance +5.name: +5抗力披風（Cloak of Resistance +5）
Cloak of Resistance +5.description: 銀或鋼的點綴在該織物上到處都是。它給穿戴者提供魔力防護。穿戴者的所有豁免得到+1到+5抗力加值。

Cloak, Patchwork.name: 拼接斗篷（cloak, Patchwork）
Cloak, Patchwork.description:
價格：5gp；重量：0.5磅

  這種披風在旅行的吟遊詩人之中廣受歡迎，並且每件拼接斗篷都是獨一無二的。披風上的補丁代表著穿戴者曾經到過何處，詩人們經常靠著這些補丁來回憶自己所記憶的曲目中的特定故事。當一名吟遊詩人臨死或者退休的時候，他通常會將自己的披風傳給年輕的藝人作為獎賞或指導。

Cloak, Reversible.name: 雙面披風（cloak, Reversible）
Cloak, Reversible.description:
價格：2sp - 100gp；重量：1磅

  這件披風有正反兩面，兩面所使用的布料與顏色各不相同。使用這種披風主要是為了追求時尚、在演劇中進行表演、或者作為易容的一部分快速改變裝束。雙面披風的價格：取決於披風的品質，最低端的是簡單的亞麻披風，而高端的則是以皮毛作為邊飾的披風或者絲綢披風。

Cloak, Wing.name: Cloak, Wing（Cloak, Wing）
Cloak, Wing.description:
Source PZO1121

  This strange piece of equipment only works for sylphs and similar creatures, whose light, airy bodies can be borne upon the winds. Looking like a fine silk traveler's cloak, a wing cloak is secretly reinforced with a series of wooden struts that, when locked into place, stretch the cloak's fabric into a rudimentary wing. Arranging the struts into a wing or reversing the change is a move action. When the cloak is shaped into a wing, the wearer can make a DC 15 Fly check to fall safely from any height without taking falling damage, as if using feather fall. When falling, the wearer may make an additional DC 15 Fly check to glide, moving 5 feet laterally for every 20 feet she falls. Readying and using a wing cloak requires two hands and provokes an attack of opportunity. A wing cloak has hardness 0 and 5 hit points. If the wing cloak is broken, the Fly DCs to use it increase by +10.

Cloud Puff.name: Cloud Puff（Cloud Puff）
Cloud Puff.description:
Source PZO1140

  價格 100 gp

  The spores of this odorous pale-gray fungus cause a euphoric light-headedness.

  Gather DC 18; Yield 1 dose

  Terrain any mountains

  Preparation After soaking in salt water for 1 hour, a cloud puff must be dried in a delicate process that requires it to be turned three times per hour for 4 hours. This requires a successful DC 12 Craft (alchemy) check.

  Use By crushing a dried cloud puff and inhaling the spores, a creature becomes light-headed and its mind grows resistant to outside influences. For the next hour, the creature gains a +2 alchemical bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects but takes a -2 penalty on Wisdom-based skill checks.

Coffee.name: 咖啡（Coffee）
Coffee.description:
價格：1CP；重量：1/2磅

  將烘烤碾碎的咖啡豆加水煮滾就成了。只需要喝兩杯咖啡，其提振精神的作用就可以把一個疲乏的生物所受到的減值從－2降為－1。

  煮咖啡需要準備好咖啡（1磅新鮮咖啡豆價值5CP，一磅咖啡粉價值8CP）和煮制用具。可以先用一個壺燒開水再兌進咖啡粉，也可以將咖啡粉煮好後再濾出。通常，喝咖啡的冒險者會隨身攜帶方便咖啡壺（見62頁）。

Coffee Pot.name: 咖啡壺（Coffee Pot）
Coffee Pot.description:
價格 3 gp; 重量 4 磅

  咖啡壺是一個大的，像茶壺一樣的裝置，它有一個用來放咖啡豆的小容器和一個連接著水管，用來盛水的大容器。加熱咖啡壺會讓沸騰的熱水穿過管子進入放咖啡豆的容器內。管子的頂部有一個玻璃的凸起讓你能夠看清煮的過程，並在合適的時間停止。同一時間它可以沖泡4杯咖啡。它也可以用來泡茶，浸泡藥材，或者單純的只是燒開水。

Coffin.name: 棺材（Coffin）
Coffin.description:
Type 價格 重量
普通 10 gp 30 磅
華麗 100 gp 50 磅

  普通的棺材由簡單的木材製成，有一個寬鬆而平的蓋子，以將其釘在棺材上。華麗的棺材因為可以彰顯死者的地位而被貴族所青睞，這種棺材有帶軟布墊的內襯和帶鉸鏈的棺材蓋。

Cold Iron.name: Cold Iron（Cold Iron）
Cold Iron.description:
Source PZO9445

  價格 1 gp; 重量 -

  Cold iron is often used to produce alloyed metals, catalysts, and items that interfere with magic.

Alchemical Power Component

  Doses 5 (5 gp); Spells abjuration school

  Spells of the abjuration school are cast at +1 caster level for the purpose of caster level and dispel checks.

Compass.name: 指南針（Compass）
Compass.description:
Compass

Source PZO1115

  價格 10 gp; 重量 1/2 磅

  普通指南針指示北極，它可以讓你在避免迷路的生存檢定上獲得+2的環境加值。你在地下城中用知識（地下城）進行導覽時也能獲得相同的加值。

Consulting A Guide.name: Consulting A Guide（Consulting A Guide）
Consulting A Guide.description:
A PC may consult a dungeon guide whenever he enters a new room or area of the dungeon to learn more about his current location, similar to how one gains information by making a Knowledge check. Consulting a dungeon guide takes 10 minutes, and a dungeon guide may only be consulted once in a given area. A dungeon guide only makes sense in context, and thus cannot be consulted outside of the relevant dungeon except for the briefest and most general information about the dungeon in question.

  When a PC consults a dungeon guide, the GM makes an accuracy check for the guide by secretly rolling a d20 and adding the guide's accuracy modifier to the roll. The GM then compares the result of the accuracy check to the DC of the information being sought (see the Accuracy Check DCs table). A GM may modify these DCs at her discretion. If the result is equal to or greater than the accuracy check DC, the GM should give the PC a clue or some knowledge about an aspect of the area in question. For example, the book might mention some historical detail of the room's original purpose, how to disarm an obstructive mechanism, where an exit leads, or if the area is a good place to rest.

  If the dungeon guide's accuracy check fails by 4 or less, the book doesn't have any relevant information on the area in question. If the dungeon guide fails the check by 5 or more, the GM should provide the PC with seemingly true information that is actually inaccurate or dangerous in some way. For example, the guide might reveal that there is a trap in the room, but give the wrong location for it.

  If a PC possesses ranks in the dungeon guide's associated skill, he may attempt a skill check with the associated skill each time he consults the guide. If his check surpasses the guide's associated skill DC, the guide receives a +2 bonus on its next accuracy check and the PC cannot receive inaccurate information from the guide should it fail this accuracy check by 5 or more (in this case the PC simply receives no pertinent information from consulting the text that time).

Table: Accuracy Check DCs
DC Task
20 Determine a mechanism's function
20 Determine whether an area is a safe place to rest
25 Fill in the next area of the map
25 Get a hint on how to solve a puzzle
20 Get a vague idea of nearby rooms
10 + creature's CR Identify a commonly encountered dungeon denizen
10 Identify a room's original purpose
10 + trap's CR Locate a hidden trap
15 Locate a nearby source of food or water

Corset.name: Corset（Corset）
Corset.description:
Source PPZO94102

  價格 1 SP-200 gp; 重量 3 磅

  Sewn-in boning and laces allow this bodice to adjust your waist size in a way considered alluring by some cultures. The restrictive nature of this garment makes it a poor choice for combat or other athletic exertions, but you can easily conceal a thin knife in the corset's boning. The price varies greatly depending on the corset's quality; the cheapest corsets are made of simple cloth and cost mere silver pieces, while the most expensive feature silk brocade and are decorated with pearls or other costly adornments.

Cosmogram.name: Cosmogram（Cosmogram）
Cosmogram.description:
Source: PZO9449

  價格 200 gp; 重量 1/2 磅

  This eldritch chart describes part of the unfathomably vast shape of the physical universe and the subtler motions of the stars. A cosmogram grants a +1 circumstance bonus on Knowledge (geography) checks relating to stars and on Survival checks to navigate the void of space between star systems. A cosmogram can be consulted while using an orrery as a focus for augury. Doing so increases the chance of a successful reading by 2%.

Cot.name: 便攜式床（Cot）
Cot.description:
Cot

  價格 1 gp; 重量 30 磅

  這種高於地面的營地用床由木頭和帆布製成，在地面潮溼而且遍佈石頭的時候特別有用。它足以睡下一個成年男性，但摺疊起來只有4英尺x9英吋的圓柱形袋子那麼大。

Cream, Chill.name: 冷霜（Cream, Chill）
Cream, Chill.description:
價格：15GP重量：1磅

  只要暴露在光亮中，這種淡藍色的油膏就會發出冷氣。通過一個整輪動作把它抹在臉和手上可以為你在對抗炎熱天氣的豁免檢定上提供+2鍊金加值——如果周圍的環境為光亮環境，這個加值增加到+4；但如果是在昏暗或黑暗環境中，這個加值則無效。抹好的冷霜可以在1小時內持續生效，一劑剛封罐的冷霜可以使用5次。

Crowbar.name: 撬棍（Crowbar）
Crowbar.description:
價格 2 gp; 重量 5 磅

  這種多功能的工具被設計用來撬開任何使用者想打開的東西。撬棍在強行打開門或者箱子的力量檢定中提供+2環境加值。若將其用於戰鬥，它被視為單手臨時武器，造成與同樣大小的木棍相同的鈍擊傷害。

Cryptography book.name: Cryptography book（Cryptography book）
Cryptography book.description:
Source Heroes of the Streets pg. 12
價格 100 gp; 重量 2 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  You can consult this book while attempting a Linguistics check to understand or create a coded message; doing so makes the task take 10 times longer than normal but grants you a +2 circumstance bonus on your check. The DC to decipher a message encoded with a cypher you invent is equal to the result of the Linguistics check you roll when creating the cypher. You can instead use one of the dozen example cyphers in the book, in which case the DC to understand the message without the cypher is 25, and any characters attempting to decipher the message do so automatically if they consult a copy of the same book.

Cup, False-Bottomed.name: Cup, False-Bottomed（Cup, False-Bottomed）
Cup, False-Bottomed.description:
Source PZO9410

  The tiny compartment in the thick bottom of this cup is an excellent place to store a small item or substance. The most insidious are designed with a weighted catch that opens when the cup is tilted back, releasing the hidden substance hidden into the contents of the cup. Spotting the secret compartment in an empty cup is a DC 15 Perception check.

Cushioned Inserts.name: Cushioned Inserts（Cushioned Inserts）
Cushioned Inserts.description:
價格 5 SP; 重量 -

  These rubber boot or shoe inserts cushion your feet and improve your gait, granting you a +1 circumstance bonus on Constitution checks to continue running and to avoid nonlethal damage from a forced march.

Cypher Books.name: 密碼本（Cypher Books）
Cypher Books.description: 密碼本 這種總是與解碼本成對出售的書籍每頁都有編碼的表格，能夠簡單、輕鬆的生成隨機單詞列表。這允許使用者引用密碼本上的頁、行和列中特定的詞來代替原本的字符和數字。沒有合適解碼本的生物若想要嘗試閱讀則需要進行一個-10的語言學檢定來破譯。使用密碼本加密訊息需要花費寫明文訊息所需時間的10倍，用解碼本解碼也需要花費同樣的時間。 價格 150 gp; 重量 2 磅

Dancer's Garb.name: Dancer's Garb（Dancer's Garb）
Dancer's Garb.description:
Source PPZO94102

  價格 100 gp; 重量 5 磅

  This combination of loose-fitting sashes, veils, and ornamentation accentuates a dancer's form and movements.

  Dancer's garb provides a +2 circumstance bonus on Perform (dance) checks, similar to that provided by masterwork instruments for other Perform skills, but does not grant this benefit when worn with armor or other concealing clothing.

Dancer's Garb, Silver.name: Dancer's Garb, Silver（Dancer's Garb, Silver）
Dancer's Garb, Silver.description:
Source PPZO94102

  價格 200 gp; 重量 5 磅

  In addition to granting the same bonus on Perform (dance) checks as regular dancer's garb, silver dancer's garb is considered a silver instrument for silver balladeer bards.

  Silver dancer's garb can be made of sunsilver (see below); sunsilver dancer's garb costs an additional 3,000 gp and grants the same benefits as armor made of sunsilver. As with the bonus on Perform (dance) checks, this benefit functions only when no other armor or concealing clothing is worn.

Darkflare.name: Darkflare（Darkflare）
Darkflare.description:
Darkflare

Source PCh:FG

  Created by the drow-hunters, this alchemical flare explodes in black sparks 1 round after lighting. Any creature in the same square as a darkflare when it explodes must make a DC 15 Fortitude save or be unable to see with darkvision for 1d10 rounds. Affected creatures can still see in normal light with no penalty. A darkflare has no effect on creatures without darkvision. The DC to create a darkflare with Craft (alchemy) is 20.

Darkwood.name: Darkwood（Darkwood）
Darkwood.description:
價格 2 gp; 重量 -

  The bark of the darkwood tree is useful in numerous alchemical applications, especially those that require a light but strong foundation.

Alchemical Power Component

  Doses 5 (10 gp); Spells creation subschool

  Spells of the creation subschool are cast at +1 caster level for the purpose of all effects.

Decorative Trim.name: 服裝配飾（Decorative trim）
Decorative Trim.description:
價格：1sp - 50gp；重量：—

  服裝配飾通常包含領口、袖口以及一些鑲邊，來讓便服看起來更加正式一些。需要頻繁進行旅行的人，比如商人或藝人，會將服裝配飾與一些當地風格的服裝進行搭配，這樣就不用購買一整套新衣了。而對於旅行中的貴族來說，則會額外準備幾套服裝配飾，用於把臨時僱來使喚的下人和護衛弄得精神一些。

Defoliant.name: 除草劑（Defoliant）
Defoliant.description:
價格：30GP重量：-

  只要兌進水裡，這種藥劑就能立刻殺死被它潑到的植物。一瓶除草劑可以殺滅50個5尺方格內的灌木和其他小型的植被。較小顆的植物（除去樹木以外）會在1小時內死亡並以10分鐘/5尺方格的速度消失（植物迅速枯萎，碎裂和分解為塵土顆粒），只留下光禿禿的地面。較大的植物（除了健康的大樹外）會在2小時內死亡，1小時/5尺的速度分解。特別大的樹通常很難被一瓶除草劑殺死，即使成功的將其毒殺也很難快速分解掉。除此之外，除草劑還可以被用來當做濺射武器攻擊植物生物，1瓶除草劑溶液可以對植物造成1d6點傷害，以及1點力量和體質（通過DC20的強韌檢定不受到屬性傷害），處於目標5尺濺射範圍的植物生物也會受到1點傷害。

Deodorizing Agent.name: Deodorizing Agent（Deodorizing Agent）
Deodorizing Agent.description:
Source PPZO9410

  價格 30 gp; 重量 -

  Coating a creature in a vial of this milky, odorless substance takes 1 minute and renders it scentless for 1d3 hours. Creatures that rely on scent for locating creatures do not gain the benefit of this ability against a creature affected by a dose of deodorizing agent.

Dimmer Dust.name: Dimmer Dust（Dimmer Dust）
Dimmer Dust.description:
Source PZO9432

  This small leather pouch is filled with a faintly radioactive ore, with a small percentage of reactants that activate the dust. When used, dimmer dust must be sprinkled in a 5-foot square, which then becomes the center of the dust's effect. All bright or normal light within 30 feet of the activated dust is reduced to dim light, and any creature attempting to cast a spell with the light descriptor in this area must succeed at a DC 15 caster level check or have spell's effect be negated. If dimmer dust is exposed to sunlight, it immediately becomes permanently inert. Each pouch contains enough dust for two applications.

  Create: Craft (alchemy) DC 25

Dissipating Fan.name: Dissipating Fan（Dissipating Fan）
Dissipating Fan.description:
Source: PZO9481

  價格 150 gp; 重量 6 磅

  This large wood-and-canvas fan is 2 feet wide and ideal for quickly dispersing smoke or other harmful gases.

  While waving a dissipating fan, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Fortitude saving throws to avoid taking nonlethal damage from heat exposure and to avoid the effects of smoke inhalation. You can use a dissipating fan to clear non-magical smoke, fog, or similar vapors from your square or an adjacent square as a full-round action-although dense smoke or fog in the surrounding area eventually refills the space (how long this takes depends on the source and the size of the area, at the GM's discretion). When folded and closed, a dissipating fan is the size of a thick walking stick.

  Some dissipating fans are decorated with paint or elaborate embroidery, and have a higher price to reflect their adornment.

Diving Suit.name: 潛水服（Diving suit）
Diving Suit.description:
價格：10gp；重量：2磅

  這件連體服裝會減少水流的阻力，讓穿戴者游泳的動作更加協調。它會為游泳檢定提供+1環境加值。只有在這套服裝穿在最外層的時候，它才會提供上述加值，若你把它穿在笨重的衣服或者厚重的裝備（比如背包，大號的武器等等）外面時，便不會產生任何效果。如果潛水服破損了（比如受到了幾個回合的揮砍或穿刺攻擊），則會在修復之前不再產生加值。

Dragon Rose.name: Dragon Rose（Dragon Rose）
Dragon Rose.description:
Source PZO1140

  價格 25 gp

  The vivid and thorny dragon rose is admired for its hardiness but is difficult to cultivate.

  Gather DC 18; Yield 1 dose

  Terrain any forests or mountains

  Preparation The petals of a dragon rose must be delicately removed from the stem and then soaked in a mixture brewed from the flower stalk's sap for 2 hours; this requires a successful DC 15 Craft (alchemy) check.

  Use A dose of prepared dragon rose petals crushed in the hand and then smeared on a weapon (this is a standard action) infuses the weapon with a magic aura. For 1 hour, the weapon can bypass DR/magic, although it doesn't gain any bonus on attack or damage rolls.

Dream Lichen.name: Dream Lichen（Dream Lichen）
Dream Lichen.description:
Source PZO1140

  價格 2,000 gp

  This multicolored, shimmering lichen grows in places where powerful magical creatures have slept and dreamt.

  Gather DC 30; Yield 1 dose

  Terrain anywhere the boundaries between the Material Plane and the Dimension of Dreams grow thin

  Preparation The fibrous outer layer of the lichen must be gently scrubbed away, exposing the soft interior, which must then be allowed to dry after being sprinkled with various alchemical powders. This requires a successful DC 25 Craft (alchemy) check and 8 hours of work.

  Use A creature that sleeps for at least 8 hours with a dose of dream lichen in contact with its body has vivid dreams in which it endures and recovers from a supernatural affliction. Upon waking, the creature can attempt a new saving throw against a single curse or mind-affecting effect from which it is currently suffering. Alternatively, the user automatically succeeds at a saving throw to remove a temporary negative level.

Dreamer's Star.name: Dreamer's Star（Dreamer's Star）
Dreamer's Star.description:
Source Heroes of the Wild

  價格 5 gp; Check Profession (herbalist) DC 13; 重量 -; Terrain forests or plains

  When the orange petals of this plant are cured and left to steep in hot water, the leaves make a mild, aromatic tea that facilitates restful sleep. When taken before sleeping, this tea grants the drinker the benefits of a full 8 hours of uninterrupted sleep in only 6 hours. One dose of Dreamer's star makes enough tea to serve six.

Drill.name: 鑽頭（Drill）
Drill.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 56, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 184, Adventurer's Armory pg. 19
價格 5 sp; 重量 1 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  鑽頭可以在石頭、木頭或金屬上鑽出1英吋直徑的孔洞，這需要花費一個標準動作。較硬的材料會迅速的磨損或折斷鑽頭。聽到鑽頭鑽孔的聲音需要通過一個DC15的察覺檢定。

Dung grenade.name: Dung grenade（Dung grenade）
Dung grenade.description:
Source Antihero's Handbook pg. 28
價格 100 gp; 重量 1 磅
分類 Alchemical Weapons

描述

  The casing of this modified fuse grenadeUE is partially filled with animal dung or guano. You can throw a dung grenade as a splash weapon with a range increment of 10 feet. Any creature directly hit by a dung grenade or in its splash radius takes 1d6 points of fire damage and is covered with the grenade’s malodorous contents, becoming sickened for 1d4 rounds. A target can attempt a DC 15 Reflex saving throw to halve the damage and the duration of the sickened condition. Crafting a dung grenade requires a successful DC 25 Craft (alchemy) check.

Construction

  Craft (Alchemy) DC 25

Dye, Hide.name: Dye, Hide（Dye, Hide）
Dye, Hide.description:
Source PPC:FF

  價格 20 gp; 重量 1 磅

  This thick, murky liquid comes in a large earthenware jug, and can be purchased in a variety of colors. Hide dye can be applied to the feathers, fur, scales, or skin of most types of animals and magical beasts, allowing creatures a measure of camouflage.

  Hide dye comes in a variety of colors and shades matching the following different kinds of terrain: cold (including ice, glaciers, snow, and tundra), desert, forest, jungle, mountain (including hills), plains, swamp, underground, urban, and water.

  One jar of hide dye can be applied to a Small or smaller animal or magical beast in 1 hour. Thereafter, the dyed creature gains a +2 circumstance bonus on Stealth checks in the associated terrain.

  If the Environment entry in a creature's statistics indicates that the creature can typically be found in a specific type of terrain (such as an owl's environment of temperate forests) and the creature is adorned with hide dye of a matching type, the bonus on Stealth checks increases to +4. Applying a new color of dye immediately covers and replaces the previous dye.

  Hide dye doesn't adhere to clothing or humanoid flesh, and grants no benefit to creatures other than animals or magical beasts. Once applied, hide dye is waterproof and can't be rubbed or burned away. It fades after 1d4+1 days unless it's removed earlier by magical means.

Dye, Marker.name: 彩彈（Dye, Marker）
Dye, Marker.description:
價格：15GP重量：1磅

  這種染色劑（有很多種顏色可選）可以在它濺射到的地方留下明顯的色斑。色斑在它剛剛留下的72小時中是全無辦法清除的，即使是褪色也需要2週資料。彩彈可以當做濺射武器進行投擲攻擊。

Ear trumpet.name: 竊聽器（Ear trumpet）
Ear trumpet.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 56
價格 5 gp; 重量 2 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  將這種由特殊工藝製作的竊聽器的一頭放在耳邊，另一頭貼在門或牆上時，隔牆聆聽的DC會減少5點。

Ear trumpet (Common).name: Ear trumpet (Common)（Ear trumpet (Common)）
Ear trumpet (Common).description:
Source Ranged Tactics Toolbox pg. 20
價格 25 gp (普通), 100 gp (masterwork); 重量 2 磅 (普通), 2 磅 (masterwork)

描述

  This foot-long brass funnel amplifies sounds entering through the broad end for anyone listening at the narrow end. The listener gains a +2 circumstance bonus on sound-based Perception checks but must use one hand to hold the trumpet to the ear in order to gain the benefit. A masterwork ear trumpet’s exquisite acoustic properties grant the listener a +4 circumstance bonus instead.

Earplugs.name: 耳塞（Earplugs）
Earplugs.description:
價格 3 cp; 重量 -

  耳塞由蠟或軟木製成，當需要進行對抗聲音效果的豁免檢定時，你可以獲得+2的環境加值；但也導致基於聽覺的察覺檢定有-5的罰值。

Elemental Breath.name: Elemental Breath（Elemental Breath）
Elemental Breath.description:
Source PZO1121

  This vial at first seems to be empty, but when it's opened, a rush of wind issues forth from within. When elemental breath is inhaled (as drinking a potion) by an air-breathing creature, that creature does not need to breath air for 10 rounds. A vial of elemental breath must be inhaled on the round it was opened to gain this effect. If it is not, the item is wasted.

Elemental Flux.name: Elemental Flux（Elemental Flux）
Elemental Flux.description:
Source PZO1121

  This flask of alchemical powder reacts to the elemental power in suli blood. Adding at least 1 hit point worth of suli blood to it creates an alchemical splash weapon. The splash weapon works like a flask of acid, except the damage is a random energy type (acid, cold, electricity, or fire). A DC 10 Craft (alchemy) check identifies what energy type the activated flask has. The activated flux retains its power for 24 hours before becoming inert material. The Craft (alchemy) DC to create this is 20.

Embalming Fluid.name: 防腐劑（Embalming Fluid）
Embalming Fluid.description:
價格：50GP重量：10磅

  這種液體可以用來儲存生物的屍體以用來解剖，剝製標本或死靈術應用（以及諸如死者復活之類的法術）。一般而言，防腐劑有毒，防腐處理的屍體會被動物和蟲類退避三舍，但是食屍的不死生物仍然不介意這種鍊金物品的氣味。用防腐劑處理1具屍體需要1小時並通過一個DC25的醫療檢定，防腐處理過的身體腐爛速度減半（用來進行法術復活的話，屍體每停放一天只視為半天）。

Essence Of Night.name: Essence Of Night（Essence Of Night）
Essence Of Night.description:
Source PRG:TWoVHD

  價格 150 gp; 重量 -

  Drinking the cold, oily draught in this vial suppresses the effects of the light sensitivity racial trait for 10 minutes. Additionally, 1 sunlight syndrome point is removed, if the drinker has any. Essence of night can remove only 1 sunlight syndrome point per day, no matter how many flasks a character might drink.

  Essence of night is an alchemical item with a Craft DC of 25.

Example Dungeon Guides.name: Example Dungeon Guides（Example Dungeon Guides）
Example Dungeon Guides.description:
The following examples are but a few of the dungeon guides the PCs might encounter while adventuring. Each of these guides is keyed to a specific dungeon, and can be a great boon to PCs delving into such sites. GMs can create their own dungeon guides by referencing these examples, which use the following format.

  • Title: Either the title of the dungeon guide or the name most commonly associated with the text if it lacks a title.
  • 價格: The cost of a dungeon guide if it is available for purchase. A character may resell a dungeon guide for half of this amount.
  • Accuracy: The accuracy bonus of the dungeon guide. This value is added to the guide's accuracy checks.
  • Associated Skill (DC): A skill keyed to the dungeon guide and the DC of the skill check. If the character consulting the dungeon guide succeeds at an optional check for this skill, there's no chance he'll receive misleading information should the guide fail its accuracy check by 5 or more. A PC must succeed at an associated skill check in order to benefit from a guide's skill bonuses.
  • 描述: A description and brief history of the dungeon guide and which dungeon or dungeons it covers.
  • Skill Bonuses: The kinds of skill checks bolstered by referencing the guide, the circumstances in which the skill checks must be made, and the bonuses granted on these checks.

Eye Patch.name: Eye Patch（Eye Patch）
Eye Patch.description:
Source PPC:PotIS.

  An eye patch covers one eye and ties around the head. Pirates usually wear eye patches to cover injured or blind eyes, but some wear eye patches to look more intimidating, or to keep one eye covered and thus retain their night vision when transitioning from the relative darkness belowdecks to the sunlight above.

Eyeglasses.name: Eyeglasses（Eyeglasses）
Eyeglasses.description:
Source PZO9410

  Also known as spectacles, eyeglasses compensate for poor vision or magnify small details.

Fairy Cap.name: Fairy Cap（Fairy Cap）
Fairy Cap.description:
Source PZO1140

  價格 250 gp

  This toadstool's pale-gray cap is stippled with yellow spots. Its presence often indicates ley lines or fey bowers nearby.

  Gather DC 20; Yield 1 dose

  Terrain any near ley lines

  Preparation A fairy cap must be gently simmered (not boiled) in a mixture of water and other natural ingredients for 1 hour; this requires a successful DC 20 Craft (alchemy) check. At the end of this preparation time, the yellow spots' color changes to bright orange or dark brown-there's a 50% chance of either development.

  Use When eaten without proper preparation, a fairy cap is mildly poisonous (save Fort DC 13, onset 1 minute, frequency 1/minute for 6 minutes, effect nauseated for 1 minute, cure 1 save), but when properly prepared, it takes on a not-unpleasant tangy flavor. The final color of a properly prepared fairy cap's spots determines its effect when consumed. A cap with orange spots causes a Large or smaller creature to grow one size category, while one with brown spots causes the eater to shrink one size category. These effects function as per enlarge person or reduce person, except they can affect any Large or smaller living creature; the effects persist for 10 minutes in either case. Whether or not it is prepared, a fairy cap is quite chewy, and eating it is a full-round action.

Fake footprint shoes.name: 偽跡鞋（Fake footprint shoes）
Fake footprint shoes.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 56
價格 5 gp; 重量 2 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  這種大號的鞋子套在普通大小的鞋子之外。它們可以創造看起來像是另一種生物所留下的腳印或鞋印。每種型號的偽跡鞋只能創造特定類型的足跡，如老虎、獸人、地精或者食人魔。穿著這些鞋子行走的時候你需要進行一個生存檢定，其結果即為其他任何人想要分辨這種痕跡真假的生物需要進行的生存檢定的DC。

Falconry Gauntlet.name: 訓鷹護手（Falconry Gauntlet）
Falconry Gauntlet.description:
價格：10gp；重量：1磅

  這種長手套由厚厚的皮革製作而成，訓鷹人會把手套套在非慣用手上，在狩獵前後供獵鷹站立。手套上還有一根流蘇和套環用於連接到獵鷹的束繩上。

Fashionable accessories.name: Fashionable accessories（Fashionable accessories）
Fashionable accessories.description:
Source Heroes of the Streets pg. 13
價格 20 gp; 重量 5 磅
分類 Clothing

描述

  These accessories allow a courtier’s, entertainer’s, or noble’s outfit to match the height of style in a particular city for 2d4 months. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Diplomacy checks to make requests of denizens of that city while wearing the accessories and an appropriate outfit. The bonus also applies on Bluff and Disguise checks to convince others that you hail from that city.

Feed, Animal.name: 飼料，每日（Feed, Animal）
Feed, Animal.description:
價格：5cp；重量：10磅

  在有的地區，你可以讓馬、驢、騾子以及矮種馬自行尋找植物餵飽自己，不過飼料能夠提供更為充足的營養。你也可以通過支付相同的費用購買食物，來餵飽騎乘用犬以及其他肉食動物。不過馬和其他大型生物需要的數額相當於其他動物每日所需飼料的兩倍。超大型動物則需要四倍的量。

Feed, Bird.name: Feed, Bird（Feed, Bird）
Feed, Bird.description:
Source PPZO9410

  價格 5 cp/day; 重量 1/2 磅

  This mixture of seed and dead insects is suitable food for small birds such as ravens, crows, and chickens. Birds of prey such as falcons, hawks, and owls can also sustain themselves on bird feed, though they typically require at least two servings per day. Larger avian creatures such as axe beaks and griffons require larger portions of meat, and cannot survive on bird feed alone.

Feed, Carnivore.name: Feed, Carnivore（Feed, Carnivore）
Feed, Carnivore.description:
Source PPZO9410

  價格 5 cp/day; 重量 5 磅

  Consisting of various kinds of raw meat that have been jerked, smoked, or salted for preservation, a day's worth of carnivore feed is adequate food for any Small or Medium meat-eating animal such as a tiger, bear, or dog. Larger carnivores might require up to 2 to 4 days' worth of carnivore feed per day.

Fetters.name: Fetters（Fetters）
Fetters.description:
Source: PZO1121

  Fetters are manacles fitted around the ankles rather than the wrists, and use the same rules for breaking, escape, and cost relative to size. A creature in fetters is entangled and can only move at half speed. In addition, a fettered creature must succeed at a DC 15 Acrobatics check to move more than its (reduced) speed in a round. If it fails the check by 5 or more, the creature falls prone.

Fire-resistant boots.name: 防火靴（Fire-resistant boots）
Fire-resistant boots.description:
價格：20gp；重量：2磅

  這雙重皮靴上有一層磚灰製成的防護層，用於保護你的雙腳免受燙傷。當你的腳部或者腳下受到火焰攻擊時，你會獲得2點火焰抗力，比如在燒熱的煤炭上行走的時候。反覆或長時間暴露在火焰中仍舊會燒壞鞋子表面的皮層，並最終毀掉這雙靴子（通常是暴露在火焰中1d10 + 20輪之後）。

Firewood.name: 薪柴（Firewood）
Firewood.description:
Firewood

Source PZO1110

  價格 (per day) 1 cp; 重量 20 磅

  這種幹木柴捆包括了樹幹與樹枝。

Fishhook.name: 魚鉤（Fishhook）
Fishhook.description:
Fishhook

Source PZO1110

  價格 1 sp; 重量 -

  這隻金屬鉤看起來更像是支稍稍扭彎的硬鋼針。

Fishing net (25 sq. ft.).name: Fishing net (25 sq. ft.)（Fishing net (25 sq. ft.)）
Fishing net (25 sq. ft.).description:
Fishing net (25 sq. ft.)

Source PZO1110

  A net for fishing.

Fishing Tackle.name: Fishing Tackle（Fishing Tackle）
Fishing Tackle.description:
Fishing Tackle

Source PZO1110

  More than a mere fishhook, this set includes birch poles, silk line, sinkers, hooks, lures, and tackle box. It grants a +1 circumstance bonus on Survival checks when gathering food around bodies of water that contain fish.

  價格: 20 gp; 重量: 5 磅

Flaming sumac.name: Flaming sumac（Flaming sumac）
Flaming sumac.description:
Source Adventurer's Guide pg. 14
價格 15 gp Black cumin, 20 gp Flaming sumac, 30 gp Golden cardamom, 100 gp Striped nutmeg, 15 gp Sunrise cinnamon, 25 gp Tiger cloves, 5 gp Violet salt; 重量 — Black cumin, — Flaming sumac, — Golden cardamom, — Striped nutmeg, — Sunrise cinnamon, — Tiger cloves, — Violet salt

描述

Food spoils more quickly in hot climates, and Qadirans have become experts at using the spices that they trade to help preserve their meals. After importing plants from across the planes, Qadiran druids and alchemists bred and magically adapted unique species with enhanced medicinal properties. Al-Zabriti tribes generally have supplies of the following spices on hand. To gain the benefits of these spices, a character must consume multiple doses over 1 or more days, as indicated for each spice. Once the benefit is gained, continued consumption at that rate maintains the benefit.

Black Cumin: Cumin is a nutty seasoning used in savory foods. If eaten twice per day for a week, it grants those who consume it a +1 alchemical bonus on Fortitude saves to resist disease for the following 24 hours. An ounce of black cumin sells for 15 gp and seasons 14 meals.

Flaming Sumac: A tart spice, sumac allows a character who contracts a natural disease with multiple effects to suffer one fewer effect (determined randomly) each time he fails a saving throw to resist that disease’s effects. An individual must consume flaming sumac twice per day for at least 3 days to gain its effects, which last for 24 hours after the last dose is consumed. An ounce of flaming sumac sells for 20 gp and seasons six meals.

Golden Cardamom: This fragrant, sweet powder is made from ground cardamom seeds and is often used as a perfume and tooth cleaner, as well as a seasoning in rice dishes and desserts. When a character takes ability damage from a disease, the actual damage taken is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0). Golden cardamom has no effect on ability drain or other effects caused by disease. It must be eaten once per day for 9 days to build up sufficiently within an individual’s body to provide this effect. An ounce of golden cardamom seeds sells for 30 gp and seasons nine meals.

Striped Nutmeg: Used for both desserts and meats, nutmeg halves any ability damage (but not ability drain) resulting from non-supernatural disease, to a minimum damage of 1. It must be eaten three times per day for at least 4 days to provide this effect. An ounce of ground striped nutmeg sells for 100 gp and seasons 12 meals.

Sunrise Cinnamon: A warming spice, sunrise cinnamon is used for seasoning both sweet and savory foods. It promotes sweating, and a character who ingests it twice per day for 5 days gains a +4 alchemical bonus on Fortitude saves made to resist the effects of hot environments. An ounce of ground sunrise cinnamon sells for 15 gp and seasons 10 meals.

Tiger Cloves: Cloves are used in both sweet and savory foods, brewed into teas, and chewed as a breath freshener. When chewed for 1 minute, a dose of tiger cloves removes nauseated or sickened conditions caused by disease or poison effects. When used to season a meal, a dose of tiger cloves grants a +2 alchemical bonus on saving throws to resist the nauseated or sickened conditions for 24 hours after the meal is eaten. A single dose of tiger cloves sells for 25 gp and seasons one meal.

Violet Salt: Salt is of vital importance for retaining a body’s water. If a dose of Qadiran violet salt is consumed as part of a meal, it grants a +4 alchemical bonus on Constitution checks to resist the effects of ongoing thirst for the next 24 hours. A dose of violet salt sells for 5 gp and seasons one meal.

Flask.name: 扁瓶（Flask）
Flask.description:
Source PZO1110

  這種玻璃瓶的容積為1品脫。它比較脆弱，如果仍到硬物表面或生物身上就會碎裂。這種瓶子可以是簡單的棕色玻璃，也有可能雕有精心製作的圖案，例如家徽或者其他藝術品。

  重量: – (裝滿時重1磅); 容積: 1 品脫/1 磅

Flayleaf.name: Flayleaf（Flayleaf）
Flayleaf.description:
Source PZO9410

  These narrow, rust-colored leaves produce a mildly hallucinogenic smoke that also serves as powerful sedative. Users are immune to pain for 4 hours after smoking flayleaf, but during this time they take a -5 penalty on saves against mind-altering effects.

Fleshgem.name: Fleshgem（Fleshgem）
Fleshgem.description:
Source PZO1121

  An oread adventurer discovered these small green gemstones when, after suffering a wound from falling on some jagged stones while exploring a cavern, she noticed pieces of beautiful green crystal growing from her skin. Oread jewelers found that these crystals, dubbed fleshgems, seemed to feed on the elemental energy that permeates an oread's flesh, growing from tiny chips of stone into large, elaborate gemstones. Essentially harmless, implanting fleshgems became a unique racial method of body alteration among oreads, equivalent to tattoos and piercings among other humanoids. Decorative fleshgems cost 1 gp and are merely ornamental. Fleshgem spikes, on the other hand, grow into elaborate crystalline shards that function as armor spikes, but the oread wearing them cannot wear armor over the spikes and even normal clothing requires special holes or seams to allow the spikes to stick out. Implanting a set of fleshgem spikes takes 10 minutes, and the resulting shard takes about a week to grow to full size. Removing a fleshgem takes 1 minute; the person removing the gem must make a successful DC 15 Heal check to avoid dealing 1d4 points of damage to the oread. The fleshgem spikes can be sundered or destroyed as if the growths were a worn object (hardness 1, 5 hp), but unless the embedded root of the fleshgem is removed, the shards grow back 1 week later.

Flint And Steel.name: 燧石和鐵片（Flint And Steel）
Flint And Steel.description: 用燧石和鐵片點燃一根火把是一個整輪動作。點燃其他火焰至少需要一整輪的時間。

Flotation Device.name: Flotation Device（Flotation Device）
Flotation Device.description:
Flotation Device

Source PPZO9410

  Usually composed of an inflated animal bladder sealed with pitch, a held flotation device adds a +1 circumstance bonus on Swim checks.

Foam, Impact.name: 軟墊劑（Foam, Impact）
Foam, Impact.description:
價格：25GP重量：1磅

  這種乳白色的粘稠液體在倒出以後會迅速膨化成1尺厚度的半固體泡泡膠。你可以將一瓶軟墊劑花費1分鐘時間均勻地塗抹在半徑10尺的地面上，或是將它以濺射武器的方式投擲出去。軟墊劑形成的泡沫不會影響踩到它的生物的行動，不過卻可以明顯地降低對它造成的衝擊力道——墜落在軟墊劑泡泡上的生物將忽略前1d6點墜落傷害，並可以將第二個1d6點墜落傷害視為非致命傷害。軟墊劑形成的泡泡會在10分鐘內解體或是直接用水衝去。

Focusing Flask.name: Focusing Flask（Focusing Flask）
Focusing Flask.description:
Source PPC:AM

  價格 700 gp; Slot none; CL 7th; 重量 1 磅; Aura moderate transmutation

  This round, rainbow-hued glass flask allows up to three alchemical splash weapons of the same type to be poured into it, concentrating them such that they never increase its weight noticeably. If multiple types of alchemical items are poured in, all the contents are ruined. The flask can be thrown as a normal splash weapon, and when it breaks, it releases all of the contained splash weapons in the same space, and the focusing flask is destroyed. If the items held within the flask normally allow a saving throw to reduce or negate the effects, the target of a focusing flask needs to succeed at only a single saving throw, regardless of the number of items held within the focusing flask. The DC of the saving throw increases by 2 if the flask contains two alchemical items, or by 4 if it contains three items.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

  Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells shrink item; Cost 350 gp

Footprint book.name: 足跡圖譜（Footprint Book）
Footprint book.description:
價格：50GP；重量：3磅

  這本50頁的圖冊畫滿了各種常見的動物，人型生物和怪物的足跡，還包括它們的這些生物的步距，力度和類似的訊息。這本圖譜可以為追蹤某一生物的足跡的技能檢定上提供+2環境加值——不過，如果目標穿有鞋仍然會使得追蹤變得極其困難。雖然你無法利用這本圖譜辨識留下足跡的生物個體究竟為何人，不過至少你不會搞混食人魔與巨魔，精靈與獸人的腳印。根據當地生物群落的不同，這本圖冊包含的內容通常也不盡相同。

Footprints Book (Apg).name: Footprints Book (Apg)（Footprints Book (Apg)）
Footprints Book (Apg).description: Footprints Book (APG) This 50-page tome contains accurate drawings of various 普通 animal, humanoid, and monster tracks, as well as notes on stride length, tread depth, and similarly useful information. The book gives you a +2 circumstance bonus to identify a creature by its tracks, though the use of shoes makes identifying many humanoids difficult or impossible. Though the book can't help you identify unique individuals, it can help you tell an ogre footprint from a troll footprint, or an elf's track from an orc's. Books sold in different areas may have different footprints, depending on what creatures are 普通 to that location. 價格 50 gp; 重量 3 磅 Source PZO1115

Footprints Cast (Acg).name: Footprints Cast (Acg)（Footprints Cast (Acg)）
Footprints Cast (Acg).description: Footprints Cast (ACG) This quick-drying cast is perfect for preserving a set of footprints in order to examine them later. By spending 1 minute setting the cast and waiting for it to dry, you can copy footprints, allowing others to examine them without traveling to the scene, and preventing the DC of the Survival check to analyze them from increasing because of time or weather. 價格 2 gp; 重量 1 磅 Source PZO1129

Formula Book.name: 公式薄（Formula Book）
Formula Book.description:
價格：15GP；重量：3磅

  公式薄擁有100頁羊皮紙書頁，它所記錄的每一條鍊金術士化合煉成會佔據每個煉成環數一頁的頁數。一個職業是鍊金術士的職業在起始時會擁有一本公式薄並記載有他已知的公式（見APG職業部分），鍊金術士的公式薄和法師的法術書在本質上是相同的。

Fortune-teller's deck.name: 算命卡牌（Fortune-Teller's Deck）
Fortune-teller's deck.description:
普通卡牌：重量：1/2磅；價格：1GP

  精緻卡牌：重量：1磅；價格：25GP

  高級卡牌：重量：1磅；價格：50GP

  這一套繪有圖案的卡牌可以幫助通靈者占卜未來——通常算命是需要收費的。一套【普通卡牌通常只是收在木盒裡的紙片。而精緻的卡牌則有更加漂亮的裝盒與彩繪的卡片，它可以作為法術卜筮（Augury）的法器使用，並在專業（占卜），專業（陰陽師）和類似的技能檢定上提供+1環境加值。而高級卡片則可能是木質或象牙精工細作而成，裝飾有彩繪甚至金銀珠寶鑲嵌組成的圖案。除了可以作為法器外，這套卡片在以上技能檢定的加值增加到+2。

Fungal Stun Vial.name: Fungal Stun Vial（Fungal Stun Vial）
Fungal Stun Vial.description:
價格 75 gp; 重量 1/2 磅

  Harvested from a rare fungus, these small vials emit a bright blue glow, and are commonly used in intertribal kobold disputes. When broken, a fungal stun vial releases a flash of bright blue light in a 10-foot radius and dim light in a 20-foot radius. All creatures within the flash area must make a Will save (DC 20). Creatures that fail are stunned for 1d2 rounds if they're in the area of bright light, or are confused for 1 round if in the area of dim light.

  Create: Craft (alchemy) DC 30

Furs.name: 皮草（Furs）
Furs.description:
價格：12gp；重量：5磅

  作為最基本的耐寒裝備，動物皮毛能夠讓穿戴者的體溫得意維持下去。用足夠多的皮草覆蓋身體能夠讓目標在抵禦寒冷氣候（cold weather）時，強韌豁免檢定獲得+2加值。這不會與生存技能帶來的任何加值疊加。皮草能夠補充到其他服飾上。

Fury Drops.name: Fury Drops（Fury Drops）
Fury Drops.description:
Source PPZO9410

  價格 50 gp; 重量 -

  Anointing a creature's eyes with a dose of fury drops causes it to immediately fly into a rage for 1d6 rounds, granting it a +2 alchemical bonus to Strength and Constitution, a +1 alchemical bonus on Will saves, and a -2 penalty to AC. The effect is otherwise identical to a barbarian's rage, and creatures are fatigued at the end of the rage. Only creatures with an Intelligence score of 1 or 2 can be affected by fury drops.

Fuse grenade.name: 引信手榴彈（Fuse Grenade）
Fuse grenade.description:
價格：100G；重量：1磅

  這個中空的粘土容器內裝有一小劑黑火藥和一條緩慢燃燒的引線。點燃引線是一個移動動作；1D3輪之後手榴彈將會爆炸，對半徑10尺爆發範圍內的生物造成2D6的震盪傷害和1D6的火焰傷害（反射DC15減半）。你投擲引信手榴彈時候將其視為濺射武器。

  製造引信手榴彈需要一個DC25的工藝（鍊金）檢定。

Gambeson.name: Gambeson（Gambeson）
Gambeson.description:
Source PPZO94102

  價格 1 gp; 重量 4 磅

  This padded cloth jacket is often worn alone or with mail or plate armor and is favored by hunters, guards, and soldiers. A gambeson fitted with leather loops to more easily attach armor is called an arming doublet. Although sufficient to protect you against casual scrapes, it is not as thick as padded armor.

Garlic.name: Garlic（Garlic）
Garlic.description:
Source PZO9410

  These pungent white cloves serve as food and medicine and play a role in many traditional cleansing rituals. It is well established that vampires cannot abide the presence of garlic (vampires cannot tolerate the strong odor of garlic and will not enter an area laced with it.)

Gel, Fire Ward.name: Gel, Fire Ward（Gel, Fire Ward）
Gel, Fire Ward.description:
價格 150 gp; 重量 1 磅

  When you apply this thin gel to your skin, armor, or clothing, it creates a resistant barrier that protects you from fire or heat damage. You gain fire resistance 5. The gel burns away as it absorbs fire damage; when it absorbs a total of 20 points of fire damage, it is discharged. Fire ward gel counts as protection from energy for the purpose of stacking multiple fire protection effects. Applying fire ward gel takes 1 minute, and it lasts for 1 hour before losing its potency. Multiple applications of fire ward gel do not stack; applying more while a dose is active merely resets the potential amount of fire damage absorbed to 20 points.

Gel, Frost Ward.name: Gel, Frost Ward（Gel, Frost Ward）
Gel, Frost Ward.description:
價格 150 gp; 重量 1 磅

  When you apply this thin gel to your skin, armor, or clothing, it creates a resistant barrier that protects you from cold damage. You gain cold resistance 5. The gel flakes away as it absorbs cold damage; when it absorbs a total of 20 points of cold damage, it is discharged. Frost ward gel counts as protection from energy for the purpose of stacking multiple cold protection effects. Applying frost ward gel takes 1 minute, and it lasts for 1 hour before losing its potency. Multiple applications of frost ward gel do not stack; applying more while a dose is active merely resets the potential amount of cold damage absorbed to 20 points.

Gel, Phosphorescent.name: Gel, Phosphorescent（Gel, Phosphorescent）
Gel, Phosphorescent.description:
Source PZO9430

  價格 45 gp; 重量 1/2 磅

  This sealed vial contains 1 ounce of milky white gel. Once the vial's seal is broken, the liquid reacts with the surrounding air and begins to rapidly heat up, glowing like a candle for 1 hour. After that hour, the oxidization of the chemical agent is complete, and the gel dissolves in a white-hot flash, dealing 3d6 points of fire damage to anything directly in contact with it. A single dose of phosphorescent gel can coat 6 square inches of a surface. Multiple doses of phosphorescent gel can be used to coat larger surfaces, but the amount of damage dealt does not stack. The conflagration occurs in an instant, and the fire generated doesn't spread, though it can be used to ignite a larger explosive such as a fuse grenade or pot of oil.

Ginger Extract.name: Ginger Extract（Ginger Extract）
Ginger Extract.description:
Source PZO9445

  價格 5 sp; 重量 -

  In addition to serving as a spice and as an alchemical reagent, ginger extract has a wide variety of uses in herbal remedies that treat nausea and pain.

Alchemical Power Component

  Doses 10 (5 gp); Spells transmutation school

  Spells of the transmutation school are cast at +1 caster level for the purpose of overcoming spell resistance.

Glass Cutter.name: 玻璃刀（Glass Cutter）
Glass Cutter.description:
價格 5 gp; 重量 -

  玻璃刀是一根短小的金屬棒，一端有一個小而尖銳的鋸輪，另一端有一個小圓球。你可以用鋸輪刻畫，然後用圓球擊打併敲碎玻璃。如果你成功通過了一個DC15的手上功夫檢定，那麼你可以非常安靜的打破玻璃（通過DC15的察覺檢定才能夠聽見）。大多數盜賊使用膠水紙和玻璃刀來減少聲響，並收集打破的玻璃碎片。

Glove, Metal.name: Glove, Metal（Glove, Metal）
Glove, Metal.description:
Source: PZO9430

  價格 120 gp; 重量 10 磅

  This thick iron gauntlet is more an encasing than a piece of armor. It has only a few moving joints, and the position of its fingers and wrist must be adjusted and locked into place before the wielder can properly slip it over her arm. When wearing a metal glove, it is impossible to manipulate one's digits (meaning the wearer cannot hold anything in that hand), but that hand and forearm are completely protected from injury, making it easy to reach into a trapped hole or a deadly animal's cage. Any trap or creature attempting to damage an arm wearing a metal glove must break through the glove before reaching the wearer. Heavy objects that would normally crush the wearer's hand rest harmlessly on the glove instead, likely trapping the item but allowing her to pull her hand out as normal. A metal glove has hardness 10 and 15 hit points, and can withstand 2,000 pounds of pressure before crumpling. It does not protect the wearer from injury to other parts of her body.

Goblinvine.name: Goblinvine（Goblinvine）
Goblinvine.description:
Source PZO1140

  價格 30 gp

  The leaves of this invasive creeper produce oil that irritates the skin, causing red, itchy splotches to cover the affected area.

  Raw goblinvine leaves can be used as an improvised thrown weapon with a range of 10 feet that causes one creature to be are affected as if by itching powder, but with a save DC of 10. Creatures with the goblinoid subtype are immune to goblinvine.

  Gather DC 16; Yield 1 dose (1 磅)

  Terrain any forests, mountains, plains, or swamps

  Preparation Properly preparing a dose of goblinvine requires a successful DC 20 Sleight of Hand check and 1 minute of work to weave and roll the vines into a compact, fist-sized ball so the hairy side of the leaves faces inward. On a failure by 5 or more, the leaves become torn and ruined. If gloves or gauntlets aren't worn, the preparer is automatically exposed to the goblinvine's effects. If the preparation check's result is a natural 1, the preparer is exposed to those effects regardless of any hand protection worn. The goblin vine must then be stored in an area of bright light for at least 1 hour for the inner surface of the leaves to properly “sweat” and build up enough irritating oil to function as a thrown weapon.

  Use Once woven into a tight ball of vines and left to sweat, a ball of goblinvine leaves can be used as an improvised thrown weapon as a ranged touch attack. On a hit, a target must succeed at a DC 10 Fortitude save or develop a distracting, itchy rash that imposes a -2 penalty on ability checks, attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks. This effect persists for 10 minutes or until the rash is tended with a successful DC 12 Heal check attempted as a full-round action. This is a poison effect, but creatures with the goblinoid subtype are immune to the effect. Innovative characters (including many goblins) have developed other uses for goblinvine, including as snares and ropes to make those bound or entangled itchy as well, but since goblinvine is relatively fragile, it makes for a very poor substitute for rope.

Godsbrew.name: Godsbrew（Godsbrew）
Godsbrew.description:
Godsbrew

Source PPZO9410

  The recipe for this beer was said to be the last beer imbibed by a god before he undertook a great challenge.

  The listed prices are for a tavern or restaurant in an average city.

*Are you looking for the official Pathfinder Roleplaying Game version of this item? Click here to find it!

Goggles, Gloom Sight.name: Goggles, Gloom Sight（Goggles, Gloom Sight）
Goggles, Gloom Sight.description:
Source PZO1121

  These non-magical goggles are set with a piece of alchemically treated, black, obsidian-like stone found in the mountainous regions of the Shadow Plane. Gloom sight goggles interact with the unique eyes of fetchlings in such a way that when the goggles are worn over both eyes, they expand the range of a fetchling's darkvision to 90 feet, but the fetchling also gains the light sensitivity weakness. Other races cannot see through the lenses of these goggles, and they have no affect on fetchlings whose eyes have been modified by the Gloom Sight feat. Though they are alchemical rather than magical in nature, these goggles take up the magic item eye slot.

Goggles, Smoked.name: 墨鏡（Goggles, Smoked）
Goggles, Smoked.description:
Source PZO1115

  墨鏡的鏡片由煙燻過玻璃製成，有助於防止生物的凝視攻擊。在處理凝視攻擊時，你總視為避開了你的目光，你在對抗凝視攻擊（任何盲眼生物能夠免疫的攻擊）的豁免檢定上獲得+8環境加值。佩戴墨鏡時你在察覺檢定上有-4罰值，所有的對手都被視為具有隱蔽（20％失手率）。

Gold.name: Gold（Gold）
Gold.description:
Source PZO9445

  價格 5 gp; 重量 -

  In its purest form, gold is a dense, nonreactive metal. Its alchemical products are useful in stains and in treating swelling, pain, and infections.

Alchemical Power Component

  Doses 1 (5 gp); Spells healing subschool

  Spells of the healing subschool heal +1 hit point if they heal hit points.

Golden cardamom.name: Golden cardamom（Golden cardamom）
Golden cardamom.description:
Source Adventurer's Guide pg. 14
價格 15 gp Black cumin, 20 gp Flaming sumac, 30 gp Golden cardamom, 100 gp Striped nutmeg, 15 gp Sunrise cinnamon, 25 gp Tiger cloves, 5 gp Violet salt; 重量 — Black cumin, — Flaming sumac, — Golden cardamom, — Striped nutmeg, — Sunrise cinnamon, — Tiger cloves, — Violet salt

描述

Food spoils more quickly in hot climates, and Qadirans have become experts at using the spices that they trade to help preserve their meals. After importing plants from across the planes, Qadiran druids and alchemists bred and magically adapted unique species with enhanced medicinal properties. Al-Zabriti tribes generally have supplies of the following spices on hand. To gain the benefits of these spices, a character must consume multiple doses over 1 or more days, as indicated for each spice. Once the benefit is gained, continued consumption at that rate maintains the benefit.

Black Cumin: Cumin is a nutty seasoning used in savory foods. If eaten twice per day for a week, it grants those who consume it a +1 alchemical bonus on Fortitude saves to resist disease for the following 24 hours. An ounce of black cumin sells for 15 gp and seasons 14 meals.

Flaming Sumac: A tart spice, sumac allows a character who contracts a natural disease with multiple effects to suffer one fewer effect (determined randomly) each time he fails a saving throw to resist that disease’s effects. An individual must consume flaming sumac twice per day for at least 3 days to gain its effects, which last for 24 hours after the last dose is consumed. An ounce of flaming sumac sells for 20 gp and seasons six meals.

Golden Cardamom: This fragrant, sweet powder is made from ground cardamom seeds and is often used as a perfume and tooth cleaner, as well as a seasoning in rice dishes and desserts. When a character takes ability damage from a disease, the actual damage taken is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0). Golden cardamom has no effect on ability drain or other effects caused by disease. It must be eaten once per day for 9 days to build up sufficiently within an individual’s body to provide this effect. An ounce of golden cardamom seeds sells for 30 gp and seasons nine meals.

Striped Nutmeg: Used for both desserts and meats, nutmeg halves any ability damage (but not ability drain) resulting from non-supernatural disease, to a minimum damage of 1. It must be eaten three times per day for at least 4 days to provide this effect. An ounce of ground striped nutmeg sells for 100 gp and seasons 12 meals.

Sunrise Cinnamon: A warming spice, sunrise cinnamon is used for seasoning both sweet and savory foods. It promotes sweating, and a character who ingests it twice per day for 5 days gains a +4 alchemical bonus on Fortitude saves made to resist the effects of hot environments. An ounce of ground sunrise cinnamon sells for 15 gp and seasons 10 meals.

Tiger Cloves: Cloves are used in both sweet and savory foods, brewed into teas, and chewed as a breath freshener. When chewed for 1 minute, a dose of tiger cloves removes nauseated or sickened conditions caused by disease or poison effects. When used to season a meal, a dose of tiger cloves grants a +2 alchemical bonus on saving throws to resist the nauseated or sickened conditions for 24 hours after the meal is eaten. A single dose of tiger cloves sells for 25 gp and seasons one meal.

Violet Salt: Salt is of vital importance for retaining a body’s water. If a dose of Qadiran violet salt is consumed as part of a meal, it grants a +4 alchemical bonus on Constitution checks to resist the effects of ongoing thirst for the next 24 hours. A dose of violet salt sells for 5 gp and seasons one meal.

Golden Maple Leaves.name: Golden Maple Leaves（Golden Maple Leaves）
Golden Maple Leaves.description:
Source PZO1121

  These potent additives can only be culled from a rare maple tree known to grow exclusively in urban areas. These small, elaborately twisting trees are extremely slow to grow and mature-the leaves reach maturity only once every 3 years-and they are almost always grown and cultivated by half-elves. Additionally, half-elves are keenly aware of the effort put into the leaves' growth and normally only sell the products of their labors to others of their kind. When the golden maple's delicate, five-pointed leaves finally take on their namesake's color, they can be cut, dried, and then ground into a fine powder, a process that requires a DC 15 Knowledge (nature) or Profession (herbalist) check. When used in conjunction with the Craft (alchemy) skill to create special substances and items like alchemical grease or tanglefoot bags, golden maple leaves reduce the Craft DC by 5 and add +1 to the DC of any save required by the alchemical item. A single dose of golden maple leaf powder is sufficient to augment the crafting of three alchemical items.

Grave Journal.name: Grave Journal（Grave Journal）
Grave Journal.description:
Source PPC:DHB

  價格 4,600 gp; Accuracy +6; Associated Skill Knowledge (religion) (DC 25)

DESCRIPTION

  This long-lost tome contains the detailed accounts of the mysterious and terrible things found when exploring a haunted burial ground centuries ago.

SKILL BONUSES

  • See through a vampire or dhampir's disguise (Perception +4)

Grease, Alchemical.name: Grease, Alchemical（Grease, Alchemical）
Grease, Alchemical.description:
Source PZO1115

  Each pot of this slick black goo has sufficient contents to cover one Medium or two Small creatures. If you coat yourself in alchemical grease, you gain a +5 alchemical bonus on Escape Artist checks, on combat maneuver checks made to escape a grapple, and to your CMD to avoid being grappled; this lasts 4 hours or until you wash it off.

  Create: Craft (alchemy) DC 15

Alchemical Power Component

Source PZO9410

  Alchemical grease is good for augmenting spells affecting or creating surfaces.

  • Grease (M): Increase the Reflex save DC for affected creatures and the Escape Artist bonus for greased armor by 1.
  • Sleet Storm (M): Increase the Acrobatics DC by 1.
  • Wall of Iron (M): For each pot of grease used as a power component, you may designate one 10-foot square of iron wall as being slippery (+5 to Climb DCs).
  • Wall of Stone (M): For each pot of grease used as a power component, you may designate one 10-foot square of the spell's stone wall as being slippery (+5 to Climb DCs).

Grenade, Sting.name: Grenade, Sting（Grenade, Sting）
Grenade, Sting.description:
Source PZO90115

  價格 100 gp; 重量 1 磅

  This hollow clay container holds black powder, a slow-burning fuse, and rock salt or hard beads of resin or rubber. Lighting the fuse is a move action; 1d3 rounds later, the sting grenade explodes, dealing 2d6 points of nonlethal damage and 1d6 points of fire damage in a 10-foot-radius burst (Reflex DC 15 half). A sting grenade is treated as a splash weapon with a range increment of 10 feet. Crafting this item requires a successful DC 25 Craft (alchemy) check.

Grog.name: 格羅格酒（Grog）
Grog.description:
價格：2CP，重量：1/2磅

  這是一種用任何手頭能搞到的酒混合成的烈酒飲料。格羅格酒的發明者者是那些一上岸就站不穩的老水手和海盜發明的。雖然味道並不佳，不過海上生活能有酒就不錯了。

Hammer.name: 錘子（Hammer）
Hammer.description:
價格 5 sp; 重量 2 磅

  如果在戰鬥中使用錘子，將其視為單手的簡易武器，造成鈍擊傷害，傷害大小等於同等體型的尖刺手套。

Hammock.name: 吊床（Hammock）
Hammock.description:
Hammock

Source PPZO9410

  價格 1 sp; 重量 3 磅

  吊床是將毯子或者網與結實的繩索連接起來的東西，你可以將其掛在粗大結實的樹枝或兩棵樹之間，以便於睡在地面之上。爬出或爬進吊床是一個整輪動作。通過一個DC5的敏捷檢定可以將其變為一個移動動作。

Handle Harness.name: Handle Harness（Handle Harness）
Handle Harness.description:
Source: PZO9455

  價格 25 gp; 重量 10 磅

  This wood-and-leather harness fits over clothing or armor and provides small handles and footrests across your back and along the sides of your legs and arms. While wearing a handle harness, you automatically succeed at checks to aid an adjacent ally of your size or smaller with Climb or Ride checks, or Acrobatics checks to balance on narrow surfaces or uneven ground. A handle harness's ungainly construction gives you a -2 penalty on Escape Artist checks.

Harness.name: Harness（Harness）
Harness.description:
價格 2 gp; 重量 2 磅

  This leather or hemp harness allows a holder to restrain and control a domesticated animal. A harness is standard equipment for anyone trying to teach an animal tricks with the Handle Animal skill. Ready-made harnesses are available in most markets for 普通 domesticated animals such as cats, dogs, horses, and oxen, but harnesses can be made for nearly any creature.

  • Training Harness: This specialized harness must be tailored to a specific type of animal. A training harness provides a +2 bonus on Handle Animal checks made with an animal wearing it.

Harrow deck.name: 哈羅牌（Harrow deck）
Harrow deck.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57, Curse of the Crimson Throne Player's Guide pg. 12, Pathfinder Campaign Setting pg. 213, Adventurer's Armory pg. 19, Inner Sea World Guide pg. 293
價格 100 gp; 重量 —
分類 娛樂

描述

  這是一種占卜者和預言家使用的傳統的占卜卡牌組。有些哈羅牌擁有精心繪製的插圖，但大多數都是由羊皮紙或普通紙做成的卡牌，只配以手繪圖案。哈羅牌往往世世代代流傳下來，並且被它們的使用者悉心儲存。

Hat.name: 帽子（Hat）
Hat.description:
價格：1sp - 50gp；重量：0.5磅 - 2磅

  在各種文化中，都會有許許多多各種樣式的帽子。從長頭巾到皮製三角帽，帽子可以說是最為普通的頭部遮蓋物。有時會由於宗教派系或社會性的理由，存在一些需要強制性佩戴的特殊帽子。三角帽這樣較為泛用的帽子，通常價值2sp。

Headband of Alluring Charisma +2.name: +2魅力頭帶（Headband of Alluring Charisma +2）
Headband of Alluring Charisma +2.description: 銀質頭環上鑲嵌有大大小小的紅黃寶石。穿戴者的魅力有+2、+4或+6增強加值。在剛穿戴的24小時內，此加值視為臨時加值。

Headband of Alluring Charisma +4.name: +4魅力頭帶（Headband of Alluring Charisma +4）
Headband of Alluring Charisma +4.description: 銀質頭環上鑲嵌有大大小小的紅黃寶石。穿戴者的魅力有+2、+4或+6增強加值。在剛穿戴的24小時內，此加值視為臨時加值。

Headband of Alluring Charisma +6.name: +6魅力頭帶（Headband of Alluring Charisma +6）
Headband of Alluring Charisma +6.description: 銀質頭環上鑲嵌有大大小小的紅黃寶石。穿戴者的魅力有+2、+4或+6增強加值。在剛穿戴的24小時內，此加值視為臨時加值。

Headband of Inspired Wisdom +2.name: +2感知頭帶（Headband of Inspired Wisdom +2）
Headband of Inspired Wisdom +2.description: 青銅頭帶環繞著綠色的絲線。穿戴者的感知有+2、+4或+6增強加值。在剛穿戴的24小時內，此加值視為臨時加值。

Headband of Inspired Wisdom +4.name: +4感知頭帶（Headband of Inspired Wisdom +4）
Headband of Inspired Wisdom +4.description: 青銅頭帶環繞著綠色的絲線。穿戴者的感知有+2、+4或+6增強加值。在剛穿戴的24小時內，此加值視為臨時加值。

Headband of Inspired Wisdom +6.name: +6感知頭帶（Headband of Inspired Wisdom +6）
Headband of Inspired Wisdom +6.description: 青銅頭帶環繞著綠色的絲線。穿戴者的感知有+2、+4或+6增強加值。在剛穿戴的24小時內，此加值視為臨時加值。

Headband of Vast Intelligence +2.name: +2智力頭帶（Headband of Vast Intelligence +2）
Headband of Vast Intelligence +2.description: 這個複雜的黃金頭帶上鑲有幾顆藍寶石。穿戴者的智力有+2、+4或+6增強加值。在剛穿戴的24小時內，此加值視為臨時加值。智力頭帶的加值每有+2，那麼就可以給予某一項技能技能等級。在穿戴24小時後，頭帶給予穿戴者某些技能技能等級，其等級等同於穿戴者的總HD。這些技能等級不能和人物技能點所學習的等級疊加。被增強的技能在該物被製造時決定好。如果不指定具體技能，則隨機決定給予某些知識技能技能等級。

Headband of Vast Intelligence +4.name: +4智力頭帶（Headband of Vast Intelligence +4）
Headband of Vast Intelligence +4.description: 這個複雜的黃金頭帶上鑲有幾顆藍寶石。穿戴者的智力有+2、+4或+6增強加值。在剛穿戴的24小時內，此加值視為臨時加值。智力頭帶的加值每有+2，那麼就可以給予某一項技能技能等級。在穿戴24小時後，頭帶給予穿戴者某些技能技能等級，其等級等同於穿戴者的總HD。這些技能等級不能和人物技能點所學習的等級疊加。被增強的技能在該物被製造時決定好。如果不指定具體技能，則隨機決定給予某些知識技能技能等級。
