Magnesium.name: Magnesium（Magnesium）
Magnesium.description:
Source PZO9445

  價格 1 gp; 重量 -

  Magnesium is an extremely light and reactive metal that burns brightly when exposed to air. It is important for all living things, especially plants.

Alchemical Power Component

  Doses 2 (2 gp); Spells transmutation school

  Spells of the transmutation school are cast at +1 caster level for the purpose of determining duration.

Magnet.name: Magnet（Magnet）
Magnet.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 181, Adventurer's Armory pg. 19
價格 5 sp; 重量 1/2 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  Handheld magnets are relatively weak and are mainly used to detect or pull iron, 秘銀, or 精金 at a short range. They are not powerful enough to tug metal over significant distances or aid in disarming creatures wielding metal weapons. This hand-sized horseshoe magnet can lift up to a 3-pound iron weight.

Manacle Barbs.name: Manacle Barbs（Manacle Barbs）
Manacle Barbs.description:
Source: PZO1121

  Barbs added to these manacles wound a captive who does more than move slowly and with care. A creature secured in barbed manacles takes 1 point of piercing damage if it takes more than a single move action during a round. Rough movement of any kind, such as being struck in combat or falling prone, likewise causes 1 point of damage. Attempting to break out of barbed manacles with a Strength check deals 1d4 points of piercing damage to the captive regardless of the success of the attempt.

  Fetters can also be fitted with barbs, but the wearer can avoid damage by not taking actions that involve moving its legs. Hobgoblins often use such fetters to secure artisans to their worktables. Securing a captive with multiple sets of manacles and/or fetters doesn't cause additional damage.

  

  Tool Kits

  This section includes several kits of preselected gear for each character class or for specific adventuring purposes (dungeoneering, spelunking, and so on). GMs can use these kits to quickly round out an NPC's gear. Players can use them to equip new PCs in a hurry or as a shorthand for providing gear for cohorts, followers, minions, and hirelings. The listed price for the kit includes a small discount for purchasing these items as a group. Items in a kit that are used up, destroyed, or lost cost the full price to replace.

Manacles, Common.name: 鐐銬（Manacles, Common）
Manacles, Common.description:
Source: PZO1110

  鐐銬可以銬住一箇中等體型的生物。被銬住的生物可以使用脫逃進行掙脫（DC30，精製鐐銬則為35）。打破鐐銬需要一個力量檢定（DC 26，精製鐐銬則為28）。鐐銬硬度為10，並有10點的生命值。

  大多數鐐銬都有鎖；把你想要用在鐐銬上的鎖的價格記入鐐銬的價格。

  你可以以相同的價格購買適用於小體型生物的鐐銬。對於大型生物而言，鐐銬的價格為標示金額的10倍；超大型的生物則是標示金額的100倍。巨型，超巨型，超小型，微型和超微型的生物可以被特別定製的鐐銬所銬住，這種鐐銬的花費需要至少100倍的價格。

  Expanded Information

Source: PZO9293

  Fetters: These manacles are specifically designed to fit around the ankles, and use the same rules for breaking, escape, and cost relative to size. A creature in fetters is entangled and can move at only half speed. In addition, a fettered creature must succeed at a DC 15 Acrobatics check to move more than its (reduced) speed in a round. If it fails the check by 5 or more, the creature falls prone.

  Frontal Restraint: A creature whose wrists are bound with manacles can wield only one melee weapon or shield in combat (the weapon may be a two-handed weapon). It cannot make use of ranged weapons, except for crossbows (but even these cannot be reloaded by the bound creature). Any attack the creature makes while manacled takes a -4 penalty. The creature can attempt skill checks using its hands, but at a -5 penalty (-15 on Disable Device checks to pick the lock of manacles the creature is wearing).

  Rear Restraint: Manacles might be employed to keep a creature's hands behind its back. In such cases, the creature cannot use its hands to effectively employ any weapon or shield. The creature can attempt to use its hands to perform a skill, but at a -10 penalty (-25 on Disable Device checks to pick the lock of manacles the creature is wearing). While manacled, a creature can attempt to flip its arms beneath its legs, bringing its hands in front of itself. This requires a successful DC 25 Escape Artist check (a separate Escape Artist check is then required to escape the manacles).

  Restraining Two Individuals: Two creatures might share one set of manacles. While manacled together, the manacled individuals must remain adjacent to one another. If they are not working together, they are both treated as grappled. If they are working together, they can move together in the same round (using the movement speed of the slower creature). A manacled creature can forfeit its turn during combat to mimic the other manacled creature's movements, allowing that creature to act as if unrestrained.

Manacles, Masterwork.description:
Source: PZO1110

  鐐銬可以銬住一箇中等體型的生物。被銬住的生物可以使用脫逃進行掙脫（DC30，精製鐐銬則為35）。打破鐐銬需要一個力量檢定（DC 26，精製鐐銬則為28）。鐐銬硬度為10，並有10點的生命值。

  Expanded Information

Source: PZO9293

  Fetters: These manacles are specifically designed to fit around the ankles, and use the same rules for breaking, escape, and cost relative to size. A creature in fetters is entangled and can move at only half speed. In addition, a fettered creature must succeed at a DC 15 Acrobatics check to move more than its (reduced) speed in a round. If it fails the check by 5 or more, the creature falls prone.

  Frontal Restraint: A creature whose wrists are bound with manacles can wield only one melee weapon or shield in combat (the weapon may be a two-handed weapon). It cannot make use of ranged weapons, except for crossbows (but even these cannot be reloaded by the bound creature). Any attack the creature makes while manacled takes a -4 penalty. The creature can attempt skill checks using its hands, but at a -5 penalty (-15 on Disable Device checks to pick the lock of manacles the creature is wearing).

  Rear Restraint: Manacles might be employed to keep a creature's hands behind its back. In such cases, the creature cannot use its hands to effectively employ any weapon or shield. The creature can attempt to use its hands to perform a skill, but at a -10 penalty (-25 on Disable Device checks to pick the lock of manacles the creature is wearing). While manacled, a creature can attempt to flip its arms beneath its legs, bringing its hands in front of itself. This requires a successful DC 25 Escape Artist check (a separate Escape Artist check is then required to escape the manacles).

  Restraining Two Individuals: Two creatures might share one set of manacles. While manacled together, the manacled individuals must remain adjacent to one another. If they are not working together, they are both treated as grappled. If they are working together, they can move together in the same round (using the movement speed of the slower creature). A manacled creature can forfeit its turn during combat to mimic the other manacled creature's movements, allowing that creature to act as if unrestrained.

Manacles, Quickcatch.name: Manacles, Quickcatch（Manacles, Quickcatch）
Manacles, Quickcatch.description:
Source: PZO9455

  價格 180 gp; 重量 3 磅

  These masterwork manacles are designed to swiftly secure a restrained creature. The price includes a quick-release mechanism that, when attached to a belt or pack, allows you to retrieve the quickcatch manacles with one hand as a swift action.

  Quickcatch manacles include a good lock that locks automatically when the manacles are applied. When you take the tie up action in a grapple, you can lock your opponent in quickcatch manacles instead of using rope. The quickcatch manacles must be sized appropriately for your opponent. Quickcatch manacles can be constructed for creatures of different sizes using the same multipliers as ordinary manacles.

Map.name: 地圖（Map）
Map.description:
Map

Source PPZO9410

  這張地理地圖給使用者在野外進行導覽的生存檢定提供+1的環境加值。它也可以給在地下城進行導覽的知識（地下城）檢定提供相同的加值。

Marbles.name: 彈珠（Marbles）
Marbles.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 181, Adventurer's Armory pg. 19
價格 1 sp; 重量 2 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  彈珠可以用於減慢對手。一袋2磅重的彈珠可覆蓋5英尺見方的面積。進入彈珠覆蓋區域的生物必須通過一個DC10的反射檢定否則就會倒地（該生物對抗摔絆的穩定加值可以應用到本次豁免上）。任何半速或以更慢的速度移動的生物可以不受影響的通過彈珠覆蓋的區域。

Marked cards.name: 作弊紙牌（Marked cards）
Marked cards.description:
價格：1gp；重量：1磅

  無論是通過彎曲紙牌、不同色彩的花紋、還是做出難以察覺的刮痕，作弊紙牌都會讓知曉此類訊息的使用者能夠僅憑著觀看牌背便了解到卡牌正面的內容。發現紙牌做過標記需要DC為25的察覺檢定或者DC為20的專業（賭徒）檢定。上面列出的是普通紙質卡牌的價格：。

Mask.name: 面具（Mask）
Mask.description:
價格：1sp - 50gp；重量：1磅

  在墮落貴族們的節慶活動中，你可以看到最為古怪和流行的面具，不過簡單的面具也可能會被作為地區性的通關許可使用。面具種類繁多，從一小塊僅能覆蓋一部分臉部布料到完全覆蓋頭臉的精緻物品一應俱全。

Mask, Battle.name: Mask, Battle（Mask, Battle）
Mask, Battle.description:
Source PZO1121

  Made from wood, bone, or similar materials, this mask covers its wearer's actual appearance and identity by depicting a hateful, leering face instead. Because of a battle mask's excellent craftsmanship and exquisite details, the wearer gains a +1 bonus on Intimidate checks made to demoralize an opponent.

Mask, Doctor's.name: Mask, Doctor's（Mask, Doctor's）
Mask, Doctor's.description:
Source PZO9410

  This mask gives you a +1 circumstance bonus on Fortitude saves made against airborne toxins and scent-based effects. It is sometimes a crime to wear a doctor's mask in public if you are not a healer or physician.

Mask, Monster.name: 怪物面具（mask, Monster）
Mask, Monster.description:
價格：5gp - 10gp；重量：1磅

  這種立體式的面具通常會模仿某種特定的類人怪物，比如熊地精（bugbear）、地精（goblin）、獸人（orc）或大地精（hobgoblin）。當你的下巴動起來的時候，面具的嘴部也會張開和閉合，面具上的表皮實際上是經過精心繪製的布匹。儘管這樣的面具通常只是用於戲劇表演中用來扮演怪物，不過冒險者們都知道使用這樣的道具來幫助自身混入到對應種類的怪物群落中。佩戴這種面具時，你不會受到由於易容成不容種族而承受的-2易容減值，不過這種效果僅限於相隔至少20尺或者自身具有隱蔽（concealment）的時候；比這個距離更近或者能夠被清楚地觀察到的時候，這面具就會變成顯而易見的失敗偽裝。怪物面具會覆蓋住你的面部，並且通常附有假髮或頭盔來蓋住或偽裝你頭部的剩餘部分。每個面具都會與特定的身材大小相適應，不過某些體型和怪物樣式進行組合會讓觀察者覺得不太可信（小型生物戴著獸人面具可以被當做獸人兒童，但是中型生物戴著地精面具就算在最好的情況下也只會被當做畸形的大地精）。

Mead.name: 蜜酒（Mead）
Mead.description:
價格：5CP-2GP；重量：1/2-8磅

  這種酒是用發酵的蜂蜜和水釀成的，有時也會加入香料或啤酒花調味。

Mead, Linnorm.name: Mead, Linnorm（Mead, Linnorm）
Mead, Linnorm.description:
Mead, Linnorm

Source PPZO9410

  This honey mead is sweet and strong and, according to bards, is an indisputable aid to singing.

  The listed prices are for a tavern or restaurant in an average city.

Mead, Wasp.name: Mead, Wasp（Mead, Wasp）
Mead, Wasp.description:
Mead, Wasp

Source PPC:MM

  價格 400 gp; 重量 2 磅

  A rare breed of wasp produces the honey used to make this spiced, mead-like drink. For 1 hour after consuming a glass of wasp mead (this takes 1 round), the drinker is quick to respond to harm, gaining a +1 alchemical bonus on attack rolls against any creature that has damaged her with an attack within the previous round. This bonus does not stack with itself. A typical bottle holds four glasses' worth of wasp mead.

Meal.name: 飯食（Meal）
Meal.description:
價格：不定；重量：—

  表中的價格：列出的是一人一天所用的飯食。簡陋的一餐可以是麵包配烤蕪菁、洋蔥和水；普通的飯食則可以有燉雞，胡蘿蔔和兌水的酒；豪華的一餐可以選擇麵包或者酥餅，配牛肉、豆類，和好酒。

Meat.name: 肉類（Meat）
Meat.description:
價格：3SP；重量：1/2磅

  一塊足夠一餐食用的肉食。在大多數地方，肉食來自魚（或者其他海產），豬（培根，火腿和鮮肉），羊（羔羊肉、綿羊肉和山羊肉），雞，鵪鶉，鴨，鵝，兔子，鹿，牛甚至是馬。在另外一些氣候不同的地區，肉類的來源也可以是麋鹿，海豹，鯨魚，海象，馴鹿，貓和狗，羊駝，蛇，老鼠和倉鼠，蜥蜴，青蛙甚至是昆蟲。

  經常有冒險者光顧的飯館可能會出售更加稀有或者詭異的肉類，比如石化蜥蜴，恐龍，兇暴動物，巨蠍，魔猩猩，多頭蜥甚至是閃電蜥蜴肉。根據肉食來源的危險程度，它們的價格：在一餐1-100GP間浮動。

Mellowroot.name: Mellowroot（Mellowroot）
Mellowroot.description:
Source PZO1121

  Sneaky goblin chieftains give this orange paste to the tribe's warriors before proposing a particularly bold raid. Consuming mellowroot causes a euphoric feeling that makes you feel invulnerable. For 1 hour after consuming mellowroot, you gain a +5 alchemical bonus versus fear effects. However, while under the effects of mellowroot, you must make a DC 15 Will saving throw when you try to leave the threatened area of an opponent. If you fail the saving throw, you cannot leave the threatened area with that action but do not lose the action.

Merfolk's Comb.name: Merfolk's Comb（Merfolk's Comb）
Merfolk's Comb.description:
Source PZO1140

  價格 750 gp

  This vibrant yellow and pale-green variety of seaweed has wide fronds with lines of narrow fringe along the upper edge.

  Gather DC 25; Yield 1 dose

  Terrain any underwater

  Preparation A single dose of merfolk's comb must be allowed to dry over a period of 7 days while being rubbed with alchemical oils once daily to prevent the herb from losing its properties during the process. This requires seven separate successful DC 14 Craft (alchemy) checks, one every 24 hours during this week. If even one of those checks is a failure, the dose of merfolk's comb is ruined.

  Use Anyone who eats a dose of merfolk's comb gains the ability to breathe water as well as air for 8 hours.

Mimameith.name: Mimameith（Mimameith）
Mimameith.description:
Source PZO1140

  價格 600 gp

  The bark of this wide-trunked but relatively squat tree is resistant to cutting and fire. Gather DC 25; Yield 1d4 doses (5 磅 per dose)

  Terrain any forests or mountains

  Preparation A living mimameith tree has hardness 7 (rather than the typical hardness 5 for most wooden objects) and fire resistance 5. When a mimameith tree is burned but lives, its bark regrows over time with pale gray scarring-such bark bears special properties. Once harvested, this bark can be processed alchemically. Doing so requires a 5-pound dose of the bark to be soaked in water for 8 hours and then boiled off to a thin layer of tacky paste with a successful DC 20 Craft (alchemy) check.

  Use When a dose of the pasty residue from mimameith bark is applied to a creature's skin as a standard action, the subject gains damage reduction 2/bludgeoning, fire resistance 5, and immunity to bleed effects for 1 hour.

Mirror.name: 鏡子（Mirror）
Mirror.description:
Source PZO1110

  這種手持式的鏡子直徑約1英尺。不像許多高品質的玻璃鏡，這種鏡子是由拋光的鐵片製成，足夠堅固，即使掉在地上也沒有摔壞的危險。

Mistletoe.name: Mistletoe（Mistletoe）
Mistletoe.description:
Source PZO9410

  This golden-colored parasitic plant grows on many different sorts of trees. Druids harvest mistletoe with specially prepared tools and during sacred times of the year.

Moly.name: Moly（Moly）
Moly.description:
Source PZO1140

  價格 1,200 gp

  Moly is a plant with flowers white as pure milk and roots black as night.

  Gather DC 25; Yield 1 dose

  Terrain any forests or plains

  Preparation This flowering herb must be picked whole and boiled with water until the entire amount is reduced by half. The resulting mixture is then strained and poured into a shallow pan to evaporate. The resulting crust is scraped off as a powder.

  Use Anyone wearing or carrying fresh moly gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities. Moly remains fresh in this way for only 12 hours, regardless of magical attempts to preserve it. When processed into a powder with a successful DC 25 Craft (alchemy) check, moly can be sprinkled on a creature, object, or area (a standard action) to end a spell as if with dispel magic (caster level 6th).

Moondew.name: Moondew（Moondew）
Moondew.description:
Source PZO9445

  價格 4 gp; 重量 -

  Moondew is derived from a potent herb. It is commonly used in the creation of medicinal, protective, and divinatory items.

Alchemical Power Component

  Doses 5 (20 gp); Spells divination school

  Spells of the divination school are cast at +1 caster level for the purpose of all effects.

Moonrod.name: Moonrod（Moonrod）
Moonrod.description:
Moonrod

Source PZO1121

  This 1-foot-long, silver-tipped tin rod glows dimly when struck as a standard action. It sheds dim light in a 30-foot radius. However, the light given off by a moonrod is particularly easily to perceive for creatures with low-light vision. For such creatures, a moonrod increases the light level by one step (to a maximum of normal) for a 60-foot radius. It glows for 6 hours, after which the silver tip is burned out and worthless.

Mug/Tankard, Clay.name: 杯子（Mug/Tankard, Clay）
Mug/Tankard, Clay.description:
Source PZO1110

  無論它是一個簡單的陶瓷杯還是一個精心製作的飲水杯，都有一個握手和向上翻起的裝飾用蓋子。這種杯子可以用來盛裝任何種類的飲料，通常是由粘土或錫製成。

  重量: -; 容積: 1 品脫/1 磅

Mugwort Extract.name: Mugwort Extract（Mugwort Extract）
Mugwort Extract.description:
Source PZO9445

  價格 2 gp; 重量 -

  Many varieties of mugwort exist; some are used in acupuncture, while others are key ingredients in herbal remedies that ward off fatigue, cold, or even supernatural dangers.

Alchemical Power Component

  Doses 2 (4gp); Spells abjuration school

  Spells of the abjuration school are cast at +1 caster level for the purpose of determining range.

Musical Instrument, Common.name: 普通樂器（Musical Instrument, common）
Musical Instrument, Common.description:
重量：3磅；價格：5GP

  如果你進行一項涉及到演奏樂器（如鍵盤，打擊樂，絃樂或吹奏）的表演技能檢定，那麼你必須擁有合適的樂器幫助才能演奏，否則你不能進行相關檢定。這類樂器的大小一般會方便你用手持拿，比如小鼓，七絃琴，鈴鐺，豎琴或吹管。像諸如大提琴或鋼琴則相對要沉重和昂貴的多。

Musical Instrument, Masterwork.name: 精製品樂器（Musical Instrument, masterwork）
Musical Instrument, Masterwork.description:
重量：3磅；價格：100GP

  如果你進行一項涉及到演奏樂器（如鍵盤，打擊樂，絃樂或吹奏）的表演技能檢定，那麼你必須擁有合適的樂器幫助才能演奏，否則你不能進行相關檢定。這類樂器的大小一般會方便你用手持拿，比如小鼓，七絃琴，鈴鐺，豎琴或吹管。像諸如大提琴或鋼琴則相對要沉重和昂貴的多。

  精製品樂器：精製品樂器可以在你進行相關的表演檢定時提供+2環境加值。

Musk, Harpy.name: Musk, Harpy（Musk, Harpy）
Musk, Harpy.description:
Source RotRPG

  The reek of this doubtful cure-all proves useful at scaring off goblins. If smeared on a surface or used as a thrown weapon, the musk fills a 30-foot area with the stink of harpies for 1 minute. Any goblin who enters the area must make a DC 14 Will save or be shaken for 1 minute.

Alchemical Reagents

Musk, Wild Animal.name: Musk, Wild Animal（Musk, Wild Animal）
Musk, Wild Animal.description:
Source PZO9410

  This emerald-colored adhesive is a concoction made from animal glands, urine, and other powerful scents combined with a strong alchemical binding agent that is difficult to wash off. A target splashed with it smells like weak prey to predators. Creatures with the scent ability can detect a marked creature at five times the normal range, note its direction as a free action, pinpoint it when it is within 25 feet, and track it by scent with a +5 bonus on its Survival checks. Immersion in water within 1 round of exposure washes it off; otherwise the effect decreases by one range increment per day (four times normal range after 1 day, three times range after 2 days, and so on) until the creature is again at normal scent levels.

  Create: Craft (alchemy) DC 20

Myrrh.name: Myrrh（Myrrh）
Myrrh.description:
Source PZO9445

  價格 5 sp; 重量 -

  Myrrh is an aromatic gum used as a base for alchemical remedies and as a sticky bonding agent.

Alchemical Power Component

  Doses 4 (2 gp); Spells abjuration school

  Spells of the abjuration school are cast at +1 caster level for the purpose of caster level checks and dispel checks.

Neck Guard.name: Neck Guard（Neck Guard）
Neck Guard.description:
Source PZO1121

  Made from hardened leather reinforced with a band of metal, this collar protects the wearer against vampire bites when worn around the throat. It provides a +1 armor bonus to AC against vampire bites or similar attacks that specifically target the wearer's throat. Unlike most armor bonuses, the neck guard's +1 bonus stacks with the armor bonus of light or medium armor, but it provides no additional bonus when worn with heavy armor.

Nepenthe.name: Nepenthe（Nepenthe）
Nepenthe.description:
Source PZO1140

  價格 400 gp

  This foot-tall blue-green pitcher plant produces a pollen that smells faintly of mint and lures insects and even small vertebrates toward its dangerous mouth.

  Gather DC 20; Yield 1 dose

  Terrain warm forests or swamps

  Preparation A dose of pollen must be mixed with alchemical reagents with a successful DC 16 Craft (alchemy) check and then left to sit for 1 hour before it can be used.

  Use A dose of nepenthe pollen must be inhaled as a standard action, whereupon the potent vapors act upon unpleasant or unknown thoughts and memories. This grants the creature a new saving throw to immediately end a single mind-affecting effect currently affecting the creature (effects that allow no saving throw cannot be removed in this way). An unwilling creature can be dosed with the pollen as a touch attack that provokes an attack of opportunity. A creature can be affected by a dose of nepenthe only once in a single 24-hour period. This is a poison effect.

Net.name: Net（Net）
Net.description:
Net

  銅鈴網 銅鈴被掛在這張5英尺x5英尺的繩網的每個角落。當你在睡覺、打獵、做飯或者其他你不能全神貫注的時候，可以將銅鈴網覆蓋在你的裝備上，這樣當你的所有物被移動的時候就會響起警報。試圖接近被銅鈴網所保護的物品的生物必須通過一個DC25的手上功夫檢定以避免弄響銅鈴。聽到銅鈴網上銅鈴的響聲需要通過一個DC0的察覺檢定。因為這些銅鈴會在你的走動的時候發出響聲，因此攜帶銅鈴網時會讓你的潛行檢定承受-2的減值。 價格 2 gp; 重量 2 磅

  捕蟲網 捕蟲網是一根6英尺的長杆，其頂端是一個包裹著小網眼的網的金屬圈。你可以用它來將物體中能夠通過網的雜質如沙或者水篩出去。你也可以像使用網（武器）一樣來使用捕蟲網來捕捉超微型或微型的生物，不過如果你失手的話，並不用將網收回，同時你如同持握網的繩頭一樣來使用捕蟲網的把手。 價格 5 gp; 重量 2 磅

  Fishing net This net measures 5 feet by 5 feet, and can be used to cover a pit or to block Tiny or larger creatures from entering an area. 價格 4 gp; 重量 5 磅

  Camouflage netting This loose mesh of twine and varicolored cloth is used to disguise the presence of creatures or large objects. Camouflage netting must be manufactured to provide camouflage in a single type of terrain, such as snow, sand, forest, grass, swamp, urban, or water. When you hide under the netting in the appropriate terrain, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus on Stealth checks as long as you remain immobile and prone. Covering up with camouflage netting is a full-round action requiring a DC 10 Survival check (failure means you do not cover yourself correctly with the netting and do not gain its bonus on Stealth checks). You have the entangled condition when using the netting, except your Dexterity penalty does not affect your initiative or Stealth checks. Taking off camouflage netting is a move action, or a swift action if combined with a move action to stand up from a prone position.

  You may spend 1 minute covering an object with camouflage netting. Make a Survival check with a -10 penalty and use the total as the Stealth check result for the object. Creatures who fail a Perception check against this Stealth DC do not recognize what the object is and usually treat it as a natural part of the terrain. For example, you can conceal a wagon as a rock or patch of brush. Covering a Large object requires two nets. Covering a Huge or Gargantuan object requires five nets and takes 10 minutes of work, and the Survival check penalty is -20 instead of -10. Camouflaging a Colossal object depends on its shape but generally requires at least 10 camouflage nets and takes 1 hour of work, and the Survival check penalty is -30 instead of -10.

  A creature with the scent ability ignores the effect of camouflage netting and makes checks against your actual Stealth roll when in scent range. Any creature within 10 feet of a Large or larger object hidden by camouflage netting automatically recognizes it as an object covered in camouflage. 價格 20 gp; 重量 5 磅

Nightsage.name: Nightsage（Nightsage）
Nightsage.description:
Source PZO1140

  價格 100 gp

  The fragrant purple blossoms of this night-blooming wildflower are so deep in hue that they appear almost black.

  Gather DC 14; Yield 1 dose

  Terrain any jungles

  Preparation A dose of nightsage must be sprinkled with holy water periodically over an 8-hour drying process in natural sunlight; this process requires a successful DC 12 Craft (alchemy) check and one flask of holy water.

  Use When dried nightsage is lit on fire (a standard action), it produces a thin but pleasant-smelling smoke almost like that produced by a stick of incense. A dose of nightsage burns for 10 minutes and can be extinguished and reignited for multiple uses (but it is always used in 1 minute increments, regardless of the actual time spent burning).

  While nightsage burns, each corporeal undead creature within a 5-foot radius gains a +2 profane bonus on saving throws against positive energy effects (including channel energy effects). Necromancers are fond of supplying their undead minions with small thuribles containing a burning stick of nightsage that can be worn while carrying out their commands. A moderate or stronger wind extinguishes a burning stick of nightsage.

Observations Of The Drowned City.name: Observations Of The Drowned City（Observations Of The Drowned City）
Observations Of The Drowned City.description:
Source PPC:DHB

  價格 3,500 gp; Accuracy +5; Associated Skill Knowledge (geography) (DC 25)

DESCRIPTION

  Compiled from the recovered diaries of a clerk, this waterproof volume is a useful guide to those exploring the drowned city. Most of the information is dated, but the sketched maps and descriptions of major buildings remain useful.

SKILL BONUSES

  • Balance on slippery surface (Acrobatics +4)

Obsession Log.name: Obsession Log（Obsession Log）
Obsession Log.description: Obsession Log Gnomes use these small books to record information about their obsessions. When a gnome consults her obsession log (taking 1 minute), she gains a +2 circumstance bonus on the next Craft or Profession check she makes, as long as that skill was the one chosen for her obsessive racial trait. 價格 25 gp; 重量 1 磅 Source PZO1121

Oil, Anointing.name: Oil, Anointing（Oil, Anointing）
Oil, Anointing.description:
Source PZO1121

  This sacred oil, infused with aromatic spices and distilled holy water, may be applied to a creature while casting a harmless divine spell with a range of touch, increasing the casting time to a full-round action but also increasing the caster's effective caster level by +1 for that spell.

Oil, Kerosine.name: 煤油（Oil, Kerosine）
Oil, Kerosine.description:
價格：5G

  煤油又被稱為龍息油，這種帶有苦味的液體比一般的油更難點著，但能在低溫下迅速燃燒。這讓它受到異國表演者的青睞，例如舞火者和吐火者。你可以通過吐出煤油並使其通過一團明火（如被點燃的蠟燭，火柴或者火把）來點燃它，以製造一次急促的爆裂火焰。如果你用其進行攻擊，這是一個最大射程為5尺，造成1D3的火焰傷害的遠程接觸攻擊。如果你在攻擊骰中ROLL出了1，你將會不小心吞下一團已經被點燃的燃料，你將受到1D6的火焰傷害並且反胃一輪。一瓶煤油足夠吞吐10次，將煤油從瓶子中吸入口中是一個標準動作（快速裝填專長能將其變為一個移動動作）。

  製造煤油需要一個DC15的工藝（鍊金）檢定。

Oil, Lamp.name: 燈油（Oil, Lamp）
Oil, Lamp.description:
Source PZO1110

  一瓶1品脫/瓶的燈油可供一盞油燈或提燈燃燒6小時。你還可以將其作為濺射武器使用。與熾火膠使用相同的規則，除了為燈油瓶準備一個引信是一個整輪動作之外。一旦它被拋出，有50％的機會成功點燃。

  你可以將1品脫的燈油倒在地面（覆蓋5英尺見方的面積）上來使地面光滑。如果被點燃，燈油會燃燒2輪並對每一個範圍內的生物造成1d3點火焰傷害。

Oil, Quick Freeze.name: Oil, Quick Freeze（Oil, Quick Freeze）
Oil, Quick Freeze.description:
Source PZO9430

  價格 50 gp; 重量 1 磅

  This bottle of viscous blue oil sublimates slightly when exposed to air. When poured over water, the oil pools on the surface and takes 1 round to spread out from the point of origin in a 20-foot radius. At the end of this round, the oil flash-freezes the surface of the water, creating an ice sheet over the affected area. Any 5-foot square of this ice can support up to 200 pounds of weight. 重量 in excess of this amount causes the entire sheet to crack and quickly break up. This ice sheet becomes unstable and breaks up on its own after 1 hour, or 20 minutes in a hot climate. Any creature whose bare skin comes in contact with this oil takes 1d6 points of nonlethal damage each round because of the chemical's volatile nature, but the oil is ineffective as a splash weapon.

Oil, Stalkers.name: Oil, Stalkers（Oil, Stalkers）
Oil, Stalkers.description:
Source PZO9487E

  價格 50 gp; 重量 -

  This is a clear, viscous liquid that is typically kept in a frosted glass vial with an unassuming label and cork. The oil is used to reduce the sound armor and weapons make while moving.

  Applying this oil to a single piece of equipment takes 1 minute and grants the wearer a +2 circumstance bonus on Stealth checks for 30 minutes. A vial of this oil is enough to coat one Medium piece of equipment, while a Large piece of equipment requires 4 vials. Two pieces of Small equipment can be covered with a single vial of oil. Exposure to or submersion in large amounts of water, such as swimming, immediately ends the effect of the oil.

Oil, Stink.name: Oil, Stink（Oil, Stink）
Oil, Stink.description:
Source PPZO9410

  價格 15 gp; 重量 1 磅

  This glass container of foul-smelling oil shatters easily upon impact. You can throw a vial of stink oil as a splash weapon with a range increment of 10 feet. If a creature with the scent ability is standing in the square of impact, it must succeed at a DC 14 Fortitude save or be nauseated for 1d4+1 rounds. Any creature with scent in an adjacent square must succeed at a DC 12 Fortitude save or be sickened for 1 round. Creatures without the scent ability are not affected by stink oil.

Oil, Wing.name: Oil, Wing（Oil, Wing）
Oil, Wing.description:
Source PZO1121

  Tengus mix special salves to protect their feathers from the elements. This one-ounce vial of wing oil gives a feathered creature a +1 bonus on all saving throws to resist the effects of cold weather. Its effects last 24 hours.

Tools, Devices and Kits

Ointment, Armor.name: 護甲潤滑油（Ointment, Armor）
Ointment, Armor.description:
價格：30GP重量：1磅

  這種厚實的油脂可以抹在盔甲的活動關節處，讓它們使用起來更加靈活。花費1分鐘為護甲塗油可以降低它的護甲減值1點（最小降到-1），持續8小時。

Ointment, Loping.name: Ointment, Loping（Ointment, Loping）
Ointment, Loping.description:
Source PZO90115

  價格 60 gp; 重量 1 磅

  This gray, greasy topical lotion strengthens and straightens the leg muscles of bandy-legged hobgoblins. Applying loping ointment requires 1 full-round action. A hobgoblin under the effects of loping ointment gains a 10-foot alchemical bonus to his speed when using the charge, run, or withdraw action. This bonus lasts for 10 minutes. Loping ointment is specifically created to enhance hobgoblin physiology; other creatures gain no benefit from this ointment and find it unpleasantly itchy. Crafting this item requires a successful DC 25 Craft (alchemy) check.

Ooze, Grease.name: Ooze, Grease（Ooze, Grease）
Ooze, Grease.description:
Source PZO9210

  This alchemical concoction can be spread over a Medium or Small creature's body as a full-round action. It provides a +5 alchemical bonus on Escape Artist checks, CMD checks to avoid a grapple, and Reflex saves to avoid an ooze's improved grab or engulf abilities, but gives a -5 penalty to disarm checks, grapple checks to start or maintain a grapple or pin, and other checks that may be hindered by a loose grip (such as Climb). One application lasts for up to 1 hour and can be removed with soap and water.

  Create: Craft (alchemy) DC 25

Ooze, Petrified.name: Ooze, Petrified（Ooze, Petrified）
Ooze, Petrified.description:
Source PZO9430

  價格 80 gp; 重量 1/2 磅

  This tiny blob of ooze looks like a small disc of green stone when inactive, and is stored in a circular dish with an airtight cover. When the cover is removed and the ooze is exposed to air, the user has 1 minute to handle the rapidly softening ooze before it regains its former viscosity (as well as toxicity) and springs back to life. Although much smaller than an actual ooze creature, this coin-sized blob still deals 1d6 points of acid damage to anything it comes in contact with. Due to its unpredictable nature, petrified ooze is typically only good for breaking or melting whatever object or device on which the user originally sets the ooze, after which the blob quickly scurries into the nearest corner or crevice so it can feed on particles of dust and diminutive prey. Once restored to its viscous form, a petrified ooze moves at a rate of 60 feet per round, and any creature that comes in contact with the ooze must succeed at a DC 12 Reflex save to avoid taking acid damage from it.

Orrery.name: Orrery（Orrery）
Orrery.description:
Source: PZO9449

  價格 100-2,000 gp; 重量 2-12 磅

  This complex mechanism simulates the angles and relative distances between one or more bodies in a solar system in relation to the system's star with marks or spheres on moving gears or arms. Anyone consulting an orrery gains a +2 circumstance bonus on Knowledge (geography) checks involving bodies it models and on Survival checks to navigate the void of space. An orrery can be used in combination with a sextant on a clear night to determine the time on any of the stellar bodies it models. Any orrery can be used as a focus component for the augury spell in place of that spell's normal focus.

  Orreries come in many shapes and sizes and with a variety of functions in mind.

  • A tellurion models a single planet and any moons it may have.
  • A standard orrery tracks the inner planets of a system and their moons.
  • A grand orrery tracks all the known planets of a system and their moons.
  • A calculating orrery is an orrery that indicates with rotating numerals on each arm the current distance between each body and its star (or its planet, in the case of moons), increasing the circumstance bonus on relevant skill checks to +4.

Outfit, Artisan's.name: Outfit, Artisan's（Outfit, Artisan's）
Outfit, Artisan's.description:
Source PZO1110

This outfit includes a shirt with buttons, a skirt or pants with a drawstring, shoes, and perhaps a cap or hat. It may also include a belt or a leather or cloth apron for carrying tools.

Outfit, Burglar's.name: Outfit, Burglar's（Outfit, Burglar's）
Outfit, Burglar's.description:
Source PPZO94102

This outfit consists of fitted pants, a shirt, a hooded reversible cloak, soft leather boots, and a face mask, all in dark or neutral colors. The outfit's few buttons and rivets are wrapped in dull, dark cloth to avoid jingling or reflecting light. A number of loops and shallow pockets are also worked into the outfit, providing ample spaces for stashing small tools or weapons.

Outfit, Cold-Weather.name: 禦寒衣物（outfit, Cold-weather）
Outfit, Cold-Weather.description:
價格：8gp；重量：7磅

  這套服裝專為在寒冷氣候中跋涉，進行登山和打獵活動的人設計而成。它包含一件由羊毛或者厚實動物皮毛製作的大衣、一件亞麻襯衫、一頂羊毛帽、一件厚重的外衣、同樣厚實的裙子或褲子、外加一雙防水皮靴。在某些地區，這套服裝可能幾乎完全使用動物毛皮作為原料進行製作。這套服裝讓穿戴者在對抗寒冷氣候（cold weather）帶來的效果時，強韌豁免檢定獲得+5環境加值。

Outfit, Companion Cold-Weather.name: Outfit, Companion Cold-Weather（Outfit, Companion Cold-Weather）
Outfit, Companion Cold-Weather.description: This vestment works just like a cold-weather outfit, granting a +5 circumstance bonus on Fortitude saving throws against exposure to cold weather, except it is custom made for an animal companion. The added cost represents custom tailoring to ensure that the furs used don't cause unwanted reactions from the animal wearing the outfit.

Outfit, Courtesan's.name: Outfit, Courtesan's（Outfit, Courtesan's）
Outfit, Courtesan's.description:
Source PPZO94102

This outfit includes fine silk or satin garments tailored to complement your figure. In addition, the outfit contains a loose shawl or robe with several discreet pockets for items such as perfume, massage oils, or even a small dagger.

Outfit, Courtier's.name: 禮服（outfit, Courtier's）
Outfit, Courtier's.description:
價格：30gp；重量：6磅

  這套服飾包含一件剪裁講究的服裝，它的款式在當地的宮廷貴族中是最為流行的。身穿便服的人很難讓貴族或朝臣們產生好感（對這些人進行基於魅力的技能檢定均會受到-2減值）。若你穿戴禮服但是沒有用珠寶（這需要額外花費50gp）加以裝飾，那麼你看起來僅僅是個不入流的平民罷了。

Outfit, Dilettante's.name: Outfit, Dilettante's（Outfit, Dilettante's）
Outfit, Dilettante's.description:
Source PZO1121

These clothes are favored by Gnome inventors and wanderers, and consist of sturdy boots, a pair of stout linen pants or skirt, a cloth shirt, leather gloves, a hat and cloak, and numerous belts, straps, and accessories (such as scarves, a vest, bits of rope or twine, and bandoleers). These items are generally mismatched, each having been selected as "superior" from some other set of clothing, and are rife with pockets and small hidey-holes. It the wearer a +2 circumstance bonus on @Compendium[pf1.skills.zK0CbvpYLZhTN5Wn]{Sleight of Hand} checks made to conceal a small object on her body.

As this outfit does not cost 10 gp or less, player characters can not choose this outfit for free when first beginning play.

Outfit, Doctor's.name: Outfit, Doctor's（Outfit, Doctor's）
Outfit, Doctor's.description:
Source PZO9410

Any creature wearing this outfit gains a +2 circumstance bonus on Fortitude saves made to resist contact diseases.

As this outfit does not cost 10 gp or less, player characters can not choose this outfit for free when first beginning play.

Outfit, Entertainer's.name: 藝人服裝（outfit, Entertainer's）
Outfit, Entertainer's.description:
價格：3gp；重量：4磅

  這套浮華——甚至可以說是華而不實——是專為演出而準備的服裝。藝人服裝的樣式各有不同，從引人發笑的丑角服裝到讓人愉快的怪誕服飾一應俱全。不過這些服裝雖然看上去古怪，卻設計成不會影響穿戴者行動能力的樣式，你可以穿著它翻滾、跳舞、走鋼絲或者僅僅用來奔跑（當你的觀眾準備翻臉的時候）。

Outfit, Executioner's.name: Outfit, Executioner's（Outfit, Executioner's）
Outfit, Executioner's.description:
Source PPZO94102

Typically worn by jailers or executioners, this outfit includes a black woolen shirt, a tunic, pants, a belt, sturdy boots, a balaclava or hood, and a great cloak. This outfit is generally too intimidating and macabre to be worn in polite company.

Some executioner's outfits prominently bear the symbol of the government or law-enforcing institution the wearer serves, while others are left ragged and stained to appear all the more threatening.

Outfit, Explorer's.name: 探險家服裝（outfit, Explorer's）
Outfit, Explorer's.description:
價格：10gp；重量：8磅

  這套服裝專為那些不知道會遭遇何種情況的人所設計。它包含結實的靴子、皮褲或皮裙、腰帶、襯衫（也許是馬甲或夾克）、手套和披風。或者是用皮質的束腰外衣穿在布裙外面來取代皮裙。這套服裝上有大量的口袋（披風上的尤其多）。除了上面提到的服飾之外，這套服裝還可以額外新增任何你可能需要的配飾，比如圍巾或者寬簷帽。

Outfit, Flame-Retardant.name: Outfit, Flame-Retardant（Outfit, Flame-Retardant）
Outfit, Flame-Retardant.description: Constructed to resist the effects of hot environments (such as forest fires and areas of volcanic activity), this set of overlapping, heavy leather clothing includes a pair of fire-resistant boots. The outfit grants fire resistance 1, but exposure to fire damage ruins the outfit after 20 rounds.

Outfit, Hot Weather.name: 耐暑衣物（outfit, Hot weather）
Outfit, Hot Weather.description:
價格：8gp；重量：4磅

  耐暑衣物會從頭到腳覆蓋住你的身體，透氣的布料可以讓你感到清涼，幫助你避免遭受陽光的暴曬。這套服裝通常由一件寬鬆的亞麻長袍、一條頭巾或寬鬆的罩帽與面罩組成。它會在抵禦酷暑天氣（hot weather）時的強韌豁免提供+2加值。這不會與生存技能帶來的任何加值疊加。

Outfit, Monk's.name: 武僧服裝（outfit, Monk's）
Outfit, Monk's.description:
價格：5gp；重量：2磅

  這套樸素的服裝僅包括一雙便鞋、外加一身寬鬆的褲子和襯衫，最後用腰帶將兩者綁在一起。武僧服裝的設計是為了提供穿戴者最大限度的機動性，因此是用高品質的織物製作而成。你可以將小型武器藏在服裝褶皺中間的小口袋中，除此之外，服飾配套的腰帶也足夠結實到能夠作為短繩使用。

Outfit, Noble's.name: 貴族服裝（outfit, Noble's）
Outfit, Noble's.description:
價格：75gp；重量：10磅

  這種服裝被故意設計得華貴而花哨，讓所有人都確實地認識到它有多麼昂貴。貴金屬與寶石被直接包容到服裝的設計之中，再飾以精緻的刺繡，有些服飾會為了迎合最新的時尚而做出一些讓步，減少浮誇的設計。若你想裝扮得如同貴族一般，同時還需要一枚璽戒（signet ring）和首飾（至少價值100gp）來搭配這套服裝。

Outfit, Peasant's.name: 平民服裝（outfit, Peasant's）
Outfit, Peasant's.description:
價格：1sp；重量：2磅

  這套服裝的品質很差，它所使用的布料和麻袋的材質沒什麼區別，經常需要縫縫補補來補上破洞。平民服裝包含一套寬鬆的襯衣和短褲，或者寬鬆的襯衣與布裙或罩衫。鞋子是布制裹腳，然後再在容易磨損的部位進行補強使其更加經久耐穿。

Outfit, Pickpocket's.name: 竊賊服裝（outfit, Pickpocket's）
Outfit, Pickpocket's.description:
價格：5gp；重量：3磅

  竊賊服裝配有隱藏的口袋，這套服裝會當你在身上藏匿輕小物品（small objects）時，提供+2加值。

Outfit, Royal.name: 皇室服裝（outfit, Royal）
Outfit, Royal.description:
價格：200gp；重量：15磅

  皇室服裝極其奢華，製成它使用了大量的寶石、黃金、絲綢以及皮毛。這套服裝在最初設計時很少會考慮到磨損問題以及應對惡劣氣候的方面——甚至不會考慮到穿戴者是否能夠使用一己之力穿好服裝——它專為那些會有一群僕從侍奉，並且在各個方面都受到了妥善照顧的人而設計製作。皇室服裝僅包含一套服裝，並不包括皇家權杖、皇冠、戒指或者其他君王所需要的配備。

Outfit, Scholar's.name: 學者服裝（outfit, Scholar's）
Outfit, Scholar's.description:
價格：5gp；重量：6磅

  這套服裝為學者量身定製，它包含一件長袍、一條腰帶、一頂軟帽、一雙軟底鞋，此外還可能附帶一件斗篷。

Outfit, Squire's.name: Outfit, Squire's（Outfit, Squire's）
Outfit, Squire's.description:
Source PPZO94102

This outfit includes heavy woolen pants, a tunic, leather boots, a belt, sturdy gloves, a cap, and a heavy tabard bearing the colors or sigil of a noble house or organization. Many organizations provide new squires this outfit for free, with the expectation they wear it during their duties.

Outfit, Sun Sensitivity.name: Outfit, Sun Sensitivity（Outfit, Sun Sensitivity）
Outfit, Sun Sensitivity.description:
Source PRG:TWoVHD

Dhampirs and other races sensitive to glaring light know a unique hell when traveling under the sun's vicious rays. To protect against the painful light, members of these races often shield themselves with some combination of heavy cloaks, gloves, tinted glasses, screening salves, and-most importantly-wide-brimmed hats. A sun sensitivity outfit prevents creatures with light sensitivity from being dazzled when walking, traveling, or otherwise performing simple acts in areas of bright natural light. Acclimating to the light still requires a moment of adjustment, so even when wearing this outfit, creatures with light sensitivity are dazzled for 1 minute after entering an area of bright sunlight. Violent activity such as combat (or any other act that might jostle the wearer's hat) also counters the outfit's effectiveness, causing the wearer to be subject to light sensitivity as normal. A sun sensitivity outfit offers no protection against magical light, such as the spell Daylight.

Outfit, Traveler's.name: 旅行者服裝（outfit, Traveler's）
Outfit, Traveler's.description:
價格：1gp；重量：5磅

  這套服裝包含靴子、羊毛制的裙子或褲子、堅固的腰帶、襯衫（也可能是馬甲或夾克）、以及帶兜帽的寬大斗篷。

Owlbear Blinders.name: Owlbear Blinders（Owlbear Blinders）
Owlbear Blinders.description:
Source PCh:DDR

  Used in siege warfare, these blinders restrict the owlbear's vision to directly where its head is pointing, helping to stop the owlbear from getting distracted and allowing the rider to focus its attention. This gives the rider a +2 equipment bonus to Ride checks made to control the owlbear, but gives the owlbear a -2 penalty to Perception checks.

Pantograph.name: Pantograph（Pantograph）
Pantograph.description:
Source SoS

  This metal framework of parallel strips is used to duplicate drawings, allowing enlarging (up to twice the original size) or shrinking (down to half the original size) of the copy in the process. The pantograph is anchored, then fitted with a stylus and a writing implement such as chalk, an ink pen, or a pencil. As the stylus is traced over the drawing or other item to be duplicated, the pantograph reproduces the motions, creating a copy. While handy for making quick, accurate copies of ancient carvings, runes, and drawings, a pantograph is unable to produce a convincing forgery. More elaborate and expensive pantographs allow even larger or smaller copies to be made, or multiple copies to be made at the same time.

Printing Press

Source PZO9410

  A hand-cranked press uses a plate on which all of the text on a page is carved in reverse. Changing the plate is a simple process, but creating a new one is expensive and labor-intensive. The press prints one page at a time, at a rate of about five pages per minute. A stationer then needs to cut and trim the pages and bind the book.

Quill, Poisoned

Source PPC:P&P

  價格 30 gp; 重量 -

DESCRIPTION

  This long pen is made from a delicate feather and has a thin and unusually long nib. The quill is typically white in color, though variations that are crimson, onyx, or some combination of these colors also exist. A hidden compartment inside the nib allows the quill to hold a single dose of poison that is dispensable with a small squeeze. Additionally, this provides a +2 circumstance bonus on Sleight of Hand checks to conceal poisons inside the quill. If this quill is used with vector ink, it increases the DC of a poison mixed with the ink by 1.

  This quill can be used as a small shiv to deal 1d3 points of damage and deliver its contained poison. However, because of the fragility of the nib, using the quill in this way destroys it.

Wax, Sealing

Source PZO1110

  Solid wax used for sealing scroll tubes or scrolls together.

Paper.name: 紙（Paper）
Paper.description:
價格 (一張) 4 sp; 重量 -

  一張普通的紙通常是9英吋長6英吋寬，並不適合製作魔法卷軸。它的硬度為0，具有1點生命值，擊破DC5。

Paper, Glue.name: 膠水紙（Paper, Glue）
Paper, Glue.description:
這種1英尺見方的紙片其中一面塗滿了粘性不強的膠水或其他具有粘性材料，例如樹汁甚至是蜂蜜。它通常對摺以便於存儲。如果你將貼紙貼在要打破的玻璃上，其碎片會粘在膠水上而不是掉落在地併發出噪音。膠水紙只能使用一次。

  價格 1 sp; 重量 -

Paper, Rice.name: 宣紙（Paper, Rice）
Paper, Rice.description:
這種紙由水稻、秸稈或樹皮製成。它的硬度為0，具有1點生命值，擊破DC2。

  價格 (一張) 5 cp; 重量 -

Parasol.name: 陽傘（Parasol）
Parasol.description:
陽傘：重量：2磅；價格：1GP

  雨傘：重量：3磅；價格：2GP

  這把半透明的折傘並不能防水，但它可以遮蔽直射的陽光以降低由此導致的高溫酷暑（比如在沙漠環境中）。陽傘在你每小時進行的對抗高溫的強韌豁免檢定上提供+1環境加值，如果你的檢定失敗，它也會減少1點你由此所受的傷害（至少為1）。不過，陽傘並不能保證你不受到高溫天氣的影響。你必須用一隻手打傘並遮住自己才能獲得陽傘的好處。不過除此之外，你也可以給一個體型不大於你的生物打傘遮陽。以上列出的價格是一把普通的布制或油紙傘，如果使用更加奢華或優質的材料，這把傘的價格可能會上升到1~10GP不等。

  雨傘：雨傘要比普通的陽傘重一些，並用的是打蠟的防水布做成傘面。雨傘不但同樣可以用來遮擋陽光，還可以用來擋雨。

Parchment.name: 羊皮紙（Parchment）
Parchment.description:
價格 (一張) 2 sp; 重量 -

  這張經過處理的薄的動物皮是一種耐用的書寫介質，適合製作魔法卷軸。它的硬度為0，具有2點生命值，擊破DC5。

Paste, Blackfingers.name: Paste, Blackfingers（Paste, Blackfingers）
Paste, Blackfingers.description:
Source PZO9232

  This inky paste aids unskilled poison-users. When smeared on the fingers, a dose of blackfingers paste prevents accidental poisoning while applying poison to a weapon, as if the user possessed the poison use ability. A single dose of blackfingers paste lasts for 1d6 hours, but the black stains the stuff creates on the user's fingers lasts for days. A single dose of this alchemical item costs 50 gp.

Paste, Bone.name: Paste, Bone（Paste, Bone）
Paste, Bone.description:
Source PZO9430

  價格 75 gp; 重量 1 磅

  Typically stored in an airtight leather wineskin cured with rare preservative unguents, bone paste is a powerful alchemical sealant with special deteriorative properties. When squeezed out of its container and exposed to air, bone paste quickly hardens, so in order to apply it to a surface or object one must typically squeeze the paste directly onto the material to be affected. Once applied, bone paste cements itself to the object in just seconds, and hardens into a flaky cast. If applied to any unattended organic material or surface (such as wood, paper, hide, or rope), after 1 hour, bone paste undergoes another alchemical reaction and begins to eat away at the material, dealing 1d4 points of damage each round for 1d6+1 rounds, eating away first at the part of the object to which it was applied and spreading briefly to other parts of the object before dissipating and leaving a small amount of residual dust. Bone paste ignores an organic object's hardness, and does not deal damage to inorganic objects or surfaces (such as metal, stone, or ceramic). One pouch of bone paste is enough to cover 1 square foot of surface, or (because of waste and spills) up to 20 smaller applications of approximately 2 square inches each.

Paste, Mending.name: 修復膏（Paste, Mending）
Paste, Mending.description:
價格：25GP重量：1/2磅

  這種氣味難聞的銀色軟膏可以用來暫時修補損壞的金屬物件，如果把它從密封的容器中倒出來，軟膏就會在1d6+4分鐘內凝固成結實的金屬。將一件破損狀態的物品用修復膏修好需要通過一個DC20的相關手藝技能檢定，在完成修復以後，這件物品處於脆弱狀態。用修復膏修理一件魔法物品或是火器的話這個手藝檢定DC+5（魔法火器兩者疊加）。如果修復失敗，你也可以使用另一瓶修復膏繼續嘗試。

Paste, Paper Wall.name: Paste, Paper Wall（Paste, Paper Wall）
Paste, Paper Wall.description:
價格 10 gp; 重量 2 磅

  This jar of thick, gritty paste is made from coarsely ground plant matter, weak epoxy, and bat guano. When exposed to air, the moldable substance quickly creates a thin, paper-like surface, which is ideal for creating false earthen walls. Creating a 5-foot-by-5-foot section of paper wall requires a full-round action. Though this false wall is easy to punch through, it requires a successful DC 13 Perception check to identify the wall as a fake. If the creator of the paper wall spends an additional full-round action disguising the wall with dirt and pebbles, the DC increases by 2.

  Create: Craft (alchemy) DC 15

Paste, Shrieking.name: Paste, Shrieking（Paste, Shrieking）
Paste, Shrieking.description:
Source PZO9430

  價格 35 gp; 重量 2 磅

  Created by suspending the spores of a shrieker mushroom in a thick mixture of wheat paste and vermiculite, this thick sludge comes in a soundproof, stone container. Shrieking paste creates an obnoxious piercing noise when exposed to even minute amounts of movement or light. This makes applying the paste a very noisy endeavor at best. However, once the paste is applied and left alone for several rounds, it once again becomes silent. Thereafter, any light source or movement within 10 feet of the paste causes it to shriek for 1d3 rounds. A single container contains enough shrieking paste to coat 1 square foot of a surface. If left undisturbed for several weeks in a dank, lightless setting, shrieking paste might eventually grow into a colony of shrieker mushrooms.

Pedzahr.name: Pedzahr（Pedzahr）
Pedzahr.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 101
價格 80 gp; 重量 —
分類 Alchemical Remedies

描述

  Drinking this crystal-clear liquid accelerates the natural process of healing Constitution damage. Resting for 1 hour after drinking a vial heals you of 1 point of Constitution damage as if you had benefited from a full night’s rest. Taking multiple doses in an hour does not increase the rate of healing; you must take each individually, followed by an hour of rest, for it to have any effect. Using more than 4 doses of padzahr in 1 day has no effect.

Construction

  Craft (Alchemy) DC 25

Pellet grenade (Adamantine).name: Pellet grenade (Adamantine)（Pellet grenade (Adamantine)）
Pellet grenade (Adamantine).description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 107
價格 150 gp (精金), 100 gp (cold iron), 50 gp (鐵), 70 gp (銀); 重量 1 磅 (精金), 1 磅 (cold iron), 1 磅 (鐵), 1 磅 (銀)

描述

  This variant of a fuse grenade has most of the black powder replaced with metal pellets. When it explodes, it deals 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage, 1d6 points of piercing damage, and 1d6 points of fire damage in a 10-foot-radius burst (Reflex DC 15 halves). A typical pellet grenade uses iron pellets, but they can instead be packed with silver, cold iron, or 精金, bypassing damage reduction as appropriate to that material type. Like ammunition, the pellets are destroyed after one use. Crafting a pellet grenade is a DC 25 Craft (alchemy) check.

Construction

  Craft (Alchemy) DC 25

Pellet grenade (Cold iron).name: Pellet grenade (Cold iron)（Pellet grenade (Cold iron)）
Pellet grenade (Cold iron).description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 107
價格 150 gp (精金), 100 gp (cold iron), 50 gp (鐵), 70 gp (銀); 重量 1 磅 (精金), 1 磅 (cold iron), 1 磅 (鐵), 1 磅 (銀)

描述

  This variant of a fuse grenade has most of the black powder replaced with metal pellets. When it explodes, it deals 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage, 1d6 points of piercing damage, and 1d6 points of fire damage in a 10-foot-radius burst (Reflex DC 15 halves). A typical pellet grenade uses iron pellets, but they can instead be packed with silver, cold iron, or 精金, bypassing damage reduction as appropriate to that material type. Like ammunition, the pellets are destroyed after one use. Crafting a pellet grenade is a DC 25 Craft (alchemy) check.

Construction

  Craft (Alchemy) DC 25

Pellet grenade (Iron).name: Pellet grenade (Iron)（Pellet grenade (Iron)）
Pellet grenade (Iron).description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 107
價格 150 gp (精金), 100 gp (cold iron), 50 gp (鐵), 70 gp (銀); 重量 1 磅 (精金), 1 磅 (cold iron), 1 磅 (鐵), 1 磅 (銀)

  This variant of a fuse grenade has most of the black powder replaced with metal pellets. When it explodes, it deals 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage, 1d6 points of piercing damage, and 1d6 points of fire damage in a 10-foot-radius burst (Reflex DC 15 halves). A typical pellet grenade uses iron pellets, but they can instead be packed with silver, cold iron, or 精金, bypassing damage reduction as appropriate to that material type. Like ammunition, the pellets are destroyed after one use. Crafting a pellet grenade is a DC 25 Craft (alchemy) check.

Construction

  Craft (Alchemy) DC 25

Pellet grenade (Silver).name: Pellet grenade (Silver)（Pellet grenade (Silver)）
Pellet grenade (Silver).description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 107
價格 150 gp (精金), 100 gp (cold iron), 50 gp (鐵), 70 gp (銀); 重量 1 磅 (精金), 1 磅 (cold iron), 1 磅 (鐵), 1 磅 (銀)

描述

  This variant of a fuse grenade has most of the black powder replaced with metal pellets. When it explodes, it deals 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage, 1d6 points of piercing damage, and 1d6 points of fire damage in a 10-foot-radius burst (Reflex DC 15 halves). A typical pellet grenade uses iron pellets, but they can instead be packed with silver, cold iron, or 精金, bypassing damage reduction as appropriate to that material type. Like ammunition, the pellets are destroyed after one use. Crafting a pellet grenade is a DC 25 Craft (alchemy) check.

Construction

  Craft (Alchemy) DC 25

Peptus Salix.name: Peptus Salix（Peptus Salix）
Peptus Salix.description:
價格 30 gp; 重量 -

  This pink liquid has a horrible chalky taste, but is quite effective at counteracting nausea, indigestion, and diarrhea. A vial taken in small doses during the day, alleviates these symptoms. If you drink an entire vial, for 1 hour you get a +2 alchemical bonus on Fortitude saving throws against effects that inflict the nauseated or sickened condition. If you drink a vial of it while suffering from the nauseated or sickened condition, you may immediately roll another saving throw (with the +2 bonus) against the effect; you may gain this particular benefit only once per day. Drinking a vial (whether over the course of a day or all at once) usually turns your tongue black for about a day, though this is a harmless side effect.

Perfume Or Cologne.name: 香水/古龍水（Perfume Or Cologne）
Perfume Or Cologne.description:
Source PZO9410

  大多數香水和古龍水是來自於鮮花精油。香水或古龍水可以（在GM的允許下）給一些基於魅力的技能檢定提供+1的環境加值。

  Perfume and cologne are 普通 accessories for those who hope to avoid offending through scent. More expensive scents are available in finer quarters of any city. Exotic scents are sold in vials containing 10 applications, with a single dose lasting for 24 hours during which its wearer gains a +2 circumstance bonus on all Diplomacy checks (save for those against creatures who, at the GM's discretion, would not be swayed by scent).

Periscope.name: 潛望鏡（Periscope）
Periscope.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 181
價格 20 gp; 重量 4 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  這根2英尺長的金屬管在每個直角末端上都有一面鏡子，如果你從一端看進去，就可以看到另一端的景象，這讓你能夠安全的越過障礙，繞過拐角，或進入不適合頭部進入的狹小空間。使用潛望鏡時，其金屬管的末端視為一個微型的物體，這使得被觀察的生物發現你的可能性極小。如果對被觀察的生物而言，你除了潛望鏡的末端之外都已完全隱藏起來，那麼你的潛行檢定使用潛望鏡的微型體型調整值，而不是你自己的體型調整值。因為鏡子的失真，通過潛望鏡觀察的時候你的察覺檢定有-4懲罰。雖然潛望鏡相當堅固（硬度 5，2點生命值），但裡面的反射鏡是脆弱的（硬度1，1點生命值），任何超過了潛望鏡硬度的傷害也同樣適用於金屬管和裡面的反射鏡。

Phosphorus.name: Phosphorus（Phosphorus）
Phosphorus.description:
Source PZO9445

  價格 2 sp; 重量 -

  Phosphorus is a highly reactive mineral that glows faintly in air. Vital to all life, it is most commonly used by alchemists to create fertilizers, poisons, soaps, and tindertwigs. It is obtained by processing uric acid or bone ash.

Alchemical Power Component

  Doses 10 (2 gp); Spells light descriptor or teleportation subschool

  Spells with the [light] descriptor or of the teleportation subschool are cast at +1 caster level for the purpose of determining range.

Pitcher, Clay.name: 陶罐（Pitcher, Clay）
Pitcher, Clay.description:
Source PZO1110

  這種簡單的陶罐有一個把手和一個有凹槽的開口，以便於傾倒。它能盛裝1/2加侖的液體。

  重量: 1 磅; 容積: 1/2 加侖/4 磅

Piton.name: 巖釘（Piton）
Piton.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
價格 1 sp; 重量 1/2 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  巖釘是末端有個用於綁住繩子的圈或者環的鐵釘。

Plague Powder.name: Plague Powder（Plague Powder）
Plague Powder.description:
Source PZO1135

  價格 varies; 重量 -

  This ash-gray powder is refined from the crushed bones of creatures that died of virulent diseases, illegally produced by nefarious alchemists, and sold on the black market to those seeking to spread illness and death. The application of the powder depends on the disease from which it is refined. Someone using powder made from diseases contracted by ingestion must apply it to food (a full-round action) for the victim to consume. Those using powder made from diseases contracted by injury must apply the powder to weapons (a standard action, as per the poison application rules) and deal damage to victims to subject them to the contagion. Diseases contracted by inhalation require the user to disperse the powder by throwing it into the air. Throwing a handful of plague powder is a splash attack with a range increment of 5 feet. Anyone standing in the square of impact must succeed at a save with a DC equal to that of the disease from which the powder is made to avoid contracting the illness, while those in adjacent squares must attempt the same save with a +4 bonus. Diseases spread through contact can use any of the three manners of application.

  The most 普通 disease refined for these powders is filth fever, costing 144 gp, but refined plague powders of other diseases are available, with a price equal to the base save DC of the disease squared. Making a plague powder always requires access to a sample of the disease and exposes the creator to the disease in question each day of crafting. Crafting a dose of plague powder requires a successful DC 25 Craft (alchemy) check.

Plaster, Casting.name: 石膏（Plaster, Casting）
Plaster, Casting.description:
價格：5SP重量：5磅

  這種白色的乾粉可以用水調製成糊狀，任何在1小時後又會幹燥變硬。石膏可以用來給足印或其他的凹痕取模，糊牆或（打在繃帶裡）固定斷骨。硬化後的石膏每英吋厚度具有1點硬度和5點生命值。5磅石膏粉調製的石膏可以蓋住5平方尺地面或填滿同樣面積但有1英吋深度的凹陷，又或是給5條胳膊或小腿（中型生物），2條手臂和全腿上石膏。兩劑5磅石膏可以為一個小型生物倒一個全身模。

Pocket, Inside.name: Pocket, Inside（Pocket, Inside）
Pocket, Inside.description:
價格 4 gp; 重量 -

  This is an extra pocket sewn on the inside of a piece of clothing. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Sleight of Hand checks to conceal an item in an inside pocket. Detecting the compartment requires a successful DC 15 Perception check at minimum (DC 20 if empty), even if you aren't trained in Sleight of Hand.

  The inside pocket is 1 inch deep. Different styles open from the top or from the side, and some have button flaps to secure the contents.

Poison Caps.name: Poison Caps（Poison Caps）
Poison Caps.description:
Source PPZO9410

  價格 25 gp; 重量 1/2 磅

  These small rubber cones attach to a creature's fangs and allow it to potentially poison those it bites. Poison caps must be filled with an injury poison, and must be attached to a creature's teeth prior to use. A creature equipped with poison caps deals bite damage as a creature one size smaller than usual, but the next time the creature makes a successful bite attack, it also injects the poison from the caps into its target. The price and weight listed above are for a pair of poison caps; both must be used simultaneously in order to be effective. A pair of poison caps can only be used once; they are effectively destroyed after a successful bite attack. The cost of the poison is not included in the cost of the poison caps.

Pole, Balancing.name: 平衡杆（Pole, Balancing）
Pole, Balancing.description:
價格：8SP；重量：12磅

  這條平衡杆大約有15-30尺長，如果使用得當的話，它對你穿越狹窄平面的行動大有幫助。在穿過狹窄平面時，使用平衡杆會為你在特技檢定上提供+1環境加值。

Poncho.name: 雨披（Poncho）
Poncho.description:
價格：5sp；重量：2磅

  這件披蓋使用防水織物（通常使用羊毛或皮革）製作而成，披蓋中間的開口上面附有罩帽，這使得它很容易被收起或者打開，並用於保護整個身體免受雨雪之苦。

Poppy Tears.name: Poppy Tears（Poppy Tears）
Poppy Tears.description:
Source PZO9410

  價格 15 gp

  The milk of this vibrant green cactus, when mixed with resins and other ingredients, congeals into sticky, black chunks with an exceedingly sour taste. Though poppy tears comes in several different varieties, it's refined form is both the most potent and expensive type.

Effects

  Type ingested or inhaled; Addiction moderate, Fortitude DC 20; Initial Effect(s) 1 hour; +1d2 alchemical bonus to Strength, -2 penalty on saves against illusions and mind-affecting effects Secondary Effect(s) after 1 hour; 1d2 hours of fatigue Damage 1d2 Con and 1d2 Wis damage

Portable ram.name: 便攜式攻城錘（Portable ram）
Portable ram.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57
價格 10 gp; 重量 20 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  在試圖使用這種包鐵的木柱破門時，你在力量的檢定上可以獲得+2的環境加值，當有另外一人在幫助你時，該加值可以再增加2。

Portable Terrarium.name: Portable Terrarium（Portable Terrarium）
Portable Terrarium.description:
Source: PZO9481

  價格 100 gp; 重量 4 磅

  This small glass enclosure is 1 foot wide, 1 foot tall, and reinforced with a wooden or metal frame. Tiny air holes in the lid allow living creatures inside the portable terrarium to breathe, and the interior can be outfitted with a variety of substrates and other materials the creatures might require. A portable terrarium is usually fitted with straps so it can be tied to a pack.

  Diminutive and smaller creatures, such as some familiars, can be safely carried within a portable terrarium and have total cover while inside it. Healers and botanists often store living plants in these containers; a successful DC 12 Knowledge (nature) check is required to transplant a plant into a portable terrarium, and most plants can live in a portable terrarium indefinitely so long as they are properly tended.

Portrait Book.name: 肖像繪本（Portrait Book）
Portrait Book.description:
價格：10GP；重量：3磅

  這本100頁的圖冊內含男女矮人、精靈、侏儒、半精靈、半獸人、半身人和人類的標準頭像。只要從後選擇合適的髮型、鬍鬚，以及疤痕及痣斑之類的小細節，即使一個生手畫家可可以輕鬆拼湊出一張與某人的面貌別無二致的肖像——比如，一個正在被審判者們圍剿的半精靈女巫。

Pot, Cooking (Iron).name: 鐵壺（Pot, Cooking (Iron)）
Pot, Cooking (Iron).description:
Source PZO1110

  這種直徑8英吋的堅固鐵罐有腳、蓋子和一個圓形把手。它可以容納足夠餵飽一個飢餓的人一頓飯的食物。

  秘銀壺的重量更輕，食物極少粘在上面。 重2磅，價值2,001 gp.

  重量: 2 磅; 容積: 1 加侖/8 磅

Potion Sponge.name: Potion Sponge（Potion Sponge）
Potion Sponge.description:
Source PZO1121

  This egg-sized sponge is covered in a layer of waterproof edible wax, designed to absorb 1 dose of a potion. Chewing a potion sponge and swallowing its liquid contents is a full-round action. A creature of at least Large size can swallow the sponge in its entirely; other creatures must spit out the sponge once it's depleted (a free action). Unlike a potion that is drunk from a vial, a potion sponge can be used underwater. A potion can be poured from a vial into a sponge potion (or squeezed from a sponge into a vial) as a full-round action. The potion sponge is immune to attacks that specifically target crystal, glass, ceramic, or porcelain, such as shatter. It otherwise works like a potion vial.

Pouch, Belt.name: 腰包（Pouch, Belt）
Pouch, Belt.description:
Source PZO1110

  典型的皮製或布制腰包都有一段皮繩，一頭繫牢開口，另一頭系在你的腰上。 能容納至多10磅或1/5立方尺的物品。

  重量: 1/2 磅1 容積: 1/5 立方尺/10 磅1

1 小型生物的腰包僅有正常的1/4重，大型生物的腰包重量為正常的兩倍。小型生物的腰包容積為正常的1/4

Pouch, Spell Component.name: 法術材料包（Pouch, Spell Component）
Pouch, Spell Component.description:
價格：5GP；重量：2磅

  這枚小皮包裡準備了你所有法術所需的施法材料和器材，不過並不包含更加昂貴的法術材料，神術法器和體積無法裝入皮包的材料。大多數法術材料包都是防水的，並且可以挎在腰上或掛在胸帶上。

Pouch, Waist.name: Pouch, Waist（Pouch, Waist）
Pouch, Waist.description:
價格 5 SP; 重量 1/2 磅

  This leather pack is supported by two straps that can be loosened or tightened to fit most body types. It can be adjusted to any facing along its wearer's waist. The pack can store up to 1/2 cubic foot of material.

Pouch, War Spirit.name: Pouch, War Spirit（Pouch, War Spirit）
Pouch, War Spirit.description:
Source PZO1121

  This tiny bundle of sacred herbs and bones supposedly attracts the attention of helpful battle-spirits. By crushing the pouch as a standard action, an orc (or a creature from a suitably warlike culture) gains 1d4+1 temporary hit points. These temporary hit points go away after 10 minutes. A creature can only benefit from 1 spirit pouch at a time. Once used, the spirit pouch is destroyed.

Powder horn.name: 火藥筒（Powder horn）
Powder horn.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57, Ultimate Combat pg. 141, Inner Sea World Guide pg. 293

描述

  通常由掏空的動物的角製成，但由各種各樣形狀的金屬製火藥筒也越來越多。一個火藥筒可以儲存10份黑火藥。火藥筒可以保護儲存其內的黑火藥，免受於火、電、水和啞火火器的影響。火藥筒狹窄的末端可以像漏斗一樣將那些昂貴的黑火藥小心的倒入火器的槍管裡。

Powder, Black.name: Powder, Black（Powder, Black）
Powder, Black.description:
Source PZO9445

  價格 10 gp; 重量 -

  Black powder is a volatile explosive and is the primary component in fireworks and other explosives.

Alchemical Power Component

  Doses 1 (10 gp); Spells evocation school

  Spells of the evocation school deal 1 additional point of the same type of energy damage.

Powder, Flash.name: 閃光粉（Powder, Flash）
Powder, Flash.description:
價格：50G

  這些粗糙的灰色粉一旦暴露於火焰中，摩擦，甚至是單純的受力（比如將其扔到地板上，標準動作）都會在瞬間被引燃並燃燒殆盡。10尺半徑爆發範圍內的生物會目盲1輪（通過DC15的強韌檢定則無效）。

  製造閃光粉需要一個DC20的工藝（鍊金）檢定。

Powder, Foaming.name: 發泡膠（Powder, Foaming）
Powder, Foaming.description:
價格：10GP重量：1磅

  把這種綠色的粉末以1磅比1加侖水的比例混合，它就能變成最多50立方尺的綠色泡沫。一份發泡膠的發泡速度（如果沒有封裝的話）是每輪產生5尺面積2尺高度的泡泡，而如果同時使用多份發泡膠，這個速度可以加快到每輪延伸5尺。被泡泡覆蓋的地面視為困難地形，但不會造成任何傷害。在1小時後，泡沫會凝固，形成輕巧但堅實（蜂窩狀結構）的固形物。泡沫塑膠易於切割（每英吋0點硬度，5點生命值），不過，這些塑膠會在幾天的時間內分解（遇水的話這個過程還會更快）。如果對著尚未凝固的發泡膠使用法術化泥為石，發泡膠在凝結後則會變成疏鬆，多孔的石頭（每英吋2點硬度，5點生命值）。

Powder, Insomnia.name: Powder, Insomnia（Powder, Insomnia）
Powder, Insomnia.description:
Source PZO9430

  價格 60 gp; 重量 2 磅

  This fine white powder is a powerful stimulant that affects the nervous systems of any creatures that inhale or ingest it, preventing them from sleeping for 24 hours. A packet of insomnia powder can be thrown as a splash weapon with a range increment of 10 feet. A creature struck by a direct hit must succeed at a DC 12 Fortitude save to avoid the effect, while those in the splash radius must succeed at DC 8 Fortitude saves. This is a poison effect.

  Although it causes no severe damage, insomnia can cause a creature to be more prone to fatigue or exhaustion. Though it prevents sleep (and thus prevents wizards and some other spellcasters from regaining their spells), insomnia powder does not prevent a creature from meditating or praying. The effects of insomnia powder can be countered by sleep, neutralize poison, or similar effects.

Powder, Itching.name: 發癢粉（Powder, Itching）
Powder, Itching.description:
價格：60G；重量：2磅

  這種精緻的灰色粉末會讓沾染上的生物遭受到無法控制的瘙癢，直到他們花1整輪時間清洗掉粉末。投擲發癢粉時可以將其視為一個射程增量為10尺的濺射武器。目標方格內的生物需要通過一個DC12的強韌檢定以避免瘙癢，而在周圍方格內的生物需要通過一個DC8的強韌檢定以避免瘙癢。若強韌檢定失敗，則在清洗掉粉末之前攻擊、豁免、技能，屬性等檢定上都將受到-2的減值。這是一種毒藥效果。

  製作發癢粉需要一個DC25的工藝（鍊金）檢定。

Powder, Normal.name: 粉末（Powder, Normal）
Powder, Normal.description:
Source PZO1115

  粉筆末、麵粉和其他類似的材料很受冒險家歡迎，因為它們在定位隱形生物上非常有用。向一個方格扔出一袋粉末是一次針對AC 5的攻擊，這將瞬間揭示那裡是否存在隱性生物。一個更有效的方法是將粉末撒在地面上（需要1整輪）並尋找足跡。

Powder, Rusting.name: 鏽蝕粉（Powder, Rusting）
Powder, Rusting.description:
價格：60GP重量：1磅

  這瓶棕色的粉末是用鏽蝕怪的腺體提取物製成的，它可以迅速腐蝕鋼鐵和類似的金屬。如果把一劑鏽蝕粉倒在金屬鎖或陷阱上，破解此類裝置的解除裝置技能檢定將獲得+5鍊金加值——但也有75%的可能性會完全損壞這件裝置而使它無法回收。如果檢定失敗，裝置被破壞。被破壞的鎖無法重新打開（不過仍然視為完全鎖住）；被破壞的陷阱會立刻觸發。另外，如果你的檢定失敗且檢定結果低於DC至少5點，那麼鏽蝕粉還會影響你所在方格的一件金屬物品（可能包括你的武器和護甲），對物品造成造成5點傷害。

  通常，鏽蝕粉被裝在紙筒裡出售，只要起開其中一端就可以將它倒出來。鏽蝕粉對金，銀，銅，青銅或秘銀無效，但是卻可以輕易毀壞，鐵，鋼和精金。

Powder, Sneezing.name: 噴嚏粉（Powder, Sneezing）
Powder, Sneezing.description:
價格：60G；重量：2磅

  這種粗糙的黃紅色粉末是一種濺射武器，可以造成1D4+1輪無法控制的噴嚏。在受到噴嚏粉影響的方格內的生物必須通過一個DC12的強韌檢定才能避免噴嚏，而周圍臨近方格內的生物必須通過DC為8強韌檢定才能避免噴嚏。受噴嚏粉影響的生物在持續時間內每輪都需要通過一個DC10的強韌檢定，否則直到他們的下一輪前都會恍惚。這是一種毒藥效果。

  製作噴嚏粉需要一個DC為25的工藝（鍊金）檢定。

Pox Burster.name: Pox Burster（Pox Burster）
Pox Burster.description:
Source PZO1121

  A pox burster is an alchemically preserved animal bladder or gourd that has been filled with toxic, rotting materials. You can throw a pox burster as a splash weapon. Treat this attack as a ranged touch attack with a range increment of 10 feet. A direct hit forces a target to immediately make a DC 13 Fortitude save or contract filth fever. Every space adjacent to the target square of the pox burster is covered in disease-causing filth. For the next minute, any creature that is injured while in one of these spaces must also make a DC 9 Fortitude save or contract filth fever.

Printing Press.name: Printing Press（Printing Press）
Printing Press.description:
Source PZO9410

  A hand-cranked press uses a plate on which all of the text on a page is carved in reverse. Changing the plate is a simple process, but creating a new one is expensive and labor-intensive. The press prints one page at a time, at a rate of about five pages per minute. A stationer then needs to cut and trim the pages and bind the book.

Quill, Poisoned

Source PPC:P&P

  價格 30 gp; 重量 -

DESCRIPTION

  This long pen is made from a delicate feather and has a thin and unusually long nib. The quill is typically white in color, though variations that are crimson, onyx, or some combination of these colors also exist. A hidden compartment inside the nib allows the quill to hold a single dose of poison that is dispensable with a small squeeze. Additionally, this provides a +2 circumstance bonus on Sleight of Hand checks to conceal poisons inside the quill. If this quill is used with vector ink, it increases the DC of a poison mixed with the ink by 1.

  This quill can be used as a small shiv to deal 1d3 points of damage and deliver its contained poison. However, because of the fragility of the nib, using the quill in this way destroys it.

Wax, Sealing

Source PZO1110

  Solid wax used for sealing scroll tubes or scrolls together.

Pull-cord grenade.name: Pull-cord grenade（Pull-cord grenade）
Pull-cord grenade.description:
Source Black Markets pg. 21
價格 150 gp; 重量 2 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  This clay container resembles a fuse grenadeUE, but trails a pulley and wire rather than a fuse. Pulling the cord (a move action) sparks a flint and steel within the device, causing the grenade to explode. The pull cord can be attached to a door or drawer within 5 feet, or strung across a 5-foot square, causing the grenade to detonate when its tripwire is disturbed. A pull-cord grenade cannot be reused.

This can be crafted with a DC 25 Craft (traps) check.

Pull-Cord Grenade

  Type mechanical; Perception DC 15; Disable Device DC 15

Effects

  Trigger touch; Reset none
Effect explosion (2d6 bludgeoning damage and 1d6 fire damage); Reflex DC 15 half; multiple targets (all targets within 10 feet)

Pulque.name: 龍舌蘭酒（Pulque）
Pulque.description:
價格：1SP-4SP；重量：1/2磅-2磅

  這種乳白而有營養的酒是用發酵的龍舌蘭芯或者其他龍舌蘭類植物釀造的。

Quicksilver.name: Quicksilver（Quicksilver）
Quicksilver.description:
Source PZO9445

  價格 1 gp; 重量 -

  Quicksilver is a liquid metal with dangerous mental effects on those who handle it. It is most often distilled from crystalline amalgams such as cinnabar and stored in iron flasks.

Alchemical Power Component

  Doses 3 (3 gp); Spells mind-affecting descriptor

  Spells with the [mind-affecting] descriptor are cast at +1 caster level for the purpose of determining duration.

Quill, Poisoned.name: Quill, Poisoned（Quill, Poisoned）
Quill, Poisoned.description:
Source PPC:P&P

  價格 30 gp; 重量 -

DESCRIPTION

  This long pen is made from a delicate feather and has a thin and unusually long nib. The quill is typically white in color, though variations that are crimson, onyx, or some combination of these colors also exist. A hidden compartment inside the nib allows the quill to hold a single dose of poison that is dispensable with a small squeeze. Additionally, this provides a +2 circumstance bonus on Sleight of Hand checks to conceal poisons inside the quill. If this quill is used with vector ink, it increases the DC of a poison mixed with the ink by 1.

  This quill can be used as a small shiv to deal 1d3 points of damage and deliver its contained poison. However, because of the fragility of the nib, using the quill in this way destroys it.

Wax, Sealing

Source PZO1110

  Solid wax used for sealing scroll tubes or scrolls together.

Rack.name: Rack（Rack）
Rack.description:
Source: PZO1135

  價格 300 gp; 重量 500 磅

  Note Each act of torture shifts the torturer's alignment one step toward evil, and it counts as a willful evil act for the purpose of effects like atonement.

  The rack is one of the most infamous and feared devices in the torturer's arsenal, capable of inflicting ruinous damage to a victim's body. Helpless victims are splayed across the device's frame, and each limb is lashed to a central windlass. Each turn of the crank deals a cumulative 1d6 points of nonlethal damage, up to 4d6 points of nonlethal damage on the fourth turn. Each subsequent turn after the fourth deals 4d6 points of nonlethal damage and deals 1 point of damage each to the victim's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution scores as it dislocates limbs, cracks cartilage, and breaks bone. Some racks are fitted with spiked wheels that puncture the victim's body, dealing lethal damage rather than nonlethal damage. Escaping from a rack requires a successful DC 30 Escape Artist check.

Rat Cage

Source: PZO1135

  價格 5 gp; 重量 15 磅

  Note Each act of torture shifts the torturer's alignment one step toward evil, and it counts as a willful evil act for the purpose of effects like atonement.

  This specially crafted steel cage can hold up to 20 rats, and includes stout leather straps around its open end and a metal crucible for holding hot charcoal or other fuel on its top end. Torturers tightly strap the open end of the device to a helpless victim's abdomen, insert the rats into the cage, and set the crucible's fuel alight. In 1d10 rounds, the increasing heat causes the rats to gnaw and dig their way through the victim's abdomen to escape, dealing 1 point of piercing damage per rat each round. A victim can wiggle free of a rat cage with a successful DC 20 Escape Artist check, though some of the voracious vermin may continue their consumption in subsequent rounds.

Thumbscrew

Source: PZO1135

  Common 價格 15 gp; 重量 1 磅; Masterwork 價格 50 gp; 重量 1 磅

  Note Each act of torture shifts the torturer's alignment one step toward evil, and it counts as a willful evil act for the purpose of effects like atonement.

  Both a torture and restraining device, this small, metal armature consists of two parallel, spike-studded bars that close together as the user tightens the frame's screws, crushing a victim's thumbs between them. A victim restrained by a thumbscrew is able to move but can't effectively wield weapons, hold items, or perform any actions or skill checks that require manual dexterity, taking a -5 penalty on all such actions and dealing 1d6 points of nonlethal damage to himself with each attempt (this doesn't include Escape Artist attempts to escape the thumbscrew).

  Spellcasters bound by thumbscrews are unable to cast spells with somatic components.

  When using a thumbscrew as a torture device, the user can turn the thumbscrew's bolt to deal 1d6 points of nonlethal damage.

  Escaping from a thumbscrew requires a successful DC 28 Escape Artist check (DC 30 for a masterwork thumbscrew).

Trephine

Source: PZO1135

  價格 20 gp; 重量 1 磅

  Note Each act of torture shifts the torturer's alignment one step toward evil, and it counts as a willful evil act for the purpose of effects like atonement.

  This surgical instrument has a serrated, circular blade that is used to bore holes into the skulls of patients to relieve cranial swelling from head trauma or, as some chirurgeons believe, release evil spirits. Use of a trephine takes 10 minutes, and deals 5 points of piercing damage to the subject creature. With a successful DC 25 Heal check, the user can heal up to 1d4 points of ability damage to any one mental ability score caused by physical trauma to the head, such as the critical called shot or debilitating blow called shot, or it can cure the severe brain trauma inflicted by the debilitating blow called shot. If the user fails the check, the subject still takes 5 points of piercing damage. If the user fails the check by 5 or more, the subject instead takes 10 points of piercing damage and 1 point of damage each to its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.

Rat Cage.name: Rat Cage（Rat Cage）
Rat Cage.description:
Source: PZO1135

  價格 5 gp; 重量 15 磅

Rations, Dwarven Trail.name: 矮人乾糧（rations, Dwarven trail）
Rations, Dwarven Trail.description:
價格：2GP；重量：1-1/2磅

  矮人族常備的乾糧以燻腸和煙肉，硬烤餅和蔬菜乾為主。如果你是一個矮人，你可以以一整個星期只吃乾糧換取每天額外的一個小時無懲罰的急行（hustle）或者強行軍時間（不可在一天內同時進行）。這個增益效果持續到你食用其他的食品或者一天都沒有進餐時為止。

Rations, Elven Trail.name: 精靈乾糧（rations, Elven trail）
Rations, Elven Trail.description:
價格：2GP；重量：1磅

  精靈族的乾糧偏愛用燕麥和其他穀物做的麵包，加入漿果、堅果和蜂蜜，再配上幹水果和果仁。如果你是一個精靈，你可以以一整個星期只吃乾糧換取在所有“堅忍”專長影響的檢定和豁免上＋2加值。這個增益效果持續到你食用其他的食品或者一天都沒有進餐時為止。

Rations, Gnome Trail.name: 侏儒乾糧（rations, Gnome trail）
Rations, Gnome Trail.description:
價格：2GP，重量：1磅

  侏儒族的乾糧大多數以預製食品為主——考慮到侏儒有時候一個星期也只需要吃兩餐的習慣。如果你是一個侏儒，你可以以一整個星期只吃乾糧換取在對抗以生命骰數決定效果的法術，比如七彩噴射和睡眠術時視為比目前生命骰數+1，但是這個效果並不會真的增加你的施法者等級、人物等級或者生命骰數。這個增益效果持續到你食用其他的食品或者一天都沒有進餐時為止。

Rations, Halfling Trail.name: 半身人乾糧（rations, Halfling trail）
Rations, Halfling Trail.description:
價格：2gp；重量：1/2磅

  半身人族的乾糧總是會超過一個半身人冒險者正常的飯量——食物總是多多益善，吃的多就有勇氣。通常的半身人乾糧會包括甜乾果、陳年香腸、硬奶酪、蜂蜜蛋糕，以及堅果、穀物和肉乾末的混合物。如果你是一個半身人，你可以以一整個星期只吃乾糧換取在受到戰慄效果影響時只承受-1減值而非-2。這個增益效果持續到你食用其他的食品或者一天都沒有進餐時為止。

Rations, Orc Trail.name: 獸人乾糧（rations, Orc trail）
Rations, Orc Trail.description:
價格：1GP；重量：1磅

  典型的獸人族乾糧由粗硬的黑麵包、硬的和皮革一樣的細香腸（需要拚命嚼才能嚥下去）、天知道是什麼動物的肉乾以及超辣的辣椒組成。如果你是一個獸人或者半獸人，你可以以一整個星期只吃乾糧換取在對抗你的威嚇檢定時DC+2。這個增益效果持續到你食用其他的食品或者一天都沒有進餐時為止。

Rations, Trail.name: 乾糧（rations, Trail）
Rations, Trail.description:
價格：5SP；重量：1磅

  上述價格：是一人一天份的乾糧。這些食物通常包括風乾的肉、水果和穀物，根據準備乾糧的地區和種族不同其內容也千差萬別。只要保持乾燥，一份乾糧通常可以保質一個月以上。

Realgar.name: Realgar（Realgar）
Realgar.description:
Source PZO9445

  價格 3 gp; 重量 -

  Realgar, also called ruby of arsenic, is a red crystal useful in creating poisons and medicines. It is commonly purified into arsenic, a crystalline metal known as the "king of poisons" for its popularity among nobles seeking to poison their rivals.

Alchemical Power Component

  Doses 1 (3 gp); Spells poison descriptor

  The DC to identify or neutralize spells with the [poison] descriptor is increased by +2.

Repellent, Vermin.name: Repellent, Vermin（Repellent, Vermin）
Repellent, Vermin.description:
Source PZO9410

  This vile-smelling white paste keeps vermin at bay if spread on the skin. Normal-sized (Fine) vermin avoid you. Swarms of vermin must make a DC 15 Fortitude saving throw in order to enter your square. Once applied, vermin repellent remains effective for 4 hours or until you spend 1 round washing it off.

  Create: Craft (alchemy) DC 20

Retort Of Control.name: Retort Of Control（Retort Of Control）
Retort Of Control.description:
Source PPC:AM

  價格 13,000 gp; Slot none; CL 9th; 重量 -; Aura moderate transmutation

  This crystal retort was meticulously crafted from the hides of a dozen shattered crysmals. When light is shone through the retort, the concoction within glows like a golden torch.

  A retort of control can be used to perform spontaneous alchemy with speed and precision. Distillation and sublimation can be carried out in merely 10 minutes when using this tool. In addition, if the user speaks a command word while using spontaneous alchemy to create an alchemical item with the retort as an additional crafting tool, she can designate one creature type or creature subtype. The created alchemical item does not affect creatures of the designated creature type or subtype-alchemical weapons do not harm such creatures on a direct hit or with splash damage, alchemical remedies do not work on such creatures, and so on.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

  Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells haste, mark of justice; Cost 7,500 gp

Ring of Protection +1.name: +1防護戒指（Ring of Protection +1）
Ring of Protection +1.description: 穿戴者被一股魔力保護，AC得到+1至+5的偏斜加值。

Ring of Protection +2.name: +2防護戒指（Ring of Protection +2）
Ring of Protection +2.description: 穿戴者被一股魔力保護，AC得到+1至+5的偏斜加值。
