Ring, Poison Pill.name: 藏毒戒指（Ring, Poison Pill）
Ring, Poison Pill.description:
Source PZO1115

  這種戒指在鑲嵌珠寶的底座下有一個極小的暗格，通常用來存放毒藥。打開或關閉戒指是一個移動動作，要隱秘的這麼做而不被別人看到需要通過一個DC 20的手上功夫檢定。

Ring, Signet.name: 璽戒（Ring, Signet）
Ring, Signet.description:
Source PZO1110

  這枚戒指上有浮雕的圖案，通常是家徽或官方圖徽。你可以將璽戒按入軟蠟，並留下徽記的印痕。

Rockshard Canister.name: Rockshard Canister（Rockshard Canister）
Rockshard Canister.description:
Source PZO9468

  價格 50 gp; 重量 25 磅

  Two separate compartments make up this black glass canister the size of a helmet. The large lower compartment contains hundreds of jagged shards of obsidian. The upper airtight chamber contains a sticky resin that hardens immediately upon contact with air. When you strike the canister with a bludgeoning melee weapon as a standard action, both compartments shatter, causing the obsidian shards to adhere to the weapon.

  The weapon deals piercing damage rather than bludgeoning damage for 10 minutes, at which point the resin dries and the shards fall off, or until you roll a natural 1 on an attack roll, which causes the shards to break off prematurely. If the weapon is made of a special material, the special properties of its material are suppressed while the obsidian shards adhere to the weapon.

  If you use a rockshard canister to coat an unarmed strike or natural weapon, you take 2d6 points of piercing damage when shattering the canister to apply the shards. For unarmed attacks, this can be avoided by carefully applying thick leather or rope straps to your hands and feet, which requires 5 minutes of work, prior to smashing the canister.

Rope.name: 麻繩（Rope）
Rope.description:
Rope

  Hempen The DC to escape hemp rope bonds is equal to 20 + the CMB of the creature that tied the bonds. Ropes do not need to make a check every round to maintain the pin. If the DC to escape is higher than 20 + the tying creatures CMB, the tied up creature cannot escape from the bonds, even with a natural 20 on the check. This rope has 2 hit points and can be burst with a DC 23 Strength check. 價格 1 gp; 重量 10 磅

  FYI: The Equipment Trick feat provides a number of options for using this item in combat.

  Silk Rope This 50-foot length of silk rope has 4 hit points and can be broken with a DC 24 Strength check. 價格 10 gp; 重量 5 磅

  Bloodvine Rope This 50-foot length of tough, lightweight rope is made from alchemically treated bloodvine, a rare scarlet-colored vine that grows only in warm jungle environments. Though prized by climbers for its durability, bloodvine can also be used to bind creatures. Bloodvine rope has a hardness of 5 and 10 hit points, and can be broken with a DC 30 Strength check. A creature bound by bloodvine rope can escape with a DC 35 Escape Artist check or a DC 30 Strength check. The DC to create bloodvine rope with Craft (alchemy) is 30. 價格 200 gp; 重量 5 磅 Source PRG:ACG

  Spider's Silk Rope This 50-foot length of rope is woven of strands of silk from monstrous spiders. Rare to virtually nonexistent on the surface world, it is commonly used by the dark elves, though shorter spider's silk rope scraps (generally no more than 10 feet long) occasionally appear among goblins. Spider's silk rope has 6 hit points and can be broken with a DC 25 Strength check. 價格 100 gp; 重量 4 磅

Rope, silk.name: Rope, silk（Rope, silk）
Rope, silk.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57
價格 10 gp; 重量 5 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  This 50-foot length of silk rope has 4 hit points and can be broken with a DC 24 Strength check.

Rumboozle.name: 甜蛋酒（Rumboozle）
Rumboozle.description:
價格：1SP；重量：1/2磅

  這是一種用朗姆酒、紅酒、麥酒、雞蛋、糖和香料混合煮制的烈酒，熱蛋酒通常在高級酒館裡才能喝到。

Sack.name: 袋（Sack）
Sack.description:
Source PZO1110

  這種沉重的帆布袋對於裝冒險裝備和其他補給品而言很有用，它的容積約4立方英尺。袋口上有一條穿過許多環扣的皮帶，只要拉緊並繫上就可以紮緊袋子。

  重量: 1/2 磅1 容積: 1 立方尺/60 磅1

1 小型生物的容器僅有正常的1/4重，大型生物的容器重量為正常的兩倍。小型生物的容器容積為正常的1/4

Saddle (exotic, military).name: 異種軍用鞍座（Saddle (Exotic, Military)）
Saddle (exotic, military).description:
價格：60gp；重量：40磅

  鞍座是裝在坐騎上，用於支撐騎手或其他物品的裝備。

  這些鞍座是專為各種非常規坐騎而設計的，每個鞍座都為某種特定類型的野獸量身定製。就和普通的鞍座一樣，異種鞍座也分為軍用、載貨和騎乘三種類型，並且具有相同的特性。

  這種鞍座可以支撐騎手，所有與維持在鞍座上（staying in the saddle）相關的騎術檢定都會獲得+2環境加值。若騎手在使用軍用鞍座時陷入昏迷（knocked unconscious），那麼他有75%的概率不會從鞍座上跌落下來。

Saddle (Exotic, pack).name: 異種載貨鞍座（Saddle (Exotic, Pack)）
Saddle (Exotic, pack).description:
價格：15gp；重量：20磅

  鞍座是裝在坐騎上，用於支撐騎手或其他物品的裝備。

  這些鞍座是專為各種非常規坐騎而設計的，每個鞍座都為某種特定類型的野獸量身定製。就和普通的鞍座一樣，異種鞍座也分為軍用、載貨和騎乘三種類型，並且具有相同的特性。

  載貨鞍座用於運送裝備和貨物，而非支撐騎手。它能夠負載的貨物與坐騎能夠負載的數量相同。

Saddle (Exotic, riding).name: 異種騎乘鞍座（Saddle (Exotic, Riding)）
Saddle (Exotic, riding).description:
價格：30gp；重量：30磅

  鞍座是裝在坐騎上，用於支撐騎手或其他物品的裝備。

  這些鞍座是專為各種非常規坐騎而設計的，每個鞍座都為某種特定類型的野獸量身定製。就和普通的鞍座一樣，異種鞍座也分為軍用、載貨和騎乘三種類型，並且具有相同的特性。

  這種鞍座是騎行裝備中最為標準的類型。若騎手在使用騎乘鞍座時陷入昏迷（knocked unconscious），那麼他有50%的概率不會從鞍座上跌落下來。

Saddle (Military).name: 軍用鞍座（Saddle (Military)）
Saddle (Military).description:
價格：20gp；重量：30磅

  鞍座是裝在坐騎上，用於支撐騎手或其他物品的裝備。

  這種鞍座可以支撐騎手，所有與維持在鞍座上（staying in the saddle）相關的騎術檢定都會獲得+2環境加值。若騎手在使用軍用鞍座時陷入昏迷（knocked unconscious），那麼他有75%的概率不會從鞍座上跌落下來。

Saddle (Pack).name: 載貨鞍座（Saddle (Pack)）
Saddle (Pack).description:
價格：5gp；重量：12磅

  鞍座是裝在坐騎上，用於支撐騎手或其他物品的裝備。

  載貨鞍座用於運送裝備和貨物，而非支撐騎手。它能夠負載的貨物與坐騎能夠負載的數量相同。

Saddle (Riding).name: 騎乘鞍座（Saddle (Riding)）
Saddle (Riding).description:
價格：10gp；重量：25磅

  鞍座是裝在坐騎上，用於支撐騎手或其他物品的裝備。

  這種鞍座是騎行裝備中最為標準的類型。若騎手在使用騎乘鞍座時陷入昏迷（knocked unconscious），那麼他有50%的概率不會從鞍座上跌落下來。

Saddlebags.name: 鞍囊（Saddlebags）
Saddlebags.description:
價格：4gp；重量：8磅

  這些堅固的防水包裹可以掛在鞍座上，用於增加額外的攜帶容量。鞍囊的每一邊通常能夠攜帶20磅重的物體。鞍囊並不會增加坐騎所能夠負載的重量：上限；只是用於給騎手一些額外的空間儲存裝備使用。

Salt.name: Salt（Salt）
Salt.description:
Source PZO9445

  價格 5 sp; 重量 -

  Salt is a vital mineral commodity. It is most commonly used as a desiccant and as a catalyst.

Alchemical Power Component

  Doses 20 (10 gp); Spells necromancy school

  Spells of the necromancy school are cast at +1 caster level for the purpose of effects.

Saltpeter.name: Saltpeter（Saltpeter）
Saltpeter.description:
Source PZO9445

  價格 3 gp; 重量 -

  Saltpeter is used to create fertilizers, propellants, fireworks, and preservatives.

Alchemical Power Component

  Doses 1 (1 gp); Spells fire descriptor

  Spells with the [fire] descriptor deal +1 fire damage.

Salve Exemplar Weapon.name: Salve Exemplar Weapon（Salve Exemplar Weapon）
Salve Exemplar Weapon.description:
Source PZO9455

  價格 350 gp; 重量 1 磅

DESCRIPTION

  This alchemical salve strengthens the material of a weapon, improves its balance, gives it greater flexibility without sacrificing resilience, and enhances its ability to hold an edge or point and survive an impact. An application turns a typical non-magical melee weapon into a masterwork weapon. A double weapon requires 2 doses of exemplar weapon salve, and 50 arrows, bolts, or similar ammunition can be enhanced by a single application.

Salve, Stonechipper.name: Salve, Stonechipper（Salve, Stonechipper）
Salve, Stonechipper.description:
Source PZO1121

  This gritty, gray ointment weakens rocky materials. When applied to an object made of stone, it reduces the object's hardness by 3 for 10 minutes. As a standard action, a creature can apply the paste to affect one 5-foot-square or a Medium or smaller creature. The paste only affects hardness, not damage reduction or similar defenses.

Sash, Adventurer's.name: Sash, Adventurer's（Sash, Adventurer's）
Sash, Adventurer's.description:
Source PPZO94102

  價格 20 gp; 重量 3 磅

  This bandolier holds six pouches along its length and a satchel at the hip. Each pouch has a stiff leather flap that can be secured against jostling with a clasp (requiring a move action to open or close) or left unfastened for easier access. The pouches and satchel contain loops and ties for securing additional equipment.

  The sash buckles at the shoulder, and in an emergency can be freed with a sharp tug as a move action.

Satchel, Familiar.name: 魔寵包（Satchel, Familiar）
Satchel, Familiar.description:
Source PZO1123

  這種覆蓋甲片的容器為呆在其中的超小型或更小的生物提供全掩蔽。它有一個空氣孔（如果需要去水下的話，可以用軟木塞塞上）以及容納兩天份的食物和水的空間。

Scale, Merchant's.name: Scale, Merchant's（Scale, Merchant's）
Scale, Merchant's.description:
價格 2 gp; 重量 1 磅

  A merchant's scale is a simple lever on a fulcrum, from which two trays hang. It grants a +2 circumstance bonus on Appraise checks involving items that are valued by weight, including anything made of precious metals.

Scarf.name: 披巾（Scarf）
Scarf.description:
價格：1sp - 5gp；重量：0.5磅

  藝人們經常會在表演中使用性感的裝束和迷人的道具。而色彩鮮豔的布料或透明的絲綢所製成的披巾便是她們最愛的配飾，這些披巾上通常會繡著複雜的花紋和圖案。

Scarf, Filter.name: Scarf, Filter（Scarf, Filter）
Scarf, Filter.description:
價格 5 gp; 重量 -

  Made of heavy material, this scarf filters out dust, sand, smoke, and other airborne contaminants. When worn over your nose and mouth, this scarf grants you a +1 resistance bonus on saving throws against inhaled poisons and other airborne effects that require breathing.

Scarf, Head.name: Scarf, Head（Scarf, Head）
Scarf, Head.description:
Source PPZO94102

  價格 1 sp-10 gp; 重量 -

  Often worn for privacy, religious or cultural reasons, or protection from the elements, full scarves designed to be wrapped around the head are 普通 accessories. Headscarves of bright colors or ornate embroidery can fetch a substantially higher price.

Scarf, Pocketed.name: 藏物圍巾（scarf, Pocketed）
Scarf, Pocketed.description:
價格：8gp；重量：0.5磅

  通過精巧的設計，這條圍巾的一側有數個經過偽裝的小口袋。藏物圍巾會在你進行在身上藏匿物品的巧手檢定時，提供+4加值。這些加值不會與身穿厚重衣物所提供的加值疊加，但是會與嘗試藏匿輕小物品（small objects）的加值疊加。

Scarf, Reinforced.name: 強固圍巾（scarf, Reinforced）
Scarf, Reinforced.description:
價格：10gp；重量：1磅

  這條8尺長的圍巾一側使用鏈條和金屬板進行了加固。儘管這還不足以為防護等級提供加值，不過這條多功能的圍巾可以作為鎖鏈來進行短距離的攀爬或者束縛敵人之用。強固圍巾的有10點硬度和4點生命值。需要成功進行DC為24的力量檢定才能掙斷它。

Scent Cloak.name: 遮味劑（Scent Cloak）
Scent Cloak.description:
價格：20磅重量：2磅

  這一撮精細碾碎的香料，植物種子，麝香和其他鍊金製劑可以灑在你的身上以混淆你的個人氣味訊息，使你聽過氣味被追蹤的DC增加10點，持續24小時。不過，因為你仍然有氣味存在所以擁有靈敏嗅覺的生物還是可以估測你的位置——它們只是無法將你個人的氣味辨識出來而已。將遮味劑完全清除掉是一個整輪動作。

Sealing wax.name: Sealing wax（Sealing wax）
Sealing wax.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
價格 1 gp; 重量 1 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  This stick of red wax is used to seal envelopes, often using an impression from a signet ring as proof they were sent by you.

Seeing Slime.name: Seeing Slime（Seeing Slime）
Seeing Slime.description:
Source PZO1140

  價格 160 gp

  This violet slime mold is found only in rock formations containing nodules of agate.

  Gather DC 19; Yield 1 dose

  Terrain any underground

  Preparation After collecting this rare slime mold from where it naturally occurs in the lightless depths, the herbalist must combine the slime with mineral salts and store it in an airtight container such as a bottle or jar.

  Use The slime causes mild skin rashes, but it grants darkvision out to a range of 30 feet for 24 hours if applied to the eyes (a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity). If the subject already had darkvision, the darkvision's range increases by 30 feet. Frequent use of this herb causes permanent purple blotches on the skin around the user's eyes.

Sewing needle.name: 縫紉針（Sewing needle）
Sewing needle.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
價格 5 sp; 重量 —
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  這種針允許你將布、帆布或薄皮革縫合在一起。

Shadowcloy.name: Shadowcloy（Shadowcloy）
Shadowcloy.description:
Source PZO1121

  This thin black liquid is stored in airtight flasks because it evaporates quickly when exposed to air. Its cloying vapors cling to a target, obscuring vision for a short period of time. You can throw a shadowcloy flask as a splash weapon with a range increment of 10 feet. A direct hit means the target treats the ambient light as one category darker than normal, with a creature already in natural darkness treating it as supernatural darkness. This effect lasts for 1 round. A thrown shadowcloy flask has no effect on adjacent creatures or if it misses.

Shears.name: Shears（Shears）
Shears.description:
Small- 重量 1/2 磅 價格 5 sp; Lopping- 重量 8 磅 價格 3 gp; Adamantine- 重量 8 磅 價格 3,003 gp

  Shears are used to quickly cut through items by snipping them between two sharp blades fitted with a spring to allow the jaws to open again after closing. Small shears can be used in one hand and are often used to trim hair, cut cloth, or perform other delicate cutting work. Lopping shears are 3 feet long and must be used in two hands; they are commonly used by farmers or gardeners to cut hedges and branches.

  Adamantine shears are lopping shears with sharpened 精金 blades that can snip through nearly any material.

  You can use 精金 shears to cut through bars, chains, grates, or similar items, dealing damage to such objects as though using a scimitar and bypassing hardness less than 20.

  On any item the 精金 shears can fit around (such as a chain or iron bar, but not an iron door), using 精金 shears provides a +10 bonus on your Strength check to break or burst it.

Shovel.name: 鐵鍬（Shovel）
Shovel.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57
價格 2 gp (普通), 10 gp (摺疊); 重量 8 磅 (普通), 12 磅 (摺疊)

描述

  這種工具可以讓你以2立方英尺每分鐘的速度挖坑。如果在戰鬥中使用鐵鍬，把它視為單手臨時武器，造成與同樣大小的木棒相等的鈍擊傷害。摺疊鐵鍬：摺疊鐵鍬是由一個堅固的可摺疊手柄和鏟刀組成的完整尺寸的鐵鍬。鏟柄的摺疊結構可以讓它摺疊到比鏟刀還短，這使它可以被放進一個較小的空間，比如背包裡。將鐵鍬從摺疊展開（反之亦然）需要2個整輪動作。

Shovel (Common).name: 鐵鍬 (普通)（Shovel (Common)）
Shovel (Common).description:
Source Adventurer's Armory pg. 19, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
價格 2 cp; 重量 3 磅
分類 冒險裝備

描述

  這種工具可以讓你以2立方英尺每分鐘的速度挖坑。

Shovel (Folding).name: 鐵鍬 (摺疊)（Shovel (Folding)）
Shovel (Folding).description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57
價格 2 gp (普通), 10 gp (folding); 重量 8 磅 (普通), 12 磅 (folding)

描述

這種工具可以讓你以2立方英尺每分鐘的速度挖坑。如果在戰鬥中使用鐵鍬，把它視為單手臨時武器，造成與同樣大小的木棒相等的鈍擊傷害。摺疊鐵鍬：摺疊鐵鍬是由一個堅固的可摺疊手柄和鏟刀組成的完整尺寸的鐵鍬。鏟柄的摺疊結構可以讓它摺疊到比鏟刀還短，這使它可以被放進一個較小的空間，比如背包裡。將鐵鍬從摺疊展開（反之亦然）需要2個整輪動作。

Silver.name: Silver（Silver）
Silver.description:
Source PZO9445

  價格 1 gp; 重量 -

  Silver is a lustrous precious metal used in mirrors, disinfectants, electrics, and illusion-creating magic items.

Alchemical Power Component

  Doses 10; Spells illusion school

  The DC of Will saves made to disbelieve a spell of the illusion school is increased by +1.

Silversheen.name: Silversheen（Silversheen）
Silversheen.description: This shimmering paste-like substance can be applied to a weapon as a standard action. It gives the weapon the properties of alchemical silver for 1 hour, replacing the properties of any other special material it might have. One vial coats a single melee weapon or 20 units of ammunition.

Skates, Ice.name: Skates, Ice（Skates, Ice）
Skates, Ice.description:
價格 1 gp; 重量 2 磅

  Each of these calf-high boots bears a vertical blade on the bottom, allowing you to travel swiftly on ice. Wearing ice skates allows you to move on ice at normal speed with a successful DC 5 Acrobatics check (including running and charging), but your movement is reduced to half speed on all other terrain. Donning or removing an ice skate is a full-round action. Skating with only one is possible, but the DC of the Acrobatics check rises to 15.

Skillet.name: 平底鍋（Skillet）
Skillet.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57
價格 8 sp (普通), 2,001 gp (秘銀); 重量 4 磅 (普通), 2 磅 (秘銀)

描述

  這種直徑8英吋直的平底鍋有很長的把手和腳，這樣你就可以把它放在火或者燃燒的煤炭上。那種以鉸鏈連接，把手可以在鍋底上摺疊起來的類型更受冒險者的青睞，因為它更容易儲存和運輸。秘銀的平底鍋更加輕便，食物也極少粘在其上。

Skis.name: 滑雪板（Skis）
Skis.description:
價格：5gp；重量：20磅

  對於中型的穿戴者來說，每塊滑雪板都是長約5-6尺的平直木板，在前端微微向上捲曲，底面有著縱向的溝槽，在上方有附帶繩帶的木質或金屬製的支架，用於固定住穿戴者的靴子。穿著滑雪板使你能夠在冰雪上以正常速度移動，但是你的移動速度在其他所有地形中都會降低至5尺。通常來說你需要兩根一端尖銳的杆子來幫助自身移動、以及在滑雪時維持平衡，但是在沒有合適的裝備時，標槍（javelins）、短矛（shortspears）、或者甚至是經過修剪的樹枝都可以拿來用作此用。穿上或脫下滑雪板是整輪動作，不過你也可以通過移動動作來砍斷繩帶來達到快速脫掉的效果（如果你想再次使用滑雪板的話，則需要替換或修好繩帶）。

Sky Mine.name: Sky Mine（Sky Mine）
Sky Mine.description:
Source PZO9257

  價格 1,000 gp; 重量 500 磅

  Dwarves fill these 20-foot-diameter cloth balloons with a secret and highly flammable gas (included in the price) and then release them into the sky over their enemies. To transform the balloons into decoys, dwarven siege warriors place dummies in cargo baskets beneath the balloons to look like balloonist scouts or snipers. Whoever releases the balloon can attempt a DC 15 Profession (driver), Knowledge (nature), or Wisdom check; if the check is successful, the balloon can be guided out to a maximum range of 300 feet, a far enough distance for archers to safely shoot the balloon with flaming arrows, causing it to explode in a devastating ball of fire. A detonated sky mine creates a 50-foot-radius burst of flame that deals 10d6 points of fire damage to anything in the area.

Smelling Salts.name: Smelling Salts（Smelling Salts）
Smelling Salts.description:
Source PZO1115

  These sharply scented gray crystals cause people inhaling them to regain consciousness. Smelling salts grant you a new saving throw to resist any spell or effect that has already rendered you unconscious or staggered. If exposed to smelling salts while dying, you immediately become conscious and staggered, but must still make stabilization checks each round; if you perform any standard action (or any other strenuous action) you take 1 point of damage after completing the act and fall unconscious again. A container of smelling salts has dozens of uses if stoppered after each use, but depletes in a matter of hours if left opened.

  Create: Craft (alchemy) DC 20

Smoke Pellet.name: 煙玉（Smoke Pellet）
Smoke Pellet.description:
價格：25GP重量：-

  這種陶土小球在內部有兩個分隔，分別含有兩種不同的鍊金物質，把煙玉在地上打碎會形成5尺範圍內渾濁難聞但無害的煙霧。這樣使用的煙玉相當於發煙棒的效果，但煙霧只持續1輪時間。你可以將一個煙玉當做射程增量10尺的遠程武器來進行遠程接觸攻擊。

Smokestick.name: 發煙棒（Smokestick）
Smokestick.description:
價格：20GP重量：1/2磅

  這種經過鍊金術處理的小木棍在點燃時可以放出濃厚而難以消散的濃煙。發煙棒造成的煙霧可以填滿一個10尺方格的空間（如同法術雲霧術的效果，不過中等或強風可以在1輪內吹散煙霧）一根發煙棒在1輪內會燒盡，它產生的煙霧足以維持1分鐘時間。

Snorkel.name: 潛水管（Snorkel）
Snorkel.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57
價格 5 sp (普通), 5 gp (masterwork); 重量 — (普通), — (masterwork)

描述

  這種防水的木管的末端是一個帶咬嘴的彎管。當你咬住咬嘴時，潛水管繞過你的臉伸向後腦勺，讓你在面朝下游泳或剛好被淹沒時能夠一直呼吸。若潛水管的頂端被淹沒了，那麼它就會充滿水且不能用來呼吸，直到你將其中的水移除（需要移動動作並完全聯通空氣）。一個普通的潛水管的長度大約是15英吋（譯註：1.25英尺），若比著更短，你在游泳時潛水管就會灌滿了水，但若比這長，你就無法通過潛水管呼吸到足夠的新鮮空氣。

精製潛水管：這種潛水管在頂端有一個閥門，能夠防止潑濺的水，且當你潛水時也能阻止水進入潛水管。它你嘴的附近也一個集水槽和閥門，防止水進入你的嘴巴，並在你浮出水面時自動排出多餘的水。

Snowshoes.name: 雪地鞋（Snowshoes）
Snowshoes.description:
價格：5gp；重量：4磅

  這些木框內有繩子或筋腱製成的緊繃網子，將這樣的物體綁在你的腳上時，可以將你的體重分散在雪地上，讓你難以踏入積雪組成的地面，從而讓你的步伐變得更加輕鬆。雪地鞋可以讓你在厚實的雪地行走時所受的懲罰降低50%；比如，在雪地上行走時，每移動1格會花費2格的移動力（正常的1格外加作為懲罰的1格），若你穿上了雪地鞋，在雪地上每移動1格僅會花費1.5格的移動力。雪地鞋可以附加到任意一套其他服飾上。

Soap.name: 肥皂（Soap）
Soap.description:
Source PPZO9410

大部分的肥皂是由動物脂肪和從灰燼中提取的鹼液製成。你可以用此這種厚塊肥皂來擦洗衣服、盆、床單，你或者別人的身體，或其他任何可能變髒的東西。一塊肥皂大約可以使用50次。

Soldier's Uniform.name: Soldier's Uniform（Soldier's Uniform）
Soldier's Uniform.description:
價格 1 gp; 重量 5 磅

  The exact details of this item varies from country to country, but typically includes sturdy boots, leather breeches or a kilt, a belt, a shirt, gloves, a cloak or jacket, and a hat. The belt includes several loops or rings for tying pouches, a waterskin, a scabbard, and similar things a traveling soldier requires.

Soothe Syrup.name: Soothe Syrup（Soothe Syrup）
Soothe Syrup.description:
Source PZO1115

  This sweet and wholesome-tasting blue liquid creates a sense of warmth and comfort. Soothe syrup coats your stomach and makes it much more difficult for you to succumb to queasiness. For 1 hour after drinking soothe syrup you gain a +5 alchemical bonus on saving throws made to resist effects that would make you nauseated or sickened.

  Create: Craft (alchemy) DC 15

Soul Stimulant.name: Soul Stimulant（Soul Stimulant）
Soul Stimulant.description:
價格 300 gp; 重量 -

  This soothing elixir was created to counter the energy-draining effects of vampires, wights, and similar horrible creatures. If you have a negative level (whether temporary or permanent), you can drink a dose of soul stimulant, negating the negative level's penalty for 12 hours. You can only benefit from 1 dose of soul stimulant at a time, though you can continue to take a dose every 12 hours to stave off the negative level's effects.

Sparring Gear.name: Sparring Gear（Sparring Gear）
Sparring Gear.description:
Source PPZO94102

  價格 35 sp; 重量 15 磅

  This array of thick, heavily lined pads, including a quilted helmet, rigid shin guards, and a wraparound rib guard, protects you during hand-to-hand training. Sparring gear cannot be worn with armor, but grants DR 2/- against nonlethal damage. Fighting schools often customize their sparring gear to feature prestigious colors or symbols.

Spellbook.name: 法術書（Spellbook）
Spellbook.description:
價格：15GP；重量：3磅

  一本法術書擁有100頁羊皮紙書頁，它所記錄的每一條法師法術會佔據每個法術環數一頁的頁數（0環法術只佔1頁）。一個職業是法師的角色在起始時會擁有一本公式薄並記載有他已知的法術。

Spider Sac.name: Spider Sac（Spider Sac）
Spider Sac.description:
Source PZO1121

  Despite their name, spider sacs have nothing to do with spiders but rather are alchemical devices with a unique delivery system. Used for climbing as well as combat, these grayish, gourd-like pouches are made of a specially grown fungus with a tough but rubbery exterior. The fungoid is carefully harvested, pierced at one end, hollowed out, and then injected with a strong alchemical adhesive that hardens to a fibrous material almost instantly when exposed to air. When squeezed, a spider sac's adhesive shoots out to a maximum range of 10 feet and sticks to whatever it strikes, whereupon the strand dries instantly into a durable fibrous rope. For the purposes of climbing, treat a spider sac as a grappling hook except that all surfaces are AC 5. A spider sac can also be used as a lasso except with AC 10, 4 hit points, and a DC 24 Strength check to burst. A spider sac is a single-use item.

Spirit Of Wine.name: Spirit Of Wine（Spirit Of Wine）
Spirit Of Wine.description:
Source PZO9445

  價格 5 sp; 重量 -

  Spirit of wine is purified, alchemically active alcohol commonly used as a fuel or solvent in alchemical items, specialized inks, and perfumes. It is too pure to drink alone, but can be used as a reagent to form tinctures and alchemical drinks.

Alchemical Power Component

  Doses 6 (3 gp); Spells calling and summoning subschools

  Spells of the calling and summoning subschools are cast at +1 caster level for the purpose of determining duration of effects.

Spirit planchette.name: Spirit planchette（Spirit planchette）
Spirit planchette.description:
Source Pathfinder #43: Haunting of Harrowstone pg. 19
Aura moderate divination; CL 9th
Slot none; 價格 4,000 gp (Brass), 10,000 gp (Cold Iron), 18,000 gp (Silver); 重量 5 磅

描述

  A spirit planchette is typically found in a wooden case along with a thin wooden board printed with numerous letters and numbers. Nonmagical versions of these divination tools can be purchased in curiosity shops (typically costing 25 gp); while these items can be used as alternative components for augury spells, only magical spirit planchettes allow users to communicate with the other side. Three types of spirit planchettes exist—brass, cold iron, and silver. Each in turn allows an increasingly potent form of divination effect to be utilized. A spirit planchette requires a board to move upon, but this “board” can be made up of letters scribed upon any smooth surface—it need not be a prepared board for a spirit planchette to work.

To use a spirit planchette, you must rest your fingers lightly upon the planchette’s surface and then concentrate on the planchette (as if maintaining a spell with a duration of concentration) for 2d6 rounds while the planchette attunes itself to the ambient spirits of the area. After this time, the planchette begins to slowly slide in random patterns across the board—at this point, questions may be asked of the spirits by any of the individuals involved in the séance. The consequences of each question asked of the spirits depends upon what type of planchette is used for the divination, as summarized on the table below. The spirits reply in a language understood by the character who asked the question, but resent such contact and give only brief answers to the questions. All questions are answered with “yes,” “no,” or “maybe,” or by spelling out a single word from the letters arranged on the board. The spirits answer each question either in the same round the question is asked (in the case of a yes, no, or maybe answer) or at a rate of one letter per round (in the case of a single word being spelled out). A spirit planchette may be used once per day—the maximum number of questions you can ask with it depends on the type of planchette being used (as detailed on the table below).

Communication with spirits can be a dangerous task, for many spirits are jealous or hateful of the living. Every time a spirit planchette is used, the user must succeed on a Will save to avoid being temporarily possessed and harmed by the angry spirits. In some areas where the spirits are particularly violent or hateful (such as in Harrowstone), this Will save takes a –2 penalty. The DC of this save depends on the type of spirit planchette being used. Anyone who fails the Will save becomes confused for a number of rounds (depending on the type of planchette being used), and no answer is received. The spirits in the area are not omniscient—the GM should decide whether or not the spirits would actually know the answer to the question asked, and if they do not, the answer granted is automatically “maybe.” If the GM determines that the spirits are knowledgeable about the answer, roll d% to determine whether the spirits speak truthfully or whether they lie.

Planchette Type Questions per Use Will Save DC Confusion Duration True Answer Lie
Brass 1 11 1 round 01-60 61-100
Cold Iron 3 15 2 rounds 01-75 76-100
Silver 5 19 3 rounds 01-90 91-100

Construction

  Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, contact other planes, speak with dead; Cost 2,000 gp (brass spirit planchette), 5,000 gp (cold iron spirit planchette), 9,000 gp (silver spirit planchette)

Spiritbane spike.name: Spiritbane spike（Spiritbane spike）
Spiritbane spike.description:
Source Undead Slayer's Handbook pg. 13
價格 300 gp; 重量 1 磅
分類 Alchemical Tools

描述

  When you slash this alchemically treated iron spike against your flesh—a move action that deals 1d6 points of damage— the spike extends and becomes a short sword with the ghost touch weapon special ability. The spike reverts to its old form after 10 minutes, corroded and useless. Should a spiritbane spike rematerialize within a corporeal body, it is shunted to the nearest empty space without effect. Crafting this item requires a successful DC 25 Craft (alchemy) check.

Construction

  Craft (Alchemy) DC 25

Spyglass.name: 望遠鏡（Spyglass）
Spyglass.description:
價格 1000 gp; 重量 1 磅

  通過望遠鏡看到的物體會被放大到它們的實際大小的兩倍。使用望遠鏡的人物對可見目標的察覺技能檢定的懲罰為每距離目標20英尺-1。

Stabling.name: Stabling（Stabling）
Stabling.description:
價格 5 sp/day; 重量 -

  This is the amount it costs to stable a single creature that is Large or smaller for one day, at a typical stable or hostler. Particularly fancy stables may cost more, and larger or more exotic creatures cost double.

Star Charts.name: Star Charts（Star Charts）
Star Charts.description:
Star Charts

Source PZO1121

  Many half-elves live in large cities or communities where they find it difficult to commune with nature. While some go on long sojourns to the wilderness, others spend their evenings on high, lonely rooftops, gazing at the stars. These lonely souls use star charts to track the movement of the stars and other celestial bodies. Anyone referencing one of these charts on a clear night can attempt a DC 20 Knowledge (geography) check to determine her approximate location and the month. In addition, these charts grant a +2 circumstance bonus on Survival checks made to avoid getting lost at night with a clear sky.

Stationery.name: 信紙（Stationery）
Stationery.description:
Source PZO9410

  價格 1 gp; 重量 -

  一般只被富人使用，昂貴的信紙是一種優質的9英吋長6英吋寬的紙，往往飾以浮雕或刻有主人的私人印章。

Stillgut.name: Stillgut（Stillgut）
Stillgut.description:
Source PZO1121

  Drinking a vial of this bland, bluish liquid grants you a +5 alchemical bonus on Fortitude saves to avoid nausea or sickness for 1 hour. If you are already nauseated, you can drink stillgut as a move action. Drinking it in this fashion grants you a second saving throw (without the +5 bonus). Goblins often use stillgut so they can choke down meat or other foods in stages of rot or decay.

Stretcher.name: 擔架（Stretcher）
Stretcher.description:
價格：1GP；重量：10磅

  擔架可以讓兩個人一起抬著一件重物行動，或是你一個人利用它來拖拽一件你無法直接承載的重物。一架擔架最多可以承載300磅重量：。

String or Twine.name: 細繩或麻繩（String or Twine）
String or Twine.description:
String or Twine

  價格 1 cp; 重量 1/2 磅

  細繩和麻繩以50英尺的繩球或線軸的形式出售，可用於繩索陷阱和報警器，且是爪鉤箭的重要組成部分。細繩或麻繩硬度為0，1點生命值，擊破DC14。

Striped nutmeg.name: Striped nutmeg（Striped nutmeg）
Striped nutmeg.description:
Source Adventurer's Guide pg. 14
價格 15 gp Black cumin, 20 gp Flaming sumac, 30 gp Golden cardamom, 100 gp Striped nutmeg, 15 gp Sunrise cinnamon, 25 gp Tiger cloves, 5 gp Violet salt; 重量 — Black cumin, — Flaming sumac, — Golden cardamom, — Striped nutmeg, — Sunrise cinnamon, — Tiger cloves, — Violet salt

描述

Food spoils more quickly in hot climates, and Qadirans have become experts at using the spices that they trade to help preserve their meals. After importing plants from across the planes, Qadiran druids and alchemists bred and magically adapted unique species with enhanced medicinal properties. Al-Zabriti tribes generally have supplies of the following spices on hand. To gain the benefits of these spices, a character must consume multiple doses over 1 or more days, as indicated for each spice. Once the benefit is gained, continued consumption at that rate maintains the benefit.

Black Cumin: Cumin is a nutty seasoning used in savory foods. If eaten twice per day for a week, it grants those who consume it a +1 alchemical bonus on Fortitude saves to resist disease for the following 24 hours. An ounce of black cumin sells for 15 gp and seasons 14 meals.

Flaming Sumac: A tart spice, sumac allows a character who contracts a natural disease with multiple effects to suffer one fewer effect (determined randomly) each time he fails a saving throw to resist that disease’s effects. An individual must consume flaming sumac twice per day for at least 3 days to gain its effects, which last for 24 hours after the last dose is consumed. An ounce of flaming sumac sells for 20 gp and seasons six meals.

Golden Cardamom: This fragrant, sweet powder is made from ground cardamom seeds and is often used as a perfume and tooth cleaner, as well as a seasoning in rice dishes and desserts. When a character takes ability damage from a disease, the actual damage taken is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0). Golden cardamom has no effect on ability drain or other effects caused by disease. It must be eaten once per day for 9 days to build up sufficiently within an individual’s body to provide this effect. An ounce of golden cardamom seeds sells for 30 gp and seasons nine meals.

Striped Nutmeg: Used for both desserts and meats, nutmeg halves any ability damage (but not ability drain) resulting from non-supernatural disease, to a minimum damage of 1. It must be eaten three times per day for at least 4 days to provide this effect. An ounce of ground striped nutmeg sells for 100 gp and seasons 12 meals.

Sunrise Cinnamon: A warming spice, sunrise cinnamon is used for seasoning both sweet and savory foods. It promotes sweating, and a character who ingests it twice per day for 5 days gains a +4 alchemical bonus on Fortitude saves made to resist the effects of hot environments. An ounce of ground sunrise cinnamon sells for 15 gp and seasons 10 meals.

Tiger Cloves: Cloves are used in both sweet and savory foods, brewed into teas, and chewed as a breath freshener. When chewed for 1 minute, a dose of tiger cloves removes nauseated or sickened conditions caused by disease or poison effects. When used to season a meal, a dose of tiger cloves grants a +2 alchemical bonus on saving throws to resist the nauseated or sickened conditions for 24 hours after the meal is eaten. A single dose of tiger cloves sells for 25 gp and seasons one meal.

Violet Salt: Salt is of vital importance for retaining a body’s water. If a dose of Qadiran violet salt is consumed as part of a meal, it grants a +4 alchemical bonus on Constitution checks to resist the effects of ongoing thirst for the next 24 hours. A dose of violet salt sells for 5 gp and seasons one meal.

Stubborn nail.name: Stubborn nail（Stubborn nail）
Stubborn nail.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 322
Aura faint abjuration; CL 3rd
Slot none; 價格 100 gp; 重量 1/2 磅

描述

  This 精金 piton is 6 inches long. As a standard action, the bearer may push the nail by hand into any non-living material, including metal, stone, or wood. The bearer may push it through more than one item at a time, so long as the total thickness is not greater than the length of the nail. Once pushed into place, the nail is held firmly as if it had been hammered there (a DC 20 Strength check to remove it), although the creature who put it there can remove it as a move action. Once removed, the nail leaves no hole or other sign of its presence. The nail can support 500 pounds. If used to hold a door shut, increase the break DC of the door by +2. If pressed into a lock, the lock cannot be opened until the nail is removed. Once removed, the nail loses all its powers and transforms into a nonmagical iron piton.

Construction

  Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, arcane lock, mending; Cost 50 gp

Sugar Lemons.name: Sugar Lemons（Sugar Lemons）
Sugar Lemons.description:
Sugar Lemons

Source PPC:MM

  價格 1 gp; 重量 1 磅

  Sugar lemons make prized preserves when ground, salted, and sealed in jars, adding an intense citrus flavor when sprinkled atop other foods. If, within 8 hours of consuming a meal seasoned with Sugar lemons, you gain the confused condition, you can roll 1d6 and subtract the result from the result of your d% roll to determine what action you take for the first round in which you are confused. This benefit does not stack with itself.

  The price and weight listed represent a jar containing enough preserved lemons to season 10 meals.

Sunderblock.name: Sunderblock（Sunderblock）
Sunderblock.description:
Source PZO9455

  價格 35 gp; 重量 2 磅

DESCRIPTION

  This lumpy, lard-like, alchemical substance is designed to protect armor and weapons from dents and cracks that commonly develop in close-combat equipment. When liberally applied to armor or weapons, the material provides a greasy surface that blunts impacts, causes blades to slide aside, and strengthens the gear it is applied to. A single container holds enough sunderblock to coat a single weapon or suit of armor as a full-round action. The effects aren't pronounced enough to increase the Armor Class bonus of a suit of armor, but the hardness of armors and weapons coated with sunderblock increases by 5. This bonus lasts for 12 hours, at which point the greasy substance dries and flakes away.

Sunrise cinnamon.name: Sunrise cinnamon（Sunrise cinnamon）
Sunrise cinnamon.description:
Source Adventurer's Guide pg. 14
價格 15 gp Black cumin, 20 gp Flaming sumac, 30 gp Golden cardamom, 100 gp Striped nutmeg, 15 gp Sunrise cinnamon, 25 gp Tiger cloves, 5 gp Violet salt; 重量 — Black cumin, — Flaming sumac, — Golden cardamom, — Striped nutmeg, — Sunrise cinnamon, — Tiger cloves, — Violet salt

A dose of violet salt sells for 5 gp and seasons one meal.

Sunrod.name: 日光杖（Sunrod）
Sunrod.description:
價格：2GP重量：1磅

  這支1尺長度的金頭鐵杖可以在敲擊（通過一個標準動作）後以光亮程度的照明照亮30尺半徑的區域，並在額外30尺的範圍內使光照等級上升1級（黑暗變成昏暗[Dim Light]，昏暗變成普通光照），但是日光杖無法把光照等級提高到普通光照或明亮光照以上。一支日光杖可以維持發亮6小時，之後黃金就會燒盡，只留下無用的鐵條。

Surefoot Training Blocks.name: Surefoot Training Blocks（Surefoot Training Blocks）
Surefoot Training Blocks.description:
Source: PZO9455

  價格 50 gp; 重量 25 磅

  This collection of eight heavy wooden or metal cones, cylinders, and spheres fills an ordinary backpack. None of the shapes is precisely regular, and when stacked atop each other, they teeter precariously and easily topple. Acrobats practice by stacking these blocks in unstable configurations and attempting to balance while standing upon them.

  Using surefoot training blocks to improve your balance requires 1 hour of practice and a DC 15 Acrobatics check. If you succeed at the check, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Climb checks and on Acrobatics checks to balance on narrow surfaces or uneven ground. This bonus lasts for 24 hours or until you fail a Climb or Acrobatics check.

Swarmsuit.name: 防蟲衣（Swarmsuit）
Swarmsuit.description:
Source PZO1115

  這是一種沉重而多層重疊的服裝，配有一個邊緣圍繞著密集的、面紗一樣的網的寬簷帽，使得微型和超微型的生物不可能與你的身體進行物理性的接觸。穿戴防蟲衣會使你的速度降低到一半，但你會在對抗超微型生物的集群時獲得DR 10/-，對抗微型生物的集群時獲得DR 5/-。

Synthetic mumia.name: Synthetic mumia（Synthetic mumia）
Synthetic mumia.description:
Source Undead Slayer's Handbook pg. 9
價格 150 gp; 重量 —
分類 Alchemical Remedies

描述

  A laboratory-created version of the expensive and infamous Osirian drug mumia (Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Lost Kingdoms 21), synthetic mumia is a mixture of honey, embalming fluids, and various animal organs. The murky liquid comes enclosed in small packets made of intestine. Mumia and synthetic mumia may be taken interchangeably to stave off the effects of addiction to either substance, and is thus used by some mumia junkies hoping to quit their addiction. Crafting synthetic mumia requires a successful DC 14 Craft (Alchemy) check.

Synthetic Mumia

  Type ingested or injury; Addiction moderate, Fortitude DC 14
價格 150 gp
Effects 1 hour; +2 alchemical bonus on saving throws against spells and effects with the curse or disease descriptor, fatigue
Damage 1d2 Wis damage

Construction

  Craft (Alchemy) DC 14

Tabard.name: 戰袍（Tabard）
Tabard.description:
價格：5gp；重量：1磅

  戰袍通常會披在護甲外面，這種外套通常是無袖並且兩側開口的設計。寬大的前襟繪有的紋章或者徽章的圖案，這使得他人很容易識別出穿戴者所屬的部隊。

Tangleburn bag.name: 熾火絆足包（Tangleburn Bag）
Tangleburn bag.description:
價格：150G；重量： 5磅

  這種袋子裡包含了絆足包和能再高溫下燃燒的鍊金粉。它的工作原理和絆足包一樣，但是在直接命中生物後會對其造成1D6的火焰傷害，且該目標必須通過一個DC20的反射豁免，否則就會著火。若著火，則在接下來的兩輪中撲滅火焰的反射檢定由15提升為25。若使用水來滅火，則將會燃料的爆裂燃燒，這會對目標造成等同於熾火膠直接命中的傷害（包括濺射傷害）。2輪之後，火焰才能被正常撲滅。

  製造纏繞灼燒包需要一個DC30的工藝（鍊金）檢定。

Tanglefoot Bag.name: 絆足包（Tanglefoot Bag）
Tanglefoot Bag.description:
價格：50G；重量： 4磅

  絆足包是一個裝滿了焦油、樹脂和其他粘性物質的小袋子。

  當你將絆足包扔向一個生物時（作為射程增量為10尺的遠程接觸攻擊），袋子會散開，裡面的粘膠將會飛濺出來，糾纏在目標的身上，之後在暴露的空氣下會很快的變硬且有彈性。被糾纏的生物將會遭到-2的攻擊檢定減值及-4的敏捷減值。被糾纏的目標必須通過反射的豁免檢定（DC15），否則將會被粘附在地面上無法移動。如果通過了檢定，他也只能以一半的速度移動。

  超大型或者更大的生物不受絆足包的影響。飛行生物不會被粘附在地面上，但它必須通過反射豁免檢定（DC15），否則就不能飛（假設它使用翅膀飛行）並且落在地面上。絆足包在水下沒有作用。

  被粘附在地板上（或不能飛）的生物可以通過力量的檢定（DC17），或者對該粘膠施加15點的揮砍傷害來試圖掙脫。刮掉自己身上的粘膠，或者其他人協助刮掉粘膠並不需要進行攻擊檢定，可以直接進行傷害的檢定。一旦恢復了行動自由，人物可以以半速移動（或飛行）。在被粘膠限定行動時，施法者在施展法術時必須通過專注檢定（DC15）以保證法術的成功。在暴露在外界2d4回合以後粘膠會變脆並容易破碎，會碎成碎片，失去它的作用。萬溶劑（universal solvent）可以立即溶解粘住生物的粘膠。

  製造絆足包需要一個DC25的工藝（鍊金）檢定。

Tar Bomb.name: Tar Bomb（Tar Bomb）
Tar Bomb.description:
Source PZO9422.

  A tar bomb is an easy weapon to make, and devastating in use. A head-sized lump of tar is wrapped around a rope and set on fire. You use the rope to lob the burning tar onto an enemy's deck, where it sticks and sets the ship alight. In many ways, a tar bomb functions as a less potent version of alchemist's fire, as it deals less damage and lacks the splash damage of the more expensive substance. Treat this attack as a ranged touch attack with a range increment of 10 feet. Lighting a tar bomb is a move action.

  A hit with a tar bomb deals 1d4 points of fire damage and has the potential to set the struck object or creature on fire, causing an additional 1d6 points of fire damage each round unless the target or an adjacent creature makes a DC 15 Reflex save to extinguish the flames as a full-round action. Knocking the tar bomb or the burning creature or object into a body of water or magically extinguishing the flames automatically smothers the fire.

Tattoo.name: 紋身（Tattoo）
Tattoo.description:
Source PZO1115

  紋身的價格取決於它的品質、大小和所使用顏色的數量。十年內不會模糊，硬幣大小的藍色紋身，其價格為1銅幣；不會褪色的，一隻手掌大小的黑色紋身，其價格為1銀幣；覆蓋整個背面的紋身需要分幾次紋，且價格為10金幣。每個額外顏色的價格差不多等於獨個相同大小的紋身的價格。雖然這些價格代表了基準，但紋身——就像任何其他藝術作品一樣——的價值可能更高，這取決於藝術家的聲望。

  

Bags, Barrels, Boxes, Chests & Pouches

  All containers are empty unless stated otherwise (price and weight are for container only.)
